modules.App:
--[[
	App — the ZAAL Assets panel.

	Left: every skin in this place, grouped by slot, with its status, tier and shop
	state; search and filters. Right: the selected skin — a 3D thumbnail, what it
	needs before the shop, Preview on the ship, Setup (face / light / name text),
	Tier (website + game), the checks, what Approve would change, and Approve.

	Nothing runs per frame. Live hooks: Selection.SelectionChanged while the panel
	is open, and the preview's model watch while a skin is being previewed.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local ToolPreview = require(script.Parent.ToolPreview)
local ToolSkinMount = require(script.Parent.ToolSkinMount)
local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)
local Preview = require(script.Parent.Preview)
local Setup = require(script.Parent.Setup)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)
local PreviewTab = require(script.Parent.PreviewTab)
local Review = require(script.Parent.Review)
local Guide = require(script.Parent.Guide)
local ImportTab = require(script.Parent.ImportTab)
local BundlesTab = require(script.Parent.BundlesTab)
local Importer = require(script.Parent.Importer)
local Screenshot = require(script.Parent.Screenshot)
local Convert = require(script.Parent.Convert)

local LOGO = "rbxassetid://92946926368629" -- the game's wheel-face symbol (docs/notes/tooling/brand-assets.md)

local new, T, col = Theme.new, Theme.text, Theme.color

local App = {}

local state = {
	mode = nil, -- "ship" | "tool"
	skins = {},
	results = {},
	selected = nil,
	filter = "all",
	query = "",
	collapsed = {}, -- [slot] = true
	previewing = nil, -- the skin shown on the preview ship
	previewItem = 1,
	showRow = false,
	busy = false,
}
local ui = {}

local STATE_LABEL = { new = "NEW", same = "IN SHOP", changed = "CHANGED" }
local STATE_COLOR = { new = col.accent, same = col.ok, changed = col.warn }

local function module() return state.mode == "tool" and ToolSkins or ShipSkins end

local function worst(r)
	local lvl = "ok"
	for _, c in ipairs(r.checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then return "bad" end
		if c.level == "warn" then lvl = "warn" end
	end
	return lvl
end

local function toast(text, level)
	if not ui.status then return end
	ui.status.Text = text
	ui.statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = level and col[level] or col.info
end

local function expectedItemId(skin)
	return (skin.kind == "tool" and "Tool:" or "Ship:") .. skin.slot .. ":" .. skin.key
end

local function tierOf(skin, r)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	if web and web.tier then return Slots.TIERS[web.tier] end
	if skin.kind == "tool" then return r and r.want and r.want.Tier end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local e = cat and cat[skin.slot] and cat[skin.slot][skin.key]
	return e and e.tier
end

local function inspectOne(skin)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local r = module().inspect(skin, web or nil, web == false) -- false: asked, and not on the website
	state.results[skin] = r
	return r
end

local renderList, renderDetail
local renderBodyList, renderBodyDetail -- the Body colours tab (defined further down)

-- LIST --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function matches(skin)
	local q = state.query:lower()
	if q ~= "" and not skin.key:lower():find(q, 1, true) and not skin.slot:lower():find(q, 1, true) then return false end
	local r = state.results[skin]
	if not r then return true end
	if state.filter == "new" then return r.status == "new" end
	if state.filter == "changed" then return r.status == "changed" end
	if state.filter == "problems" then return worst(r) == "bad" end
	if state.filter == "review" then return Review.get(skin.model) ~= nil end
	return true
end

renderList = function()
	-- the filter chips belong to the skin lists: hidden on Preview and Import, whose list moves up
	if ui.filters then
		local own = state.mode ~= "preview" and state.mode ~= "import" and state.mode ~= "bundles"
		ui.filters.Visible = own
		ui.list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, own and 78 or 40)
		ui.list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, own and -78 or -40)
	end
	if state.mode == "body" then return renderBodyList() end
	if state.mode == "preview" then return PreviewTab.renderList() end
	if state.mode == "import" then return ImportTab.renderList() end
	if state.mode == "bundles" then return BundlesTab.renderList() end
	local list = ui.list
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local counts = { all = #state.skins, new = 0, changed = 0, problems = 0, review = 0 }
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
		if Review.get(s.model) then counts.review += 1 end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
		local r = state.results[s]
		if r then
			if r.status == "new" then counts.new += 1 end
			if r.status == "changed" then counts.changed += 1 end
			if worst(r) == "bad" then counts.problems += 1 end
		end
	end
	for key, b in pairs(ui.filterButtons) do
		b.Text = ({ all = "All", new = "New", changed = "Changed", problems = "Problems", review = "Review" })[key] .. "  " .. counts[key]
	end

	local order = 0
	local groups, groupOrder = {}, {}
	for _, skin in ipairs(state.skins) do
		if matches(skin) then
			if not groups[skin.slot] then
				groups[skin.slot] = {}
				table.insert(groupOrder, skin.slot)
			end
			table.insert(groups[skin.slot], skin)
		end
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(groupOrder) do
		order += 1
		local collapsed = state.collapsed[slot]
		local head = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), LayoutOrder = order }, {
			T((collapsed and "+  " or "–  ") .. slot:upper(), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0) }),
			T(tostring(#groups[slot]), { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }),
		})
		head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			state.collapsed[slot] = not state.collapsed[slot] or nil
			renderList()
		end)
		head.Parent = list
		if not collapsed then
			for _, skin in ipairs(groups[slot]) do
				order += 1
				local r = state.results[skin]
				local sel = state.selected == skin
				local lvl = r and worst(r) or "info"
				local tier = tierOf(skin, r)
				local row = new("TextButton", {
					Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.bg,
					BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1,
				}, {
					Theme.corner(6),
					new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -4),
						BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl] or col.info, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(4) }),
					T(skin.key, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }),
				})
				local chips = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X },
					{ Theme.hlist(4) })
				local hl = chips:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
				hl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
				if tier and Theme.TIER[tier] then
					Theme.pill(tier:sub(1, 1), Theme.TIER[tier], { LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center }).Parent = chips
				end
				if Review.get(skin.model) then
					Theme.pill("REVIEW", col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = chips
				end
				if skin.kind == "tool" and Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot) == false then
					Theme.pill("NOT ON WEB", col.bad, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = chips
				end
				if r then
					Theme.pill(STATE_LABEL[r.status], STATE_COLOR[r.status], { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = chips
				end
				chips.Parent = row
				row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if state.selected ~= skin then row.BackgroundTransparency = 0 row.BackgroundColor3 = col.hover end end)
				row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if state.selected ~= skin then row.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end end)
				row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					state.selected = skin
					state.showRow = false
					renderList()
					renderDetail()
				end)
				row.Parent = list
			end
		end
	end
	if order == 0 then
		T(state.mode and "No skins match." or (state.area == "tools" and "Tool skins live in the PVP&NPC ASSETS place — open it to work on them."
			or "Ship skins live in the Assets place — open it to work on them."),
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = list
	end
end

-- DETAIL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function thumbnail(model)
	local vf = new("ViewportFrame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 112), BackgroundColor3 = col.raised,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -0.5), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 175) },
		{ Theme.corner(10) })
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local copy = model:Clone()
		for _, d in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Light") then d:Destroy() end
		end
		if copy:IsA("BasePart") then
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			copy.Parent = m
			copy = m
		end
		copy.Parent = vf
		local cf, size = copy:GetBoundingBox()
		local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
		cam.FieldOfView = 30
		local dist = size.Magnitude * 1.9
		-- from the FRONT: a model faces its LookVector (the camera sat on -LookVector, so every
		-- door, board, lantern, wheel and anchor rendered from its back)
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + (cf.LookVector + cf.RightVector * 0.7 + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
		cam.Parent = vf
		vf.CurrentCamera = cam
	end)
	if not ok then T("no preview", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = vf end
	return vf
end

local function checkLine(c, order, skin)
	local mark = ({ ok = "✓", warn = "!", bad = "✕", info = "•" })[c.level]
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = col[c.level] or col.info, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
		BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(10),
		T(mark, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col[c.level] or col.info, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center }) }).Parent = f
	T(c.text, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, c.fix and -230 or -30, 0, 0),
		TextColor3 = c.level == "info" and col.dim or col.text }).Parent = f
	if c.fix then
		local b = Theme.button(c.fix.label, "secondary", function()
			-- RENAME (a skin not in the shop yet): the website row first — its name is the shop key —
			-- then the model here, so the two still match; one is never renamed without the other
			if c.fix.kind == "rename" then
				local to = c.fix.to
				local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
				if web == nil then toast("The website list is not read yet — Refresh, then try again.", "warn") return end
				local msg = ""
				if type(web) == "table" then
					local ok, why = Website.renameAsset(web.id, to)
					if not ok then toast(why, "bad") return end
					msg = why .. " "
				end
				local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsRename", "Rename " .. skin.model.Name .. " to " .. to)
				skin.model.Name = to
				if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
				skin.key = to
				-- a website rename empties the plugin's website cache: read every skin's row again
				local names = {}
				for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do table.insert(names, s.key) end
				Website.fetch(names)
				toast(msg .. (type(web) == "table" and "The model here is renamed too — save the place."
					or ("Renamed here to " .. to .. " (it is not on the website).")), "ok")
				for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
				renderList()
				renderDetail()
				return
			end
			local ok, err = ShipSkins.runFix(c.fix)
			toast(ok and (c.fix.label .. " — done (Ctrl+Z undoes it).") or ("Fix failed: " .. tostring(err)), ok and "ok" or "bad")
			inspectOne(skin)
			renderList()
			renderDetail()
		end, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0, -2), Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 26), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextSize = 12,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })
		b.Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

local function refreshSkin(skin)
	inspectOne(skin)
	renderList()
	renderDetail()
end

-- the skin's theme: its first tag that is not a colour-group or tool tag
local function themeOf(skin)
	if skin.kind == "ship" then return ShipSkins.themeOf(skin) end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(skin.model)) do
		if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" and not t:match("Skin$") then return t end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the body in the skin's theme colours (or back to default)
local function paintBody(skin)
	local theme = themeOf(skin)
	if state.bodyPaint == false or not theme then
		Preview.paint(nil)
		state.paintSource = state.bodyPaint == false and "Default body colours." or "No theme tag, so the body keeps its default colours."
		return
	end
	local palette, source = Preview.paletteFor(theme, ShipSkins.catalogData())
	Preview.paint(palette)
	state.paintSource = palette and ("Body painted with " .. source .. ".")
		or (source or ("No body colours found for " .. theme .. " — no catalogue paint rows and no colour donor in workspace.ship tagged " .. theme .. "."))
end

-- DRAFT: while a skin is previewed, every change to its Assets model shows on the ship at once
-- but stays a draft. Apply keeps it; Revert puts the model back as it was when the preview
-- started; stopping the preview, previewing another skin or closing the panel reverts what was
-- not applied. (A Studio File → Save in between still saves the draft: the edits are real
-- instances — the plugin cannot hold a save back.)
local draftMuted = false -- true while Revert itself rewrites the model

-- what Revert puts back on a skin that is a single MeshPart (a sail) rather than a Model
local PART_PROPS = { "CFrame", "Size", "PivotOffset", "Color", "Transparency", "Material", "TextureID", "DoubleSided" }

local function snapshotOf(model)
	local was = model.Archivable
	model.Archivable = true
	local copy = model:Clone()
	model.Archivable = was
	local snap = { copy = copy, attrs = model:GetAttributes(), tags = CollectionService:GetTags(model) }
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		snap.primary = model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart.Name
		snap.pivot = model.WorldPivot
	else
		-- a sail skin is ONE MeshPart, not a Model: keep the part's own look and place
		local props = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(PART_PROPS) do props[k] = model[k] end
		snap.props = props
	end
	return snap
end

local function restoreModel(model, snap)
	local fresh = snap.copy:Clone()
	-- Parent = nil, not Destroy: a scripted Destroy cannot always be undone (AGENTS.md §10)
	for _, c in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do c.Parent = nil end
	for _, c in ipairs(fresh:GetChildren()) do c.Parent = model end
	fresh:Destroy()
	-- RBX_* attributes (RBX_ReimportId from the importer) belong to Roblox: a plugin may not write
	-- them ("CoreScript permission required"), and the failed write cancelled the whole revert
	for k in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
		if snap.attrs[k] == nil and k:sub(1, 4) ~= "RBX_" then model:SetAttribute(k, nil) end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(snap.attrs) do
		if k:sub(1, 4) ~= "RBX_" then model:SetAttribute(k, v) end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(model)) do
		if not table.find(snap.tags, t) then CollectionService:RemoveTag(model, t) end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(snap.tags) do CollectionService:AddTag(model, t) end
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		model.PrimaryPart = snap.primary and model:FindFirstChild(snap.primary) or nil
		model.WorldPivot = snap.pivot
	elseif snap.props then
		for k, v in pairs(snap.props) do model[k] = v end
	end
end

-- run fn without the live watch counting its model writes as a change (review attributes)
local function draftQuiet(fn)
	draftMuted = true
	local results = table.pack(fn())
	task.defer(function() task.defer(function() draftMuted = false end) end)
	return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end

-- a review request cleared on the model is final: a later Revert must not bring it back
local function draftForgetReview(model)
	local dr = state.draft
	if not (dr and dr.model == model) then return end
	for k in pairs(dr.snap.attrs) do
		if k:sub(1, 10) == "ZAALReview" then dr.snap.attrs[k] = nil end
	end
end

-- DRIFT (2026-10-03, the owner: "write the drift with yellow in its row, so I know I moved X how many
-- studs until I apply it"): what Move / Rotate / Turn / Scale have done to a skin since it was last
-- applied, per model and per Piece choice ("*all" or a piece name). Shown in yellow at the end of each
-- row; gone on Apply, Revert, Confirm and Remove. Move is in the turning frame's axes (studs), Rotate +
-- Turn add up degrees per axis (a readout, not an exact composition), Scale multiplies.
state.drift = {}
local function driftOf(model, piece)
	local byModel = state.drift[model] or {}
	state.drift[model] = byModel
	local d = byModel[piece or "*all"]
	if not d then
		d = { move = Vector3.zero, rot = Vector3.zero, scale = Vector3.one }
		byModel[piece or "*all"] = d
	end
	return d
end
-- a turn shown as where it ENDS: -180..180 (eight 90° turns are back to 0, 270° is -90°;
-- 2026-10-03, the owner: "+720" for a skin that was back where it began)
local function wrapDegrees(n)
	local w = n % 360
	if w > 180 then w -= 360 end
	return math.abs(w) < 1e-6 and 0 or w
end
local function clearDrift(model)
	if model then state.drift[model] = nil end
end

local function draftApply()
	local dr = state.draft
	if dr and dr.dirty then
		dr.snap = snapshotOf(dr.model)
		dr.dirty = false
	end
	if dr then clearDrift(dr.model) end
end

local function draftRevert()
	local dr = state.draft
	if not (dr and dr.dirty and dr.model.Parent) then return false end
	draftMuted = true
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsRevert", "Revert " .. dr.key)
	local ok, err = pcall(restoreModel, dr.model, dr.snap)
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	dr.dirty = not ok -- a failed revert keeps the changes, and the Apply / Revert bar with them
	if ok then clearDrift(dr.model) end
	-- the live watch re-shows on a deferred call queued during the restore: unmute after it
	task.defer(function() task.defer(function() draftMuted = false end) end)
	if not ok then toast("Could not revert " .. dr.key .. ": " .. tostring(err), "bad") end
	return ok
end

-- leaving the draft: what was not applied goes back
local function draftEnd()
	local dr = state.draft
	if dr and dr.dirty and draftRevert() then
		toast("Changes to " .. dr.key .. " were not applied — reverted.", "warn")
	end
	state.draft = nil
end

-- APPLY / REVERT strip: its own highlighted box, green Apply + orange Revert, always the same
-- height (greyed while nothing changed) — a bar that appeared on the first click pushed every
-- button down under a clicking mouse. Used under the ship controls and in Setup.
local function changesStrip(skin, order)
	local dirty = state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model and state.draft.dirty == true
	local tone = dirty and col.warn or col.cardStroke
	local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = dirty and 0.85 or 0.6, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = order, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46) },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(tone, 1), Theme.pad(8, 10, 8, 10), Theme.hlist(8) })
	local applyBtn, applyApi = Theme.button("✓  Apply", "ok", function()
		draftApply()
		toast("Applied the changes to " .. skin.key .. ".", "ok")
		renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 13 })
	applyApi.setEnabled(dirty)
	applyBtn.Parent = box
	local revertBtn, revertApi = Theme.button("↺  Revert", "warn", function()
		if draftRevert() then toast(skin.key .. " is back as it was when the preview started.", "ok") end
		refreshSkin(skin)
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 13 })
	revertApi.setEnabled(dirty)
	revertBtn.Parent = box
	T(dirty and "Not applied yet — shown on the ship only" or "No changes since the preview started",
		{ TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = dirty and col.warn or col.dim, LayoutOrder = 3, TextWrapped = false,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 1, 0) }).Parent = box
	return box
end

-- MOVE / ROTATE / TURN / SCALE a skin's pieces (Piece: All or one), as pivot edits on the Assets
-- model (one undo step a click) — under the ship preview, and in the Import review
local function adjustRows(skin, parent)
	-- PIECE: All, or one piece (a cannon mouth, a door glass) — its pivot alone
	local allPieces, names = {}, {}
	for _, p in ipairs(skin.model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("MeshPart") then table.insert(allPieces, p) table.insert(names, p.Name) end
	end
	if state.adjustPiece and not table.find(names, state.adjustPiece) then state.adjustPiece = nil end
	-- SEVERAL PIECES (2026-10-03, the owner: "move two or three different parts together"): two or
	-- more chosen live in state.adjustPieces (a list of names); one stays state.adjustPiece, which the
	-- anchor / window pickers below also set (and they clear the list)
	if state.adjustPieces then
		local kept = {}
		for _, n in ipairs(state.adjustPieces) do
			if table.find(names, n) then table.insert(kept, n) end
		end
		state.adjustPieces = #kept >= 2 and kept or nil
		if #kept == 1 then state.adjustPiece = kept[1] end
	end
	local function chosen()
		if state.adjustPieces then
			local list = {}
			for _, n in ipairs(state.adjustPieces) do
				local p = skin.model:FindFirstChild(n)
				if p and p:IsA("MeshPart") then table.insert(list, p) end
			end
			if #list > 0 then return list end
		end
		if not state.adjustPiece then return allPieces end
		local one = skin.model:FindFirstChild(state.adjustPiece)
		return (one and one:IsA("MeshPart")) and { one } or allPieces
	end
	-- the drift is kept per choice: "*all", one name, or the chosen names joined
	local function pieceKey()
		if state.adjustPieces then
			local sorted = table.clone(state.adjustPieces)
			table.sort(sorted)
			return table.concat(sorted, "+")
		end
		return state.adjustPiece
	end
	-- the yellow drift readouts (DRIFT, above): filled in as the rows are built, redrawn on every press
	local driftLabels = {}
	local function driftText(kind)
		local d = driftOf(skin.model, pieceKey())
		local parts = {}
		if kind == "move" or kind == "rot" then
			local v = d[kind]
			for _, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
				local n = kind == "rot" and wrapDegrees(v[ax]) or v[ax]
				if math.abs(n) > 1e-6 then
					table.insert(parts, kind == "move" and ("%s %+.2f"):format(ax, n) or ("%s %+g°"):format(ax, math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100))
				end
			end
			return table.concat(parts, "  ")
		end
		-- one figure when every axis grew alike, else per axis (Scale X / Y / Z, 2026-10-03)
		local s = d.scale
		if math.abs(s.X - s.Y) < 1e-6 and math.abs(s.Y - s.Z) < 1e-6 then
			local pct = (s.X - 1) * 100
			return math.abs(pct) > 0.005 and ("%+.1f%%"):format(pct) or ""
		end
		local parts = {}
		for _, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			local pct = (s[ax] - 1) * 100
			if math.abs(pct) > 0.005 then table.insert(parts, ("%s %+.1f%%"):format(ax, pct)) end
		end
		return table.concat(parts, "  ")
	end
	local function refreshDrift()
		for kind, l in pairs(driftLabels) do
			if l.Parent then l.Text = driftText(kind) end
		end
	end
	local function driftLabel(row, kind)
		local l = T("", { TextColor3 = col.warn, FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 99, TextWrapped = false })
		l.Parent = row
		driftLabels[kind] = l
		l.Text = driftText(kind)
	end
	if #allPieces > 1 then
		local opts = { { "*all", "All" } }
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do table.insert(opts, { n, n }) end
		-- wraps onto more lines: a cannon has six pieces, wider than the panel in one row
		local pickRow = Theme.row(8, 5)
		T("Piece", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = pickRow
		-- a click adds or drops a piece (two or three move together, as one body); All = the whole skin
		local function isOn(k)
			if k == "*all" then return state.adjustPiece == nil and state.adjustPieces == nil end
			if state.adjustPieces then return table.find(state.adjustPieces, k) ~= nil end
			return state.adjustPiece == k
		end
		Theme.multiChips(opts, isOn, function(k)
			if k == "*all" then
				state.adjustPiece, state.adjustPieces = nil, nil
			else
				local set = state.adjustPieces and table.clone(state.adjustPieces) or (state.adjustPiece and { state.adjustPiece } or {})
				local at = table.find(set, k)
				if at then table.remove(set, at) else table.insert(set, k) end
				state.adjustPieces = #set >= 2 and set or nil
				state.adjustPiece = #set == 1 and set[1] or nil
			end
			refreshDrift()
			-- SELECTED IN STUDIO TOO (2026-10-03, the owner): the chosen piece(s) — on the preview ship
			-- while it is shown (what the owner looks at and may drag), else the model's own pieces (the
			-- import review mounts those). Inside this skin, so the Explorer watch keeps this skin open.
			local pieces = chosen()
			local onShip = state.previewing == skin and Preview.clones(skin.slot, pieces, state.previewItem or 1) or {}
			Selection:Set(#onShip > 0 and onShip or pieces)
			-- the barrel: look through it the way a gunner does in game
			if skin.slot == "Cannon" and state.adjustPiece == k and Slots.socketFor(Slots.SHIP.Cannon, k) == "Aim" then
				Preview.focusGunner(state.previewItem)
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 0) }).Parent = pickRow
		pickRow.Parent = parent
	end
	-- ONE BODY (2026-10-03, the owner: two 90° turns of a whole cannon pulled its pieces apart — each
	-- piece turned about its OWN socket point, so the barrel on Aim and the carriage on BasePart swung
	-- round different centres). Several pieces now move as one: about the base piece's socket point,
	-- in its axes (the BasePart socket, else the biggest piece). Each piece gets the same world motion
	-- G expressed in its own socket frame F — t' = F⁻¹·G·F — so setPivot (which keeps the socket point)
	-- lands every piece at G·its old pose. One piece alone: G is its own turn, as before.
	local shipDef = Slots.SHIP[skin.slot]
	local function basePiece(list)
		local best, bestV
		for _, p in ipairs(list) do
			if shipDef and Slots.socketFor(shipDef, p.Name) == "BasePart" then return p end
			local v = p.Size.X * p.Size.Y * p.Size.Z
			if not bestV or v > bestV then best, bestV = p, v end
		end
		return best
	end
	local function shift(t, label)
		local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTurn", label .. " " .. skin.key)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local list = chosen()
			local base = basePiece(list)
			if not base then return end
			local centre = base.CFrame * base.PivotOffset
			local G = centre * t * centre:Inverse()
			for _, p in ipairs(list) do
				local F = p.CFrame * p.PivotOffset
				Preview.setPivot(p, p.PivotOffset * (F:Inverse() * G * F):Inverse())
			end
		end)
		if rec then
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
		end
		if not ok then toast("Could not " .. label:lower() .. " it: " .. tostring(err), "bad") end
		return ok
	end
	local function axisRow(label, order, make)
		local r = Theme.row(6, order, 30)
		T(label, { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = r
		for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			Theme.button(ax .. " −", "secondary", function() make(ax, -1) end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2 - 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
			Theme.button(ax .. " +", "secondary", function() make(ax, 1) end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		end
		r.Parent = parent
		return r
	end
	state.moveStep = state.moveStep or 0.05
	state.rotStep = state.rotStep or 5
	local steps = Theme.row(8, 6, 30)
	T("Step", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = steps
	Theme.segmented({ { 0.01, "0.01" }, { 0.05, "0.05" }, { 0.25, "0.25" }, { 1, "1 st" } }, state.moveStep,
		function(v) state.moveStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = steps
	Theme.segmented({ { 1, "1°" }, { 5, "5°" }, { 15, "15°" }, { 90, "90°" } }, state.rotStep,
		function(v) state.rotStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = steps
	steps.Parent = parent
	driftLabel(axisRow("Move", 7, function(ax, s)
		local v = Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * s * state.moveStep
		if shift(CFrame.new(v), "Move") then
			local d = driftOf(skin.model, pieceKey())
			d.move += v
			refreshDrift()
		end
	end), "move")
	driftLabel(axisRow("Rotate", 8, function(ax, s)
		if shift(CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]), math.rad(state.rotStep) * s), "Rotate") then
			local d = driftOf(skin.model, pieceKey())
			d.rot += Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * s * state.rotStep
			refreshDrift()
		end
	end), "rot")
	local turnRow = Theme.row(6, 9, 30)
	-- a quarter turn per press (2026-10-03, the owner: 90° instead of 180°; two presses = the old half turn)
	T("Turn 90°", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = turnRow
	for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
		Theme.button("On " .. ax, "secondary", function()
			if shift(CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]), math.pi / 2), "Turn") then
				local d = driftOf(skin.model, pieceKey())
				d.rot += Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * 90 -- shown in the Rotate row
				refreshDrift()
				toast("Turned " .. skin.key .. " 90° on " .. ax .. " (its pivot, in the Assets model). Ctrl+Z undoes it; twice is a half turn.", "ok")
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = i, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = turnRow
	end
	turnRow.Parent = parent
	-- SCALE every piece about its own pivot (pieces sharing a pivot scale as one)
	state.scaleStep = state.scaleStep or 0.02
	-- SCALE ON ONE AXIS (2026-10-03, the owner: "for door scale, scale only on X or Y"): the axis is the
	-- skin's (the base piece's socket frame, the one Move and Rotate use); each piece scales the one of
	-- its OWN sides that lines up with it (a leaf turned 180°, a glass turned 90° still widen alike).
	-- Preview.scale takes a Vector3 per side.
	state.scaleAxis = state.scaleAxis or "All"
	local function scaleAll(factor)
		local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTurn", "Scale " .. skin.key)
		local axis = state.scaleAxis
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local list = chosen()
			local worldAxis
			if axis ~= "All" then
				local base = basePiece(list)
				local frame = base.CFrame * base.PivotOffset
				worldAxis = ({ X = frame.XVector, Y = frame.YVector, Z = frame.ZVector })[axis]
			end
			for _, p in ipairs(list) do
				if worldAxis then
					local sides = { p.CFrame.XVector, p.CFrame.YVector, p.CFrame.ZVector }
					local best, bestDot = 1, -1
					for i, v in ipairs(sides) do
						local dd = math.abs(v:Dot(worldAxis))
						if dd > bestDot then best, bestDot = i, dd end
					end
					Preview.scale(p, Vector3.new(best == 1 and factor or 1, best == 2 and factor or 1, best == 3 and factor or 1))
				else
					Preview.scale(p, factor)
				end
			end
		end)
		if rec then
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
		end
		if not ok then toast("Could not scale it: " .. tostring(err), "bad") return end
		local d = driftOf(skin.model, pieceKey())
		d.scale *= axis == "All" and Vector3.one * factor or Vector3.new(axis == "X" and factor or 1, axis == "Y" and factor or 1, axis == "Z" and factor or 1)
		refreshDrift()
	end
	local sr = Theme.row(6, 10, 30)
	T("Scale", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.button("Smaller", "secondary", function() scaleAll(1 / (1 + state.scaleStep)) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.button("Bigger", "secondary", function() scaleAll(1 + state.scaleStep) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.segmented({ { 0.01, "1%" }, { 0.02, "2%" }, { 0.05, "5%" }, { 0.1, "10%" } }, state.scaleStep,
		function(v) state.scaleStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.segmented({ { "All", "All" }, { "X", "X" }, { "Y", "Y" }, { "Z", "Z" } }, state.scaleAxis,
		function(v) state.scaleAxis = v end, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = sr
	driftLabel(sr, "scale")
	sr.Parent = parent
end

-- on the ship: mounted on its sockets, or — while any piece has no socket name — the whole model
-- standing loose where the slot's first item is, to be named by eye (Preview.showLoose)
local function mountOnShip(skin, r)
	if #Importer.unnamedPieces(skin.model, skin.slot) > 0 then return Preview.showLoose(skin) end
	return Preview.show(skin, r.plan)
end

-- SHOW a piece (2026-10-03, the owner: Show did not bring the camera): selected and framed — its copy
-- on the ship while it is shown there (mounted or loose), else the piece itself
local function showPart(skin, part)
	local target = state.previewing == skin and Preview.shipPieceOf(skin.slot, part, state.previewItem or 1) or nil
	target = target or part
	Selection:Set({ target })
	Preview.focusPart(target)
end

local function showPreview(skin, r)
	if skin.kind ~= "ship" then return end
	if not (state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model) then
		draftEnd()
		state.draft = { model = skin.model, key = skin.key, snap = snapshotOf(skin.model), dirty = false }
	end
	-- a clean ship: only this skin, defaults in every other slot. Without this, pieces left by
	-- an earlier preview (another theme's set from the Preview tab) stayed on the other slots.
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local ok, why = mountOnShip(skin, r)
	if not ok then
		toast("Preview: " .. tostring(why), "bad")
		return
	end
	paintBody(skin)
	state.previewing = skin
	Preview.watch({ skin.model }, function()
		if state.previewing ~= skin or not skin.model.Parent then return end
		if not draftMuted and state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model then state.draft.dirty = true end
		local nr = inspectOne(skin)
		mountOnShip(skin, nr)
		-- not mid-drag: re-rendering would destroy the colour slider under the mouse
		if state.selected == skin and not Theme.dragging() then renderDetail() end
	end)
end

local function stopPreview()
	draftEnd()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	state.previewing = nil
end

-- TOOL PREVIEW (2026-10-02): a tool skin in a default R15 avatar's hand, mounted by the game's own rule
-- (ToolPreview). Its fit is the skin model's MOUNT ATTRIBUTES — the very values Approve copies
-- into ToolSkins — so the Adjust buttons set those, one undo step a click, and the hand re-mounts.
-- Apply keeps them; Revert puts back what the model had when the preview started.
local TOOL_ATTRS = { "HiltEnd", "SkinPitch", "SkinYaw", "SkinRoll", "SkinOffset", "WaterDiameter", "WaterRim", "WaterOffset" }
local toolDraft = nil -- { skin, before = { [attr] = value } }

-- the one mesh the game mounts (ToolSkinMount.meshOf: the first MeshPart)
local function toolMesh(model)
	return ToolSkinMount.meshOf(model)
end

local function toolAttrs(model)
	local t = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(TOOL_ATTRS) do t[a] = model:GetAttribute(a) end
	local mesh = toolMesh(model)
	t.__size = mesh and mesh.Size -- Scale resizes the mesh: the game holds it at that size
	return t
end

local function toolDirty()
	if not toolDraft then return false end
	local now = toolAttrs(toolDraft.skin.model)
	for _, a in ipairs(TOOL_ATTRS) do
		if now[a] ~= toolDraft.before[a] then return true end
	end
	return now.__size ~= toolDraft.before.__size
end

local function toolSet(model, attr, value)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTool", "Tool fit " .. attr .. " of " .. model.Name)
	model:SetAttribute(attr, value)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
end

local function toolRevert()
	if not toolDraft then return false end
	if not toolDirty() then return false end
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTool", "Revert the fit of " .. toolDraft.skin.key)
	for _, a in ipairs(TOOL_ATTRS) do toolDraft.skin.model:SetAttribute(a, toolDraft.before[a]) end
	local mesh = toolMesh(toolDraft.skin.model)
	if mesh and toolDraft.before.__size then mesh.Size = toolDraft.before.__size end
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
	clearDrift(toolDraft.skin.model)
	return true
end

-- start (or move) the hand preview; unapplied changes to another skin go back first
local function showToolPreview(skin)
	if toolDraft and toolDraft.skin ~= skin and toolRevert() then
		toast("Changes to " .. toolDraft.skin.key .. " were not applied — reverted.", "warn")
	end
	if not (toolDraft and toolDraft.skin == skin) then toolDraft = { skin = skin, before = toolAttrs(skin.model) } end
	local ok, msg = ToolPreview.show(skin)
	toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
	return ok
end

renderDetail = function()
	if state.mode == "body" then return renderBodyDetail() end
	if state.mode == "preview" then return PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
	if state.mode == "import" then return ImportTab.renderDetail() end
	if state.mode == "bundles" then return BundlesTab.renderDetail() end
	local d = ui.detail
	for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local skin = state.selected
	if not skin then
		local empty = Theme.card(nil, 1)
		T("Pick a skin on the left — or select its model in the Explorer.", { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 16, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = empty
		T("Every skin is checked for its type. Preview shows it on the ship exactly where the game puts it; Setup adds a face, light or name text; Tier changes the website and the game price; Approve adds it to the shop Packages.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = empty
		empty.Parent = d
		return
	end
	local r = state.results[skin] or inspectOne(skin)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local tier = tierOf(skin, r)
	local isShip = skin.kind == "ship"

	-- HERO
	local hero = Theme.card(nil, 1)
	local top = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 112), LayoutOrder = 1 })
	thumbnail(skin.model).Parent = top
	local info = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -128, 1, 0) }, { Theme.vlist(6) })
	T(skin.key, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 22, LayoutOrder = 1, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 28) }).Parent = info -- room for the Guide button
	local tags = ShipSkins.themeTags(skin.model)
	local shownTheme = themeOf(skin)
	local themeText = shownTheme and ("  ·  theme " .. shownTheme) or ""
	if isShip and shownTheme and not table.find(tags, shownTheme) then
		themeText ..= #tags > 0 and ("  (tagged " .. table.concat(tags, ", ") .. ")") or "  (no tag)"
	end
	T(skin.slot .. (isShip and "  ·  ship skin" or "  ·  tool skin") .. themeText,
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = info
	local pills = Theme.row(6, 3, 22)
	Theme.pill(STATE_LABEL[r.status], STATE_COLOR[r.status], { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pills
	if tier and Theme.TIER[tier] then Theme.pill(tier:upper(), Theme.TIER[tier], { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = pills end
	if web == false then
		Theme.pill("NOT ON WEBSITE", col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pills
	elseif web then
		Theme.pill(web.status == "approved" and "WEBSITE APPROVED" or ("WEBSITE " .. tostring(web.status):upper()),
			web.status == "approved" and col.ok or col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pills
		if web.exclusive then Theme.pill("EXCLUSIVE", Theme.TIER.Legendary, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pills end
	end
	pills.Parent = info
	local actions = Theme.row(8, 4, 32)
	if isShip then
		Theme.button(state.previewing == skin and "Refresh preview" or "Preview on ship", "secondary", function()
			-- still in its import review: Preview on ship confirms it first (2026-10-03, the owner: the
			-- window stayed stuck on the reference) — back to its grid cell, then the preview
			if skin.model:GetAttribute(Importer.REVIEW_ATTR) then
				if not ImportTab.rows() then ImportTab.load() end
				local ok, msg = Importer.finishReview(skin.model, skin.slot, ImportTab.rows())
				if ok then clearDrift(skin.model) end
				toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
				refreshSkin(skin)
			end
			showPreview(skin, r)
			state.previewItem = 1
			Preview.focus(skin.slot, 1)
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = actions
	end
	if skin.kind == "tool" then
		Theme.button(toolDraft and toolDraft.skin == skin and ToolPreview.exists() and "Refresh preview" or "Preview in hand", "secondary", function()
			showToolPreview(skin)
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = actions
	end
	Theme.button("Select", "ghost", function() Selection:Set({ skin.model }) end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = actions
	local owner = Review.isOwner()
	local pending = Review.get(skin.model)
	local ab, aapi
	if owner then
		local approveText = r.status == "new" and "Approve — add to shop" or (r.status == "changed" and "Approve — update shop"
			or (pending and "Mark reviewed ✓" or "Approved ✓"))
		ab, aapi = Theme.button(approveText, "primary", function()
			if state.busy then toast("Still busy with the last write — wait a moment.", "warn") return end
			state.busy = true
			toast("Writing " .. skin.key .. " into the shop…")
			-- an error must not leave the panel busy for good (2026-10-03: every later Approve did
			-- nothing, silently): caught, reported, and busy always cleared
			local called, ok, msg = pcall(function()
				draftApply() -- approving takes what is on the ship
				if skin.kind == "tool" and toolDraft and toolDraft.skin == skin then toolDraft.before = toolAttrs(skin.model) end
				return module().approve(skin, inspectOne(skin)) -- the checks as they are now

				draftQuiet(function() Review.clear(skin.model) end)

		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })

		ab, aapi = Theme.button(pending and "Sent for review ✓" or (dirty and "Apply & send for review" or "Send for review"), "primary", function()
			local ok = draftQuiet(function() return Review.mark(skin.model, state.reviewNote or "") end)
			-- sending takes the changes shown on the ship (and the review mark) as applied
			if state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model then
				state.draft.dirty = true
				draftApply()
			end
			state.reviewNote = nil
			toast(ok and (skin.key .. " sent to the owner for review.") or "Could not mark it.", ok and "ok" or "bad")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(r.ok and pending == nil)
	end
	ab.Parent = actions
	actions.Parent = info
	info.Parent = top
	-- GUIDE: how a skin of this category is built (names, pivots, its traps), top right
	Theme.button(state.guideOpen and "Guide ✕" or "ⓘ Guide", state.guideOpen and "primary" or "ghost", function()
		state.guideOpen = not state.guideOpen
		renderDetail()
	end, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), TextSize = 12 }).Parent = top
	-- CLOSE, under Guide while a preview runs (2026-10-03, the owner): the ship (or the hand) back to
	-- the defaults — unapplied changes go back, as Stop preview does — the Studio selection cleared
	-- and the skin closed, so the panel is back on "Pick a skin"
	local toolOn = toolDraft ~= nil and toolDraft.skin == skin

	top.Parent = hero
	-- IMPORT REVIEW: a fresh import is checked on its slot's default before it takes its grid cell

		T("IMPORT REVIEW", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.accent, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = box
		T(posed and "On the default (faded). Fix it here — pick a piece, move / turn / scale it; wrong piece names: Setup → Name the pieces — then Confirm."
			or "Imported, not checked yet. Put it on the default to compare it with the stock piece.", { TextColor3 = col.text, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = box
		if posed then

							TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = row

						Theme.chips(opts, Slots.socketFor(def, part.Name), function(sock)

		local rr = Theme.row(8, 20, 32)
		Theme.button(posed and "Back to the default view" or "Check it on the default", posed and "secondary" or "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = Importer.startReview(skin.model, skin.slot)
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "warn")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rr
		local cb = Theme.button("✓  Confirm — put it in its place", "ok", function()
			-- the grid's tiers come from the website: load its list when the Import tab has not yet
			if not ImportTab.rows() then ImportTab.load() end
			local ok, msg = Importer.finishReview(skin.model, skin.slot, ImportTab.rows())
			if ok then clearDrift(skin.model) end
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
		cb.Parent = rr
		-- REMOVE (2026-10-03, the owner): a wrong import out of the place — undoable; the website
		-- keeps it, so Import brings it back
		Theme.button("✕  Remove", "danger", function()
			local ok, msg = Importer.remove(skin.model, skin.slot)
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			if ok then
				clearDrift(skin.model)
				local i = table.find(state.skins, skin)
				if i then table.remove(state.skins, i) end
				state.results[skin] = nil
				if state.selected == skin then state.selected = nil end
				if state.previewing == skin then Preview.clearAll() state.previewing = nil end
				renderList()
				renderDetail()
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = rr
		rr.Parent = box
		box.Parent = hero
	end
	if state.guideOpen then
		local g = Guide.forSkin(skin)
		local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col.raised, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 4,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y },
			{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.pad(10, 12, 10, 12), Theme.vlist(6) })
		T(g.title, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 15, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = box
		local order = 1
		for _, s in ipairs(g.sections) do
			if #s.lines > 0 then
				T(s.heading:upper(), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = order }).Parent = box
				order += 1
				for _, line in ipairs(s.lines) do

					order += 1
				end
			end
		end
		box.Parent = hero
	end
	hero.Parent = d

	-- READINESS
	local bad, warn, notes = {}, 0, {}
	for _, c in ipairs(r.checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then table.insert(bad, c.text) elseif c.level == "warn" then
			warn += 1
			table.insert(notes, c.text)
		end
	end
	local lvl = #bad > 0 and "bad" or (warn > 0 and "warn" or "ok")
	local headline = #bad > 0 and (#bad == 1 and "1 thing to fix before it can go in the shop" or (#bad .. " things to fix before it can go in the shop"))
		or (r.status == "same" and "In the shop and up to date" or (warn > 0 and ("Ready for the shop — " .. warn .. " note" .. (warn > 1 and "s" or "")) or "Ready for the shop"))
	if web == false and #bad == 0 then headline ..= "  ·  hidden until the website sells it" end
	local banner = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl], BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col[lvl], 1), Theme.pad(10, 14, 10, 14), Theme.vlist(4) })
	banner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Transparency = 0.5
	T(headline, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = col[lvl], LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = banner
	for i, b in ipairs(bad) do
		if i <= 3 then T("•  " .. b, { TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 1 + i }).Parent = banner end
	end
	-- the notes too, right here (2026-10-03, the owner: "what is this 1 note below and how can I check
	-- it?" — the Checks card is far down, under In the hand and Website)
	if #bad == 0 then
		for i, n in ipairs(notes) do
			if i <= 3 then T("•  " .. n, { TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 10 + i, TextColor3 = col.text }).Parent = banner end
		end
	end
	if #bad + #notes > 3 then
		T("All of them: the Checks card, further down.", { TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 20 }).Parent = banner
	end
	banner.Parent = d

	-- REVIEW
	if pending or not owner then
		local rc = Theme.card(owner and "Review requested" or "Review", 2.5)
		if pending then
			T(Review.text(pending), { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextColor3 = col.warn, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rc
			Theme.button(owner and "Clear the request" or "Withdraw", "ghost", function()
				draftQuiet(function() Review.clear(skin.model) end)
				draftForgetReview(skin.model)
				refreshSkin(skin)
			end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = rc
		else
			T("Designer mode: adjust, preview and set up freely — the owner approves what goes live. Add a note, then Send for review.",
				{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rc
			local box = Theme.input("Note for the owner (optional) — what changed, what to check", state.reviewNote or "", { LayoutOrder = 2 })
			box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() state.reviewNote = box.Text end)
			box.Parent = rc
		end
		rc.Parent = d
	end

	-- IN THE HAND: the tool skin's fit, set on the model's mount attributes (what Approve copies)
	if skin.kind == "tool" and toolDraft and toolDraft.skin == skin and ToolPreview.exists() then
		local def = Slots.TOOL[skin.slot] or {}
		local m = skin.model
		local hc = Theme.card("In the hand", 3)
		T("Mounted by the game's own rule (the Arena's ToolSkinMount). The buttons set the model's mount attributes — the hand follows at once; Approve takes them to the shop.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = hc
		local order = 1
		local function label(row, text)
			T(text, { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = row
		end
		local function nextRow()
			order += 1
			local row = Theme.row(6, order)
			row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").Wraps = true
			return row
		end
		-- WHO holds it (the place's Standard avatars) and HOW: one keyframe of the tool's own animation
		local avatars = ToolPreview.avatars()
		if #avatars > 1 then
			local ar = nextRow()
			label(ar, "Avatar")
			local opts = {}
			for _, n in ipairs(avatars) do table.insert(opts, { n, n }) end
			Theme.segmented(opts, ToolPreview.avatar() or avatars[1], function(k)
				local ok, msg = ToolPreview.setAvatar(k)
				if not ok then toast(msg, "bad") end
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = ar
			ar.Parent = hc
		end
		local poses = ToolPreview.POSES[skin.slot]
		if poses then
			local pr = nextRow()
			label(pr, "Pose")
			local opts = {}
			for _, row in ipairs(poses) do table.insert(opts, { row[1], row[2] }) end
			Theme.segmented(opts, ToolPreview.pose() or poses[1][1], function(k)
				local ok, msg = ToolPreview.setPose(k)
				if msg then toast(msg, ok and "warn" or "bad") end
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pr
			T("a frame of the game's own animation", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = pr
			pr.Parent = hc
		end
		-- SEE-THROUGH (2026-10-03, the owner: tools work the same as the ship): the tool's own default
		-- art — what the skin replaces, where the game mounts it — faded behind the skin, as the
		-- ship's template; or hidden, as the game hides it
		local str = nextRow()
		label(str, "See-through")
		Theme.segmented({ { "hitbox", "Hitbox" }, { "art", "Default art" }, { "both", "Both" }, { "hidden", "Hidden" } }, ToolPreview.seeThrough, function(k)
			ToolPreview.seeThrough = k
			ToolPreview.refresh()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = str
		str.Parent = hc
		local function allowed(attr)
			return (def.required and def.required[attr]) or (def.optional and def.optional[attr])
		end
		-- the sword's hilt end
		if allowed("HiltEnd") then
			local r = nextRow()
			label(r, "Hilt end")
			Theme.segmented({ { "-Z", "−Z" }, { "+Z", "+Z" } }, m:GetAttribute("HiltEnd") or "-Z", function(k)
				toolSet(m, "HiltEnd", k)
				renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r
			T("which end of the mesh is the grip", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = r
			r.Parent = hc
		end
		-- THE SHIP'S ROWS (2026-10-03, the owner: "the workflow and mechanism should be the same"):
		-- Step, Move, Rotate, Turn 90°, Scale All / X / Y / Z, and the yellow amount moved since the last
		-- Apply at the end of each row (the ship's DRIFT, one per tool model). What they write is what
		-- the game reads: Move = SkinOffset (studs in the hand: +Y up out of the fist, +Z forward);
		-- Rotate / Turn = SkinPitch / Yaw / Roll, composed as real turns about the mount's own axes (the
		-- default art's, as a ship piece turns in its socket) and written back as clean angles, so
		-- presses never pile up error and a full turn reads 0; Scale = the mesh's Size (Approve copies
		-- it, the game holds the mesh at that size — the sword's hilt stays in the fist).
		local cfg = ToolSkinMount.configFor(skin.slot) or {}
		local function driftText(kind)
			local dd = driftOf(m, nil)
			local parts = {}
			if kind == "move" or kind == "rot" then
				for _, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
					local n = kind == "rot" and wrapDegrees(dd.rot[ax]) or dd.move[ax]
					if math.abs(n) > 1e-6 then
						table.insert(parts, kind == "move" and ("%s %+.2f"):format(ax, n) or ("%s %+g°"):format(ax, math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100))
					end
				end
				return table.concat(parts, "  ")
			end
			local s = dd.scale
			if math.abs(s.X - s.Y) < 1e-6 and math.abs(s.Y - s.Z) < 1e-6 then
				local pct = (s.X - 1) * 100
				return math.abs(pct) > 0.005 and ("%+.1f%%"):format(pct) or ""
			end
			for _, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
				local pct = (s[ax] - 1) * 100
				if math.abs(pct) > 0.005 then table.insert(parts, ("%s %+.1f%%"):format(ax, pct)) end
			end
			return table.concat(parts, "  ")
		end
		local function driftLabel(row, kind)
			T(driftText(kind), { TextColor3 = col.warn, FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 99, TextWrapped = false }).Parent = row
		end
		local function axisRow(title, make)
			local r = nextRow()
			label(r, title)
			for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
				Theme.button(ax .. " −", "secondary", function() make(ax, -1) end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2 - 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
				Theme.button(ax .. " +", "secondary", function() make(ax, 1) end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
			end
			r.Parent = hc
			return r
		end
		state.moveStep = state.moveStep or 0.05
		state.rotStep = state.rotStep or 5
		local steps = nextRow()
		label(steps, "Step")
		Theme.segmented({ { 0.01, "0.01" }, { 0.05, "0.05" }, { 0.25, "0.25" }, { 1, "1 st" } }, state.moveStep,
			function(v) state.moveStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = steps
		Theme.segmented({ { 1, "1°" }, { 5, "5°" }, { 15, "15°" }, { 90, "90°" } }, state.rotStep,
			function(v) state.rotStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = steps
		steps.Parent = hc
		driftLabel(axisRow("Move", function(ax, s)
			local v = Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * s * state.moveStep
			local cur = m:GetAttribute("SkinOffset")
			toolSet(m, "SkinOffset", (typeof(cur) == "Vector3" and cur or Vector3.zero) + v)
			local dd = driftOf(m, nil)
			dd.move += v
			renderDetail()
		end), "move")
		-- the turn the game applies now (the model's angles, else the row's default)
		local function currentTurn()
			local p = m:GetAttribute("SkinPitch") or cfg.skinPitch or 0
			local y = m:GetAttribute("SkinYaw") or cfg.skinYaw or 0
			local rr = m:GetAttribute("SkinRoll") or cfg.skinRoll or 0
			return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(p), math.rad(y), math.rad(rr))
		end
		local function clean(a)
			local deg = math.floor(math.deg(a) * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
			if math.abs(deg) < 1e-9 then return 0 end
			return deg == -180 and 180 or deg
		end
		local function turn(ax, degrees)
			local t = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]), math.rad(degrees))
			local rx, ry, rz = (t * currentTurn()):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
			local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTool", "Turn " .. skin.key)
			m:SetAttribute("SkinPitch", clean(rx))
			m:SetAttribute("SkinYaw", clean(ry))
			m:SetAttribute("SkinRoll", clean(rz))
			if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
			local dd = driftOf(m, nil)
			dd.rot += Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * degrees
		end
		driftLabel(axisRow("Rotate", function(ax, s)
			turn(ax, s * state.rotStep)
			renderDetail()
		end), "rot")
		local turnRow = nextRow()
		label(turnRow, "Turn 90°")
		for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			Theme.button("On " .. ax, "secondary", function()
				turn(ax, 90)
				toast("Turned " .. skin.key .. " 90° on " .. ax .. ". Ctrl+Z undoes it; twice is a half turn.", "ok")
				renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = i, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = turnRow
		end
		turnRow.Parent = hc
		-- SCALE the mesh: All, or one axis of the mount (the side of the mesh lying along it, whatever
		-- its turn). Scaling All also scales the bucket's water fit with it.
		state.scaleStep = state.scaleStep or 0.02
		state.scaleAxis = state.scaleAxis or "All"
		local function scaleBy(factor)
			local mesh = toolMesh(m)
			if not mesh then toast("No MeshPart to scale.", "bad") return end
			local axis = state.scaleAxis
			local k = Vector3.one * factor
			if axis ~= "All" then
				local inMesh = currentTurn():VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[axis]))
				local a = Vector3.new(math.abs(inMesh.X), math.abs(inMesh.Y), math.abs(inMesh.Z))
				local best = (a.X >= a.Y and a.X >= a.Z) and 1 or (a.Y >= a.Z and 2 or 3)
				k = Vector3.new(best == 1 and factor or 1, best == 2 and factor or 1, best == 3 and factor or 1)
			end
			local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTool", "Scale " .. skin.key)
			mesh.Size = mesh.Size * k
			if axis == "All" then
				for _, wa in ipairs({ "WaterDiameter", "WaterRim" }) do
					local v = m:GetAttribute(wa)
					if type(v) == "number" then m:SetAttribute(wa, math.floor(v * factor * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000) end
				end
				local wo = m:GetAttribute("WaterOffset")
				if typeof(wo) == "Vector3" then m:SetAttribute("WaterOffset", wo * factor) end
			end
			if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
			local dd = driftOf(m, nil)
			dd.scale *= axis == "All" and Vector3.one * factor
				or Vector3.new(axis == "X" and factor or 1, axis == "Y" and factor or 1, axis == "Z" and factor or 1)
			renderDetail()
		end
		local sr = nextRow()
		label(sr, "Scale")
		Theme.button("Smaller", "secondary", function() scaleBy(1 / (1 + state.scaleStep)) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = sr
		Theme.button("Bigger", "secondary", function() scaleBy(1 + state.scaleStep) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = sr
		Theme.segmented({ { 0.01, "1%" }, { 0.02, "2%" }, { 0.05, "5%" }, { 0.1, "10%" } }, state.scaleStep,
			function(v) state.scaleStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = sr
		Theme.segmented({ { "All", "All" }, { "X", "X" }, { "Y", "Y" }, { "Z", "Z" } }, state.scaleAxis,
			function(v) state.scaleAxis = v end, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = sr
		driftLabel(sr, "scale")
		sr.Parent = hc
		-- offsets (studs) for the bucket's water
		local function vectorRow(attr, title)
			if not allowed(attr) then return end
			local r = nextRow()
			label(r, title)
			local v = m:GetAttribute(attr)
			v = typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v or Vector3.zero
			for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
				for j, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
					Theme.button(ax .. (s < 0 and " −" or " +"), "secondary", function()
						toolSet(m, attr, v + Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * s * state.moveStep)
						renderDetail()
					end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2 + j - 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
				end
			end
			T(string.format("%.2f, %.2f, %.2f", v.X, v.Y, v.Z), { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 9 }).Parent = r
			r.Parent = hc
		end
		-- the bucket's water
		for _, attr in ipairs({ "WaterDiameter", "WaterRim" }) do
			if allowed(attr) then
				local r = nextRow()
				label(r, attr == "WaterDiameter" and "Water width" or "Water rim")
				local v = tonumber(m:GetAttribute(attr)) or 0
				Theme.button("−", "secondary", function() toolSet(m, attr, math.max(0, v - state.moveStep)) renderDetail() end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r
				Theme.button("+", "secondary", function() toolSet(m, attr, v + state.moveStep) renderDetail() end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = r
				T(string.format("%.2f", v), { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = r
				r.Parent = hc
			end
		end
		vectorRow("WaterOffset", "Water offset")
		-- view + close
		local vr = nextRow()
		Theme.button("Look at it", "ghost", function() ToolPreview.focus() end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = vr
		Theme.button("Stop preview", "ghost", function()
			if toolRevert() then toast("Unapplied changes to " .. skin.key .. " went back.", "warn") end
			clearDrift(m)
			toolDraft = nil
			ToolPreview.clear()
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = vr
		vr.Parent = hc
		-- APPLY / REVERT, the ship strip's look
		local dirty = toolDirty()

-- BODY COLOURS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One row per theme (a skin theme tag, a catalogue set, or a colour ship's tag). The editor
-- tunes the six paint groups with sliders / RGB / swatches, repaints the preview ship live,
-- creates or updates the theme's colour ship in workspace.ship, and Approve writes the
-- theme's BODY_COLORS entry into SkinCatalog.

state.drafts = {} -- [theme] = { [group] = Color3 } being edited
state.bodyGroup = "Hull"

local function bodyThemes()
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local set = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		local t = ShipSkins.themeOf(s)
		if t then set[t] = true end
	end
	for k in pairs(cat and cat.BodyPackage or {}) do
		if k ~= "Default" then set[k] = true end
	end
	local folder = Paint.donorFolder()
	for _, m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
		for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(m)) do
			if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" then set[t] = true end
		end
	end
	local list = {}
	for t in pairs(set) do table.insert(list, { kind = "body", key = t, slot = "Body" }) end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
	return list
end

-- what the shop and the colour ship hold for a theme right now
local function bodySources(theme)
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local shop = Paint.fromCatalog(cat, theme)
	local donor = Paint.findDonor(theme)
	local donorPalette = donor and Paint.read(donor) or nil
	return shop, donor, donorPalette, Paint.isStyle(cat, theme)
end

-- what the theme HAS (APPLIED, 2026-10-02): its colour ship — where Apply writes — else the
-- shop's set, else the default; per group, so a colour ship without a mast takes the mast from
-- the shop / default. Revert goes back to this; Approve sends it to the shop.
local function baselineFor(theme)
	local shop, _, donorPalette = bodySources(theme)
	local base = Paint.defaults(ShipSkins.catalogData())
	local d = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do d[g] = (donorPalette and donorPalette[g]) or (shop and shop[g]) end
	-- the shop's own fallbacks (SkinCatalog's BODY_COLORS loop): steps follow the mast, stairs the hull
	d.MastSteps = d.MastSteps or d.Mast
	d.Stairs = d.Stairs or d.Hull
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do d[g] = d[g] or base[g] end
	return d
end

-- the colours being tuned (kept per theme while the plugin is open)
local function draftFor(theme)
	if not state.drafts[theme] then state.drafts[theme] = baselineFor(theme) end
	return state.drafts[theme]
end

-- APPLY: the draft onto the theme's colour ship (made when it has none) and the grid's Body row,
-- one undo step; a designer's Apply also sends it to the owner for review — answers ok, message
local function bodyApply(theme, draft)
	local _, donor = bodySources(theme)
	local ship = donor
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsColourShip", "Apply colours of " .. theme)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if ship then
			Paint.apply(ship, draft)
		else
			local made, why = Paint.createDonor(theme, draft)
			if not made then error(why) end
			ship = made
		end
		Paint.stamp(ship, draft) -- the groups the ship has no parts for (Stairs, Mast steps) are kept here
		Importer.redressBodies() -- the grid's display copies / masts follow; a new ship replaces its display one
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Could not apply: " .. tostring(err) end
	if not Review.isOwner() then
		Review.mark(ship, "body colours for " .. theme)
		return true, theme .. " colours applied on workspace.ship." .. ship.Name .. " and sent to the owner for review."
	end
	return true, theme .. " colours applied on workspace.ship." .. ship.Name .. (donor and "" or " (new)") .. " — Approve puts them in the shop. Save the place."
end

local pendingPaint = false
local function repaintLive(theme)
	if state.bodyPreview ~= theme or pendingPaint then return end
	pendingPaint = true
	task.defer(function()
		pendingPaint = false
		if state.bodyPreview == theme and Preview.exists() then Preview.paint(draftFor(theme)) end
	end)
end

local function previewTheme(theme)
	-- start clean, like the Whole theme button: a slot this theme has no skin for shows the
	-- ship's default, not the last theme's leftover (JollyRoger wore DiscoOcto's door)
	draftEnd()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local n = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			local r = ShipSkins.inspect(s, Website.get(s.key, s.slot) or nil)
			if r.plan and Preview.show(s, r.plan) then n += 1 end
		end
	end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	-- a texture-style body has no colour draft: show the style itself
	Preview.paint(Paint.isStyle(cat, theme) and (Preview.paletteFor(theme, cat)) or draftFor(theme))
	state.bodyPreview = theme
	state.previewing = nil
	Preview.focusShip()
	return n
end
