				local row = cat and cat.BodyPackage and cat.BodyPackage[theme]
				task.spawn(function()
					local okP, said = Website.ensureBodyProduct(theme, row and row.tier, { Hull = draft.Hull, Rim = draft.Rim })
					toast(said, okP and "ok" or "warn")
				end)
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(not styled and not dirty and (not matchesShop or bodyPending ~= nil))
		ab.Parent = actions
	elseif bodyPending then
		Theme.pill("SENT FOR REVIEW", col.accent, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pills
	end
	actions.Parent = hero
	hero.Parent = d

	-- STATUS
	local lvl, head = "info", ""
	if styled then
		lvl, head = "warn", theme .. " is a texture style (per-part textures) — its body is not a colour set, so it is not edited here."
	elseif dirty then
		lvl, head = "warn", "Changed, not applied — Apply puts them on the colour ship" .. (Review.isOwner() and "" or " and sends them for review") .. "; Revert takes them back."
	elseif shop and matchesShop then
		lvl, head = "ok", "These colours are in the shop."
	elseif not Review.isOwner() then
		lvl, head = "info", bodyPending and "Applied and sent — the owner checks them and puts them in the shop." or "Tune the colours, then Apply — it sends them to the owner for review."
	elseif shop then
		lvl, head = "warn", "Applied on the colour ship — Approve to update the shop (then Publish SkinCatalog)."
	else
		lvl, head = "info", "Not in the shop yet. Tune, Apply, then Approve. Approve puts it on sale for gold once SkinCatalog is published, and makes the whole set's Robux product on the website."
	end
	local banner = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl], BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col[lvl], 1), Theme.pad(10, 14, 10, 14), Theme.vlist(4) })
	banner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Transparency = 0.5
	T(head, { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextColor3 = col[lvl] == col.info and col.text or col[lvl], LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = banner
	banner.Parent = d
	if styled then return end

	-- EDITOR
	local ed = Theme.card("Colours", 3)
	local rows = {}
	local sliders = {}
	local function paintChip(g)
		local c = draft[g]
		if chips[g] then chips[g].BackgroundColor3 = c end
		if rows[g] then
			rows[g].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
			if not rows[g].box:IsFocused() then rows[g].box.Text = Theme.rgb(c) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(c) end
		end
	end
	local function syncSliders()
		local c = draft[state.bodyGroup]
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		if sliders.h then
			sliders.h.set(h)
			sliders.s.set(s)
			sliders.v.set(v)
			sliders.s.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(h, 0, v), Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, math.max(v, 0.05)))
			sliders.v.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 1))
		end
	end
	-- UNDO: the draft is not an instance, so Studio's Ctrl+Z never sees it. Each change keeps
	-- the colour it replaced; a slider drag (changes to one part less than a second apart) is
	-- ONE step. Apply and Revert start the history afresh.
	state.bodyHistory = state.bodyHistory or {}
	local hist = state.bodyHistory[theme] or {}
	state.bodyHistory[theme] = hist
	local refreshUndo = function() end -- set once the Undo button exists
	local function setColor(g, c, noHistory)
		if draft[g] == c then return end
		if not noHistory then
			local top = hist[#hist]
			if top and top.g == g and os.clock() - top.t < 1 then
				top.t = os.clock() -- the same drag: keep the colour from before it began
			else
				table.insert(hist, { g = g, c = draft[g], t = os.clock() })
				if #hist > 100 then table.remove(hist, 1) end
			end
		end
		draft[g] = c
		paintChip(g)
		if g == state.bodyGroup then syncSliders() end
		repaintLive(theme)
		refreshUndo()
	end
	-- the colour a part has APPLIED (on the colour ship, else the shop's, else default)
	local function savedColor(part) return applied[part] end
	for i, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local sel = g == state.bodyGroup
		local row = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.card, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 },
			{ Theme.corner(6) })
		local sw = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = draft[g], BorderSizePixel = 0 },
			{ Theme.corner(6), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) })
		sw.Parent = row
		T(Paint.LABEL[g], { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }).Parent = row
		local box = Theme.input("r, g, b  or  #hex", Theme.rgb(draft[g]) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(draft[g]),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0.5, -14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 28), FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 13 })
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local c = Theme.parseColor(box.Text:match("#%x+") or box.Text:gsub("%s+#%x+$", ""))
			if c then setColor(g, c) else box.Text = Theme.rgb(draft[g]) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(draft[g]) end
		end)
		box.Parent = row
		row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			state.bodyGroup = g
			renderBodyDetail()
		end)
		rows[g] = { swatch = sw, box = box }
		row.Parent = ed
	end
	-- sliders for the selected group
	local g = state.bodyGroup
	T("Tuning " .. Paint.LABEL[g], { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 10 }).Parent = ed
	local h0, s0, v0 = draft[g]:ToHSV()
	local hueKeys = {}
	for i = 0, 6 do table.insert(hueKeys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(i / 6 % 1, 1, 1))) end
	local cur = { h = h0, s = s0, v = v0 }
	local function fromSliders()
		setColor(g, Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, cur.v))
	end
	local hf, hset = Theme.slider("Hue", h0, ColorSequence.new(hueKeys), function(x) cur.h = x fromSliders() end, 11)
	local sf, sset, sgrad = Theme.slider("Saturation", s0, ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), function(x) cur.s = x fromSliders() end, 12)
	local vf, vset, vgrad = Theme.slider("Brightness", v0, ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), function(x) cur.v = x fromSliders() end, 13)
	sliders.h = { set = hset }
	sliders.s = { set = sset, grad = sgrad }
	sliders.v = { set = vset, grad = vgrad }
	hf.Parent, sf.Parent, vf.Parent = ed, ed, ed
	syncSliders()
	Theme.swatches(Theme.SWATCHES, draft[g], function(c)
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		cur.h, cur.s, cur.v = h, s, v
		setColor(g, c)
	end, 14).Parent = ed
	local quick = Theme.row(8, 15, 30)
	Theme.button("Stairs = Hull", "ghost", function() setColor("Stairs", draft.Hull) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	Theme.button("Mast steps = Mast", "ghost", function() setColor("MastSteps", draft.Mast) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	quick.Parent = ed
	local undoRow = Theme.row(8, 16, 30)
	local undoB, undoApi = Theme.button(#hist > 0 and ("Undo  (" .. #hist .. ")") or "Undo", "secondary", function()
		local top = table.remove(hist)
		if not top then return end
		if top.all then
			state.drafts[theme] = top.all
		else
			state.bodyGroup = top.g
			setColor(top.g, top.c, true)
		end
		repaintLive(theme)
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 })
	undoApi.setEnabled(#hist > 0)
	undoB.Parent = undoRow
	local saved = savedColor(g)
	local putB, putApi = Theme.button("Put back " .. Paint.LABEL[g], "ghost", function()
		setColor(g, saved)
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 })
	putApi.setEnabled(saved ~= nil and draft[g] ~= saved)
	putB.Parent = undoRow
	undoRow.Parent = ed
	-- APPLY / REVERT (the skins' strip): Apply puts the colours on the colour ship (a designer's
	-- also goes to the owner for review); Revert takes the draft back to what is applied
	local box = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 17, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46) },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke, 1), Theme.pad(8, 10, 8, 10), Theme.hlist(8) })
	local applyB, applyApi = Theme.button(Review.isOwner() and "✓  Apply" or "✓  Apply & send for review", "ok", function()
		local ok, msg = bodyApply(theme, draft)
		if ok then table.clear(hist) end
		toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
		renderBodyList()
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 13 })
	applyB.Parent = box
	local revertB, revertApi = Theme.button("↺  Revert", "warn", function()
		state.drafts[theme] = baselineFor(theme)
		table.clear(hist)
		repaintLive(theme)
		toast(theme .. " is back to its applied colours.", "ok")
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 13 })
	revertB.Parent = box
	local note = T("", { TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 3, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 1, 0) })
	note.Parent = box
	local function paintStrip()
		local changed = not Paint.same(applied, draft)
		local tone = changed and col.warn or col.cardStroke
		box.BackgroundColor3 = tone
		box.BackgroundTransparency = changed and 0.85 or 0.6
		box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Color = tone
		applyApi.setEnabled(changed or (not donor and not styled))
		revertApi.setEnabled(changed)
		note.Text = changed and "Not applied yet — shown on the preview ship only"
			or (donor and "Applied — the colour ship has these colours" or "No colour ship yet — Apply makes one")
		note.TextColor3 = changed and col.warn or col.dim
	end
	paintStrip()
	box.Parent = ed
	refreshUndo = function()
		undoB.Text = #hist > 0 and ("Undo  (" .. #hist .. ")") or "Undo"
		undoApi.setEnabled(#hist > 0)
		putApi.setEnabled(saved ~= nil and draft[g] ~= saved)
		paintStrip()
	end
	ed.Parent = d

	-- THE THEME'S SKINS
	local sk = Theme.card("Skins in this theme", 4)
	local n = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			n += 1
			local b = Theme.button(s.slot .. "  ·  " .. s.key, "ghost", function()
				state.mode = "ship"
				App.selectKey = s.key
				refresh(true)
			end, { LayoutOrder = n, TextSize = 13 })
			b.Parent = sk
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then T("No skin models tagged " .. theme .. ".", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = sk end
	sk.Parent = d
end

-- REFRESH -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function refresh(fetchWeb)
	if not state.mode then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast(state.area == "tools" and "No tool skins here — open the PVP&NPC ASSETS place." or "No ship skins here — open the Assets place.", "warn")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "ship" or state.mode == "body" or state.mode == "preview" then ShipSkins.catalogData(true) end
	if state.mode == "preview" then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast("Pick a theme to dress the ship with its whole set.")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "bundles" then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast("Bundles: group tool skins; Tidy stands each bundle together in its own row.")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "import" then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		task.spawn(function()
			ImportTab.load()
			if state.mode == "import" then
				renderList()
				renderDetail()
			end
		end)
		toast("Reading the website's merch…")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "body" then
		state.skins = bodyThemes()
		if state.selected and not table.find(state.skins, state.selected) then state.selected = nil end
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast(string.format("%d themes. Pick one to tune its body colours.", #state.skins))
		return
	end
	state.skins = module().scan()
	table.clear(state.results)
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
	if state.selected and not table.find(state.skins, state.selected) then state.selected = nil end
	if App.selectKey then -- a jump from another tab ("Skins in this theme")
		for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
			if s.key == App.selectKey then state.selected = s end
		end
		App.selectKey = nil
	end
	renderList()
	renderDetail()
	toast(string.format("Checked %d skins.", #state.skins))
	if fetchWeb then
		task.spawn(function()
			if not Website.ownerToken() then
				ui.webError = nil
				App.paintWebPill()
				return
			end
			toast("Asking the website about " .. #state.skins .. " skins…")
			local names = {}
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do table.insert(names, s.key) end
			local ok, err = Website.fetch(names)
			ui.webError = (not ok) and err or nil
			App.paintWebPill(ok)
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
			renderList()
			renderDetail()
			toast(ok and string.format("%d skins checked against the catalogue and the website.", #state.skins) or err, ok and "ok" or "warn")
		end)
	end
end

function App.paintWebPill(ok)
	if ui.rolePill then
		ui.rolePill.Text = Review.isOwner() and "OWNER" or "DESIGNER"
		ui.rolePill.TextColor3 = Review.isOwner() and col.ok or col.accent
		ui.rolePill.BackgroundColor3 = ui.rolePill.TextColor3
	end
	if not ui.webPill then return end
	state.webOk = ok
	local text
	if not Website.token() then
		text = "Add website token"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.warn
	elseif not Website.isOwnerToken() then
		text = "Designer token — Import"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.accent
	elseif ok == false then
		text = "Website unreachable"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.bad
	else
		text = "Website connected"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.ok
	end
	-- a narrow dock shows only the dot (fitHeader); the words stay a click away in Settings
	ui.webPill.Text = state.compactHeader and "●" or ("●  " .. text)
end

local function buildSettings(root)
	local s = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, Visible = false, ZIndex = 20, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	local inner = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 20 }, { Theme.pad(24), Theme.vlist(12) })
	local card = Theme.card(nil, 1, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) })
	T("Settings", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 20, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
	T("Website token — OWNER: your agent token (team.zaalstudio.com → Dashboard → Agent token). DESIGNER: your own Blender token (Dashboard → Your Blender token); it opens Import once the owner ticks Import into Studio for you. Kept in this plugin's settings on this computer only; never in a place or the repo — never share the owner's agent token.",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
	ui.tokenBox = Theme.input("zaal_agent_…", "", { LayoutOrder = 3, FontFace = Theme.fontMono })
	ui.tokenBox.Parent = card
	T("Website address", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = card
	ui.urlBox = Theme.input("https://team.zaalstudio.com", "", { LayoutOrder = 5, FontFace = Theme.fontMono })
	ui.urlBox.Parent = card
	local row = Theme.row(8, 6, 32)
	Theme.button("Save", "primary", function()
		if ui.tokenBox.Text ~= "" then Website.setToken(ui.tokenBox.Text) end
		Website.setUrl(ui.urlBox.Text)
		s.Visible = false
		refresh(true)
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = row
	Theme.button("Forget token", "secondary", function()
		Website.setToken(nil)
		ui.tokenBox.PlaceholderText = "zaal_agent_…"
		App.paintWebPill()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = row
	Theme.button("Close", "ghost", function() s.Visible = false end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = row
	row.Parent = card
	local pv = Theme.row(8, 7, 32)
	Theme.button("Remove preview ship", "ghost", function()
		stopPreview()
		Preview.destroy()
		toast("Preview ship removed.", "ok")
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pv
	pv.Parent = card
	-- CONVERT TO IDS (2026-10-03, owner): the one-time switch of THIS place's skin catalogue from
	-- names to their developer product ids (Convert). First click reads the website and says what it would do;
	-- the second does it. Run in every place holding a catalogue copy.
	local cv = Theme.row(8, 8, 32)
	local convertPlan
	local cb
	cb = Theme.button("Convert catalogue to ids…", "secondary", function()
		if not Website.ownerToken() then toast("Converting needs the owner's agent token (above).", "warn") return end
		-- a plan older than two minutes is read again: the place may have changed since
		if convertPlan and os.clock() - (convertPlan.plannedAt or 0) > 120 then
			convertPlan = nil
			cb.Text = "Convert catalogue to ids…"
		end
		if not convertPlan then
			toast("Reading the website…")
			local plan, why = Convert.plan()
			if not plan then toast(why, "bad") return end
			convertPlan = plan
			local n = #plan.tools + #plan.ships
			cb.Text = (n > 0 or plan.buildTools) and ("Convert " .. n .. " now") or "Nothing to convert"
			toast(("%s%d tool + %d ship skins would move to their developer product ids; %d have no product yet and keep their names%s."):format(
				-- (the old ToolSkins folder becomes ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkinData rows first, 2026-10-03)
				plan.buildTools and "ToolSkinData will be built from the old ToolSkins folder. " or "",
				#plan.tools, #plan.ships, #plan.unmatched,
				#plan.clash > 0 and (" — " .. #plan.clash .. " skipped as duplicates: " .. table.concat(plan.clash, ", ")) or ""), "warn")
			if #plan.unmatched > 0 then print("[ZAAL Assets] no website item (keep their names): " .. table.concat(plan.unmatched, ", ")) end
			if plan.buildTools and #plan.leftOut > 0 then print("[ZAAL Assets] left out of ToolSkinData: " .. table.concat(plan.leftOut, ", ")) end
			if n == 0 and not plan.buildTools then convertPlan = nil end
			return
		end
		local ok, msg = Convert.run(convertPlan)
		convertPlan = nil
		cb.Text = "Convert catalogue to ids…"
		toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
		-- every skin re-read against the converted catalogue (no stale "key → id" diffs)
		ShipSkins.catalogData(true)
		refresh(false)
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 })
	cb.Parent = cv
	T("one-time: skins keyed by their developer product id", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = cv
	cv.Parent = card
	card.Parent = inner
	inner.Parent = s
	for _, dsc in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
		if dsc:IsA("GuiObject") then dsc.ZIndex = 21 end
	end
	s.Parent = root
	return s
end

local function openSettings()
	ui.settings.Visible = true
	ui.tokenBox.Text = ""
	ui.tokenBox.PlaceholderText = Website.token() and "A token is saved — paste a new one to replace it" or "zaal_agent_… (owner)  or  your Blender token (designer)"
	ui.urlBox.Text = Website.url()
end

local AREAS = {
	ship = { chip = "⛵ Ship", title = "Ship", text = "Wheels, lanterns, cannons, sails, boards… and the body colours.",
		place = "the Assets place", available = function() return ShipSkins.available() end },

		place = "the PVP&NPC ASSETS place", available = function() return ToolSkins.available() end },

}
local AREA_ORDER = { "ship", "tools", "clothes" }

function App.mount(widget, plugin, info)
	pluginRef = plugin
	local root = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	Theme.bindDragHost(root) -- slider drags follow the mouse anywhere over the panel
	PreviewTab.init({
		ui = ui,
		toast = function(...) toast(...) end,
		themes = function() return bodyThemes() end,
		query = function() return state.query end,
		active = function() return state.mode == "preview" end,
		-- a set row's skin name opens that skin in the Ship skins tab, to edit it
		openSkin = function(key)
			PreviewTab.leave()
			App.show("ship", key)
		end,
	})
	BundlesTab.init({
		ui = ui,
		toast = function(...) toast(...) end,
		query = function() return state.query end,
		openTool = function(key) App.show("tool", key) end,
		rows = function() return ImportTab.rows() end,
		loadRows = function() ImportTab.load() end,
	})
	ImportTab.init({
		ui = ui,
		toast = function(...) toast(...) end,
		query = function() return state.query end,
		active = function() return state.mode == "import" end,
		openSkin = function(key) App.show("ship", key) end,
		openTool = function(key) App.show("tool", key) end,
		area = function() return state.area end,
		-- a fresh tool import: open it in Tool skins, in the avatar's hand (its fit is checked there)
		reviewTool = function(key)
			ToolPreview.seeThrough = "both" -- a fresh import: its hitbox and the default art, as the ship shows its template
			App.show("tool", key)
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
				if s.key == key and s.kind == "tool" then
					state.selected = s
					showToolPreview(s)
					renderList()
					renderDetail()
					return
				end
			end
		end,
		-- a fresh import: onto its slot's default, camera there, its review open in Ship skins
		review = function(key, slot)
			local def = slot and Slots.SHIP[slot]
			local folder = def and workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
			local m = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(key)
			if not m then return end
			-- SIMPLER IMPORT (2026-10-03, the owner: "mount it on the socket and open the item card;
			-- we modify it there and apply; the socket template a little transparent"): the pivots are
			-- still set up from the slot's sockets (startReview's line-up — a file's own pivots sit at
			-- mesh centres), the skin goes straight to its grid cell (finishReview), and its card opens
			-- previewing ON THE SHIP with the replaced defaults see-through. No template review.
			local ok, msg = Importer.startReview(m, slot)
			-- pieces nobody could name (a .glb's "tripo_node_…"): no line-up, but it still goes to its
			-- cell and opens on the ship, loose at the socket, to be named in Setup → Pieces
			local needsNames = #Importer.unnamedPieces(m, slot) > 0
			if ok or needsNames then ok, msg = Importer.finishReview(m, slot, ImportTab.rows()) end
			App.show("ship", key)
			if ok then
				for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
					if s.key == key and s.kind == "ship" then
						state.selected = s
						Preview.seeThrough = "template"
						showPreview(s, inspectOne(s))
						state.previewItem = 1
						Preview.focus(s.slot, 1)
						renderList()
						renderDetail()
						msg = needsNames
							and (key .. " is on the ship, loose — its pieces need names: Setup → Pieces (Show flies the camera to each).")
							or (key .. " is on the ship (the template see-through) — adjust it here, then Apply.")
						break
					end
				end
			end
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "warn")
		end,
	})

	-- top bar
	local top = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 },
		{ Theme.pad(10, 12, 10, 14) })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = col.cardStroke, BorderSizePixel = 0 }).Parent = root
	local left = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0) }, { Theme.hlist(12) })
	new("ImageLabel", { Image = LOGO, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), LayoutOrder = 0,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit }).Parent = left
	ui.title = T("ZAAL Assets", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 18, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 1 })
	ui.title.Parent = left
	ui.rolePill = Theme.pill(Review.isOwner() and "OWNER" or "DESIGNER", Review.isOwner() and col.ok or col.accent, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
	ui.rolePill.Parent = left
	-- VERSION (2026-10-03, the owner: "so my designer knows if their plugin updated or not"): the
	-- running release in the top bar, checked ONCE against the release repo's version.json —
	-- green "v101 ✓" = the newest, amber "v101 → v103 · restart Studio" = a newer one is out, grey =
	-- could not check (offline). Compared by NUMBER, so the CDN copy (up to ~5 min behind) can never
	-- claim a newer one. The first open after an update says so once (plugin setting, no dot).
	local running = info and info.version
	local runningNo = running and tonumber(running:match("^v(%d+)"))
	ui.versionPill = Theme.pill(runningNo and ("v" .. runningNo) or "dev", col.dim, { LayoutOrder = 4 })
	ui.versionPill.Parent = left
	if runningNo then
		local seen = plugin:GetSetting("ZAALAssets_LastVersion")
		if seen ~= running then
			plugin:SetSetting("ZAALAssets_LastVersion", running)
			if seen ~= nil then task.delay(1, function() toast("ZAAL Assets updated to " .. running .. ".", "ok") end) end
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, res = pcall(game:GetService("HttpService").RequestAsync, game:GetService("HttpService"), {
				Url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZAAL-STUDIO/ZAAL-Assets-Plugin-Release/main/version.json", Method = "GET" })
			local latest = ok and res.Success and (function()
				local okJ, data = pcall(game:GetService("HttpService").JSONDecode, game:GetService("HttpService"), res.Body)
				return okJ and type(data) == "table" and type(data.version) == "string" and tonumber(data.version:match("^v(%d+)")) or nil
			end)() or nil
			if not ui.versionPill.Parent then return end
			if not latest then
				ui.versionPill.Text = "v" .. runningNo .. " · could not check"
			elseif latest > runningNo then
				ui.versionPill.Text = ("v%d → v%d · restart Studio"):format(runningNo, latest)
				ui.versionPill.TextColor3, ui.versionPill.BackgroundColor3 = col.warn, col.warn
				toast(("A newer ZAAL Assets (v%d) is out — restart Studio to get it."):format(latest), "warn")
			else
				ui.versionPill.Text = "v" .. runningNo .. " ✓"
				ui.versionPill.TextColor3, ui.versionPill.BackgroundColor3 = col.ok, col.ok
			end
		end)
	end
	-- AREAS (2026-10-02, the owner: "the plugin at start should ask us which part do we want, ship,
	-- tools, clothes"): the start screen picks one; the top bar then shows that area's tabs and an
	-- area chip that brings the start screen back. The last pick is remembered (per machine).
	local modeHolder, mounted = nil, false
	local function modesFor(area)
		local m = {}
		if area == "ship" and ShipSkins.available() then
			table.insert(m, { "ship", "Ship skins" })
			table.insert(m, { "preview", "Preview" })
			table.insert(m, { "body", "Body colours" })
			table.insert(m, { "import", "Import" })
		elseif area == "tools" and ToolSkins.available() then
			table.insert(m, { "tool", "Tool skins" })
			table.insert(m, { "bundles", "Bundles" }) -- 2026-10-03: tool skins grouped (BundlesTab)
			table.insert(m, { "import", "Import" })
		end
		return m
	end
	local function setArea(area)
		if state.mode == "preview" then PreviewTab.leave() end
		if area ~= "tools" then
			if toolRevert() then toast("Unapplied tool fit went back.", "warn") end
			toolDraft = nil
			ToolPreview.clear()
		end
		state.area = area
		ImportTab.reset()
		BundlesTab.reset()
		if pluginRef then pcall(function() pluginRef:SetSetting(AREA_KEY, area) end) end
		if modeHolder then modeHolder:Destroy() end
		local modes = modesFor(area)
		state.mode = modes[1] and modes[1][1] or nil
		state.selected = nil
		ui.paintMode = nil
		modeHolder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			LayoutOrder = 2 }, { Theme.hlist(6) })
		local area1 = AREAS[area]
		Theme.button((area1 and area1.chip or area) .. "  ▾", "ghost", function() App.showStart() end,
			{ LayoutOrder = 0, TextSize = 13 }).Parent = modeHolder
		if #modes > 1 then
			local seg, paintSeg = Theme.segmented(modes, state.mode, function(k)
				if state.mode == "preview" and k ~= "preview" then PreviewTab.leave() end
				state.mode = k
				state.selected = nil
				refresh(k ~= "body")
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 })
			seg.Parent = modeHolder
			ui.paintMode = paintSeg
		elseif #modes == 1 then
			Theme.pill(string.upper(modes[1][2]), col.accent, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = modeHolder
		end
		modeHolder.Parent = left
		if mounted then refresh(true) end
	end
	-- which slots' imports turn half round by themselves (Importer.turnSlots), kept per Studio
	local turns = pluginRef and pluginRef:GetSetting(Importer.TURN_KEY)
	if type(turns) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(turns) do Importer.turnSlots[k] = v == true end
	end
	Importer.onTurnSlots = function(t)
		if pluginRef then pcall(function() pluginRef:SetSetting(Importer.TURN_KEY, t) end) end
	end
	local saved = pluginRef and pluginRef:GetSetting(AREA_KEY)
	state.area = (saved == "ship" or saved == "tools") and saved
		or (ShipSkins.available() and "ship" or (ToolSkins.available() and "tools" or "ship"))
	setArea(state.area)
	left.Parent = top
	local right = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0) }, { Theme.hlist(8) })
	right:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	-- TIME OF DAY for every tab: judge a skin (and a lantern's light) by day and by night. Studio's own
	-- time comes back on "Studio", when the panel closes and when the plugin unloads (a save never keeps the night)
	local lightSeg, paintLight = Theme.segmented({ { "studio", "Studio" }, { "day", "Day" }, { "sunset", "Sunset" }, { "night", "Night" } },
		Preview.lightMode or "studio", function(k)
			if k == "studio" then Preview.restoreLight() else Preview.setLight(k) end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 0 })
	lightSeg.Parent = right
	ui.paintLight = paintLight
	ui.webPill = new("TextButton", { Text = "", FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 1 })
	ui.webPill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(openSettings)
	ui.webPill.Parent = right
	Theme.button("Refresh", "secondary", function() Website.clear() refresh(true) end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = right
	Theme.button("Settings", "ghost", openSettings, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = right
	right.Parent = top
	top.Parent = root

	-- NARROW DOCK: the two halves of the bar met in the middle and drew over each other.
	-- First the website status shrinks to its dot, then the title hides (the logo stays).
	-- Decided from the FULL widths, remembered while they were shown.
	local leftL, rightL = left:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"), right:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	local full = { title = 0, web = 0 }
	local DOT = 16
	local function fitHeader()
		if ui.title.Visible then full.title = math.max(full.title, ui.title.AbsoluteSize.X) end
		if not state.compactHeader then full.web = math.max(full.web, ui.webPill.AbsoluteSize.X) end
		local need = leftL.AbsoluteContentSize.X + rightL.AbsoluteContentSize.X + 24
		if not ui.title.Visible then need += full.title + 12 end
		if state.compactHeader then need += math.max(full.web - DOT, 0) end
		local room = top.AbsoluteSize.X - 26
		if room <= 0 then return end
		local compact = need > room
		local hideTitle = compact and need - math.max(full.web - DOT, 0) > room
		if compact ~= (state.compactHeader == true) or hideTitle == ui.title.Visible then
			state.compactHeader = compact
			ui.title.Visible = not hideTitle
			App.paintWebPill(state.webOk)
		end
	end
	top:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitHeader)
	leftL:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(fitHeader)
	rightL:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(fitHeader)
	task.defer(fitHeader)

	-- left column: search, filters, list
	local side = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 1, -52 - 30), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg,
		BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.pad(12, 10, 0, 12) })
	local search = Theme.input("Search skins or slots…", "", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32) })
	search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		state.query = search.Text
		renderList()
		if state.mode == "bundles" then renderDetail() end -- it filters the bundle's Add list too
	end)
	search.Parent = side
	local filters = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X }, { Theme.hlist(6) })
	ui.filterButtons = {}
	for i, key in ipairs({ "all", "review", "new", "changed", "problems" }) do
		local b
		b = Theme.button(key, "secondary", function()
			state.filter = key
			for k, fb in pairs(ui.filterButtons) do
				fb.BackgroundColor3 = k == key and col.selected or col.raised
			end
			renderList()
		end, { LayoutOrder = i, TextSize = 12, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26) })
		ui.filterButtons[key] = b
		b.Parent = filters
	end
	ui.filterButtons.all.BackgroundColor3 = col.selected
	ui.filters = filters
	filters.Parent = side
	ui.list = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 78), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -78), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 5, ScrollBarImageColor3 = col.dim, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, { Theme.vlist(2) })
	ui.list.Parent = side
	side.Parent = root
	new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -82), BackgroundColor3 = col.cardStroke, BorderSizePixel = 0 }).Parent = root

	-- right column: detail
	ui.detail = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.36, 1, 0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0.64, -1, 1, -52 - 30), BackgroundColor3 = col.panel,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 6, ScrollBarImageColor3 = col.dim, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, { Theme.pad(16), Theme.vlist(12) })
	ui.detail.Parent = root

	-- status bar
	local bar = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -30), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col.cardStroke, BorderSizePixel = 0 }).Parent = bar
	ui.statusDot = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -4), BackgroundColor3 = col.info, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(4) })
	ui.statusDot.Parent = bar
	ui.status = T("", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextColor3 = col.dim })
	ui.status.Parent = bar
	bar.Parent = root

	ui.settings = buildSettings(root)

	-- THE START SCREEN: which part of the studio's assets — over the whole panel until one is picked
	local start = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 50, Visible = false })
	local inner = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ZIndex = 51 }, { Theme.vlist(14) })
	inner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	T("ZAAL Assets", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 26, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 52 }).Parent = inner
	T("What are you working on?", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 15, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 52 }).Parent = inner
	local cards = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = 3, ZIndex = 51 }, { Theme.hlist(14) })
	cards:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	cards:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").Wraps = true -- a narrow dock stacks the cards
	cards.Parent = inner
	local function buildCards()
		for _, c in ipairs(cards:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
		end
		for i, key in ipairs(AREA_ORDER) do
			local a = AREAS[key]
			local here = a.available and a.available()
			local last = state.area == key
			local card = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = not a.soon, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 52,
				BackgroundColor3 = last and col.selected or col.card, Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 170) },
				{ Theme.corner(10), Theme.stroke(last and col.accent or col.cardStroke, last and 2 or 1), Theme.pad(14, 14, 14, 14), Theme.vlist(6) })
			T(a.chip, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 22, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 53,
				TextColor3 = a.soon and col.dim or col.text }).Parent = card
			T(a.text, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 53 }).Parent = card
			local note = a.soon and "Coming soon" or (here and "In this place ✓" or ("Open " .. a.place))
			T(note, { TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 3, ZIndex = 53, FontFace = Theme.fontMedium,
				TextColor3 = a.soon and col.dim or (here and col.ok or col.warn) }).Parent = card
			if not a.soon then
				card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					start.Visible = false
					setArea(key)
				end)
			end
			card.Parent = cards
		end
	end
	inner.Parent = start
	start.Parent = root
	function App.showStart()
		buildCards()
		start.Visible = true
	end
	App.showStart()
	mounted = true
	root.Parent = widget
	App.paintWebPill()
	if not Website.ownerToken() then toast("Paste your website token in Settings to see approval and change tiers.", "warn") end
end

-- open a tab (and optionally a row by key): "ship" | "body" | "tool"
function App.show(mode, key)
	state.mode = mode
	if ui.paintMode then ui.paintMode(mode) end
	state.selected = nil
	App.selectKey = key
	refresh(mode ~= "body")
	if mode == "body" and key then
		for _, t in ipairs(state.skins) do
			if t.key == key then state.selected = t end
		end
		App.selectKey = nil
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
	end
end

-- the panel follows the Explorer selection while it is open
local selectionConn
function App.setOpen(open)
	if open then
		refresh(true)
		selectionConn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
			local sel = Selection:Get()[1]
			if not sel then return end
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
				if sel == s.model or sel:IsDescendantOf(s.model) then
					if state.selected ~= s then
						state.selected = s
						state.showRow = false
						renderList()
						renderDetail()
					end
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	else
		if selectionConn then
			selectionConn:Disconnect()
			selectionConn = nil
		end
		stopPreview()
		Importer.unfadeAll() -- a review left open: the default comes back
		-- the panel closed: Studio's own time of day comes back
		Preview.restoreLight()
		if ui.paintLight then ui.paintLight("studio") end
	end
end

-- the plugin is closing: leave nothing behind
function App.unload()
	toolRevert() -- an unapplied tool fit goes back, like a ship draft
	toolDraft = nil
	ToolPreview.clear()
	PreviewTab.leave()
	Importer.unfadeAll()
	stopPreview()
	Preview.destroy()
end

return App
modules.BundlesTab:
--[[
	BundlesTab — the Tools side's Bundles tab (2026-10-03, the owner: "a bundle feature in the tools, its
	own tab, to bundle different items together, and they sit in a different place in tidy up").

	Left: New bundle, then every bundle with how many skins it holds. Right: the picked bundle — rename,
	order, delete; its skins (Show flies the camera there, Open opens it in Tool skins, Remove takes it
	out); and every other tool skin to Add, by tool, the search box filtering them. A skin is in one
	bundle at most (adding moves it). Tidy the room lays the bundles out in the BUNDLES row.

	The bundles live in the place (ToolBundles): no shop, website or game effect.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local ToolBundles = require(script.Parent.ToolBundles)
local Importer = require(script.Parent.Importer)

local new, T, col = Theme.new, Theme.text, Theme.color

local BundlesTab = {}

local ctx -- { ui, toast, query = fn, openTool = fn(key), rows = fn, loadRows = fn }
local tab = {
	selected = nil, -- a bundle's Configuration
	addTool = "Sword", -- the Add list's tool
	newName = "",
	tidy = nil, -- a plan, while it is shown
}

function BundlesTab.init(context)
	ctx = context
end

local function clear(frame)
	for _, c in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
end

local function selectedBundle()
	for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do
		if b.inst == tab.selected then return b end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the camera on a skin, and the skin selected
local function show(model)
	Selection:Set({ model })
	local cf, size
	if model:IsA("Model") then cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox() else cf, size = model.CFrame, model.Size end
	local at = cf.Position
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local dist = math.max(size.Magnitude * 2.5, 6)
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(at + Vector3.new(0, dist * 0.6, -dist), at)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(at)
end

local function redraw()
	BundlesTab.renderList()
	BundlesTab.renderDetail()
end

function BundlesTab.renderList()
	local list = ctx.ui.list
	clear(list)
	local order = 0
	-- NEW BUNDLE
	local nr = Theme.row(6, 0, 32)
	local box = Theme.input("New bundle name (e.g. Candy)", tab.newName, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = 1, ClearTextOnFocus = false })
	box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() tab.newName = box.Text end)
	box.Parent = nr
	Theme.button("+ New", "primary", function()
		local ok, msg, name = ToolBundles.create(tab.newName)
		ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
		if ok then
			tab.newName = ""
			for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do
				if b.name == name then tab.selected = b.inst end
			end
			redraw()
		end
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 13 }).Parent = nr
	nr.Parent = list
	local bundles = ToolBundles.list()
	order += 1
	T(("BUNDLES  ·  %d"):format(#bundles), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = order }).Parent = list
	if #bundles == 0 then
		order += 1
		T("No bundles yet. Name one above, then add its skins.", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = order }).Parent = list
	end
	local q = ctx.query():lower()
	for _, b in ipairs(bundles) do
		local hit = q == "" or b.name:lower():find(q, 1, true)
		for _, it in ipairs(b.items) do
			if not hit and it.model.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) then hit = true end
		end
		if hit then
			order += 1
			local sel = tab.selected == b.inst
			local r = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.bg, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 },
				{ Theme.corner(6) })
			T(b.name, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextWrapped = false }).Parent = r
			Theme.pill(#b.items == 1 and "1 SKIN" or (#b.items .. " SKINS"), #b.items > 0 and col.accent or col.info,
				{ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0) }).Parent = r
			r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				tab.selected = b.inst
				redraw()
			end)
			r.Parent = list
		end
	end
end

-- TIDY: the same plan as Import's, with the bundles row
local function tidyCard(d, orderNo)
	local card = Theme.card("Tidy the room", orderNo)
	T("Lays out the three tool rows by tier and, past them, the BUNDLES row: each bundle's skins side by side (Sword, Flintlock, Bucket), each with its own pad in front and its name, the bundle's name behind. A skin in a bundle leaves its tool row.",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
	local tr = Theme.row(8, 3, 32)
	if tab.tidy then
		local plan = tab.tidy
		T(("%d to move  ·  %d already in place  ·  %d in bundles  ·  pads: %d new, %d moved, %d spare taken out")
			:format(#plan.moves, plan.stay, plan.bundled, plan.pads.add, plan.pads.move, plan.pads.remove),
			{ TextColor3 = col.text, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
		Theme.button(("Tidy now — move %d"):format(#plan.moves), "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = Importer.toolTidy(Importer.toolTidyPlan(ctx.rows())) -- fresh: the place may have changed
			ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			tab.tidy = nil
			BundlesTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = tr
		Theme.button("Hide the plan", "ghost", function()
			tab.tidy = nil
			BundlesTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = tr
	else
		Theme.button("Tidy the room…", "secondary", function()
			-- the tiers come from the website: its list first, when Import has not loaded it yet
			if not ctx.rows() then ctx.loadRows() end
			tab.tidy = Importer.toolTidyPlan(ctx.rows())
			BundlesTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = tr
	end
	tr.Parent = card
	card.Parent = d
end

function BundlesTab.renderDetail()
	local d = ctx.ui.detail
	clear(d)
	local b = selectedBundle()
	if not b then
		local head = Theme.card("Bundles", 1)
		T("Group tool skins that belong together — a Sword, a Bucket and a Flintlock of one theme, say. Make a bundle on the left, pick it, then add its skins. Bundles are kept in this place only (ServerStorage.ZAALToolBundles): no shop, website or game change.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = head
		head.Parent = d
		tidyCard(d, 2)
		return
	end

	-- THE BUNDLE
	local hc = Theme.card(b.name, 1)
	local rr = Theme.row(8, 1, 32)
	local nameBox = Theme.input("Bundle name", b.name, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = 1, ClearTextOnFocus = false })
	nameBox.Parent = rr
	Theme.button("Rename", "secondary", function()
		local ok, msg = ToolBundles.rename(b, nameBox.Text)
		if msg ~= "" then ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad") end

	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 13 }).Parent = rr
	Theme.button("▲", "ghost", function() ToolBundles.move(b, -1) redraw() end, { LayoutOrder = 3, TextSize = 13 }).Parent = rr
	Theme.button("▼", "ghost", function() ToolBundles.move(b, 1) redraw() end, { LayoutOrder = 4, TextSize = 13 }).Parent = rr
	Theme.button("✕  Delete bundle", "danger", function()
		local ok, msg = ToolBundles.delete(b)
		ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
		tab.selected = nil
		redraw()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 5, TextSize = 13 }).Parent = rr
	rr.Parent = hc
	-- its skins
	if #b.items == 0 then
		T("No skins yet — add them below.", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = hc
	end
	for i, it in ipairs(b.items) do
		local r = Theme.row(8, 2 + i, 30)
		Theme.pill(string.upper(it.tool or "?"), col.info, { LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = r
		T(it.model.Name, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r
		Theme.button("Show", "ghost", function() show(it.model) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		Theme.button("Open", "ghost", function() ctx.openTool(it.model.Name) end, { LayoutOrder = 3, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		Theme.button("Remove", "danger", function()
			local ok, msg = ToolBundles.remove(b, it.model)
			ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			redraw()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 4, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		r.Parent = hc
	end
	hc.Parent = d

	-- ADD SKINS: one tool at a time, the search box narrowing it
	local ac = Theme.card("Add skins", 2)
	local opts = {}
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do table.insert(opts, { tool, tool }) end
	Theme.segmented(opts, tab.addTool, function(k)
		tab.addTool = k
		BundlesTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = ac
	local members = ToolBundles.members()
	local q = ctx.query():lower()
	local skins = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ToolSkins.scan()) do
		if s.slot == tab.addTool and not ToolSkins.isReference(s.key) and members[s.model] ~= b
			and (q == "" or s.key:lower():find(q, 1, true)) then
			table.insert(skins, s)
		end
	end
	table.sort(skins, function(x, y) return x.key:lower() < y.key:lower() end)
	if #skins == 0 then
		T(q ~= "" and "No " .. tab.addTool:lower() .. " skin matches the search." or "Every " .. tab.addTool:lower() .. " skin is in this bundle already.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = ac
	end
	for i, s in ipairs(skins) do
		local r = Theme.row(8, 2 + i, 30)
		T(s.key, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r
		local other = members[s.model]
		Theme.button(other and ("Move here (in " .. other.name .. ")") or "+ Add", other and "secondary" or "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = ToolBundles.add(b, s.model)
			ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			redraw()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		Theme.button("Show", "ghost", function() show(s.model) end, { LayoutOrder = 3, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		r.Parent = ac
	end
	ac.Parent = d
	tidyCard(d, 3)
end

function BundlesTab.reset()
	tab.selected, tab.tidy = nil, nil
end

return BundlesTab
modules.CatalogText:
--[[
	CatalogText — find, replace or insert ONE skin row inside the SkinCatalog
	module source, leaving every other byte as it was.

	The catalogue is one module (~120k characters). Each slot is a block
	`SkinCatalog.<Slot> = { ... }` and each skin a row indented by one tab,
	optionally preceded by a `-- <Key>: ...` comment line:

		-- MidNightLantern: Assets workspace.Lantern.MidNightLantern, tag MidNight (added 2026-09-23)
		MidNightLantern = { price = 100, tier = "Common", pieces = {
			...
		} },

	Some blocks are one line (`SkinCatalog.Door = { Default = { ... } }`); an
	insert turns them into a multi-line block.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local CatalogText = {}

local function escape(s)
	return (s:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%0"))
end

-- start/end index of the `{` and `}` of SkinCatalog.<Slot> = { ... }
function CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	local _, e = src:find("\nSkinCatalog%." .. escape(slot) .. "%s*=%s*{")
	if not e then return nil end
	local close = Util.matchBrace(src, e)
	if not close then return nil end
	return e, close
end

-- the row of `key` inside a block: rowStart (first char of its comment or key line),
-- rowEnd (last char before the newline that ends the row), and the row text
function CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	local pat = "\n\t" .. escape(Util.keyExpr(key)) .. "%s*=%s*{"
	local a, b = src:find(pat, open)
	if not a or a > close then return nil end
	local rowClose = Util.matchBrace(src, b)
	if not rowClose or rowClose > close then return nil end
	-- the rest of the row's last line: a trailing comma and/or comment
	local nl = src:find("\n", rowClose, true) or (close - 1)
	local rowEnd = nl - 1
	local rowStart = a + 1
	-- the comment line above, when it names this key
	local prevStart = src:sub(1, a - 1):match(".*\n()")
	if prevStart then
		local prevLine = src:sub(prevStart, a - 1)
		if prevLine:match("^\t%-%- " .. escape(key) .. ":") then rowStart = prevStart end
	end
	return rowStart, rowEnd, src:sub(rowStart, rowEnd)
end

-- the current row text for `key` in `slot`, or nil
function CatalogText.getRow(src, slot, key)
	local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	if not open then return nil end
	local _, _, text = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	return text
end

-- src with `rowText` in place of the key's row (or added at the end of the block).
-- rowText: the full row, comment line included, ending in "," and NO trailing newline
function CatalogText.upsert(src, slot, key, rowText)
	local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	if not open then
		error("SkinCatalog has no block `SkinCatalog." .. slot .. " = {` — add the slot to the catalogue first")
	end
	local rowStart, rowEnd = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	if rowStart then
		return src:sub(1, rowStart - 1) .. rowText .. src:sub(rowEnd + 1), "replaced"
	end
	local before = src:sub(1, close - 1):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local last = before:sub(-1)
	if last ~= "," and last ~= "{" then before ..= "," end
	return before .. "\n" .. rowText .. "\n" .. src:sub(close), "added"
end

-- rows compared without their comment line and whitespace
-- src without `key`'s row (and its comment line) — used when a row moves to another key (its
-- developer product id, 2026-10-03); src unchanged when there is no such row
function CatalogText.remove(src, slot, key)
	local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	if not open then return src end
	local rowStart, rowEnd = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	if not rowStart then return src end
	-- the newline that ends the row goes with it
	local after = src:sub(rowEnd + 1, rowEnd + 1) == "\n" and rowEnd + 1 or rowEnd
	return src:sub(1, rowStart - 1) .. src:sub(after + 1)
end

function CatalogText.same(a, b)
	if not (a and b) then return false end
	local function norm(t)
		t = t:gsub("^\t%-%-[^\n]*\n", "")
		return (t:gsub("%s+", ""))
	end
	return norm(a) == norm(b)
end

return CatalogText
modules.Convert:
--[[
	Convert — the ONE-TIME switch of this place's skin catalogue from names to permanent ids
	(2026-10-03, the owner: "change the system so it depends on the id, not the name").

	A skin's key becomes its OWN ROBLOX DEVELOPER PRODUCT ID (Shayan, 2026-10-03: "we should never
	change a product id" — a product can't be deleted, and one product sells one skin); the name it
	had is kept on the entry, so
	every save, config and grant that still names it by that name keeps working (the game's
	SkinIds, docs/notes/economy/skin-ids.md in SailMe-Places). Nothing is re-read from the Assets
	models — an entry is only RENAMED and annotated, exactly as it is in the shop:

	  tools   ToolSkinData.<Tool>["<old>"]  ->  ["<id>"], attrs LegacyKey = old, ProductId (the
	          website's product), Shown (the shop name, when it had none)
	  ships   SkinCatalog.<Slot>.<old> = { … }  ->  ["<id>"] = { legacy = "old", name, productId,
	          theme, … }, and ServerStorage.SkinAppearances.<Slot>.<old>  ->  .<id>

	TOOLS ARE ROWS since 2026-10-03 (ToolData): in the place the tool skins are made in (PVP&NPC
	ASSETS — the one with the designer models), a first run also BUILDS ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkinData
	from the old ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins folder of Models (every skin but Default, the references
	and a model with no mesh, which are listed), then publish it as a Package and swap it into the
	Lobby, Arena and Shipyard in place of their folders. Tools are never touched anywhere else.
	Ships: run it in the Assets place (SkinCatalog + SkinAppearances, then publish both Packages).
	Only AFTER every place runs the game's SkinIds (published).

	Matching: the website row whose game item id is this entry's ("Tool:Sword:sowrd-fish"), else
	the model of that name filed under the same slot. Default, the references, the paint sets
	(not website assets) and anything already an id are left alone; an entry with no website row
	keeps its name (it still works — it just cannot be renamed until it is on the website).
	One undo step.
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local CatalogText = require(script.Parent.CatalogText)
local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local ToolData = require(script.Parent.ToolData)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)

local Convert = {}

-- the slots whose rows are paint sets keyed by theme, never website assets
local PAINT = { Hull = true, Rim = true, Deck = true, Mast = true, MastSteps = true, Stairs = true, BodyPackage = true }

-- a product id: digits only (no skin name is)
function Convert.isId(key)
	return type(key) == "string" and key:match("^%d%d%d%d%d+$") ~= nil
end

-- the website row's own developer product, as the key text; nil when it has none yet
local function productOf(row)
	local pid = row and tonumber(row.product_id)
	return (pid and pid > 0) and string.format("%d", pid) or nil
end

local function escape(s)
	return (s:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%0"))
end

local function matcher(list)
	local byItem, byName = {}, {}
	for _, a in ipairs(list) do
		if type(a.item_id) == "string" then byItem[a.item_id:lower()] = a end
		if type(a.slot) == "string" then byName[a.name:lower() .. "|" .. a.slot:lower()] = a end
	end
	return function(kind, slot, key)
		return byItem[(kind .. ":" .. slot .. ":" .. key):lower()] or byName[key:lower() .. "|" .. slot:lower()]
	end
end

-- ToolSkinData's rows built from the OLD ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins folder: answers data, and the
-- entries left out ({ "Sword.Sword_Eagle (no MeshPart with a MeshId)", … })
function Convert.toolRowsFromFolder()
	local data, left = {}, {}
	local root = ToolSkins.oldRoot()
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		data[tool] = {}
		local folder = root and root:FindFirstChild(tool)
		for _, e in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
			-- Default is the tool's own art (the game keeps a preview copy in ToolSkinDefaults), and the
			-- references are not skins
			if e.Name ~= "Default" and not ToolSkins.isReference(e.Name) then
				-- (not `x and rowFromModel(e) or nil`: an `and` keeps only the FIRST value it returns)
				local row, why = nil, "not a Model"
				if e:IsA("Model") or e:IsA("BasePart") then row, why = ToolData.rowFromModel(e) end
				if row then
					data[tool][e.Name] = row
				else
					table.insert(left, tool .. "." .. e.Name .. " (" .. tostring(why) .. ")")
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return data, left
end

-- answers plan = { tools = { … }, ships = { … }, unmatched = { "Tool:Sword:x", … }, clash = { … },
-- toolData = <the rows to write> or nil, buildTools = true when they come from the old folder,
-- leftOut = { … } }, or nil, why
function Convert.plan()
	local list, why = Website.merchList()
	if not list then return nil, why end
	local find = matcher(list)
	local plan = { tools = {}, ships = {}, unmatched = {}, clash = {}, leftOut = {}, plannedAt = os.clock() }
	-- TOOLS only where they are made (the designer models are here): ToolSkinData as it is, or built
	-- from the old folder the first time
	if ToolSkins.available() then
		if ToolData.module() then
			local data, dataWhy = ToolData.read(true)
			if not data then return nil, dataWhy end
			plan.toolData = data
		elseif ToolSkins.oldRoot() then
			plan.toolData, plan.leftOut = Convert.toolRowsFromFolder()
			plan.buildTools = true
		end
	end
	local taken = {} -- [id] = the entry that took it (two entries must never become one)
	-- entries ALREADY keyed by a product own it: a name-keyed entry resolving to the same product is
	-- a duplicate, never a second entry under one key (a table literal with two ["id"] keys loads silently)
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		for key in pairs(plan.toolData and plan.toolData[tool] or {}) do
			if Convert.isId(key) then taken[key] = "Tool:" .. tool .. ":" .. key end
		end
	end
	local data0 = ShipSkins.catalogData(true)
	for slot, rows in pairs(type(data0) == "table" and data0 or {}) do
		if type(rows) == "table" then
			for key in pairs(rows) do
				if Convert.isId(key) then taken[key] = "Ship:" .. slot .. ":" .. key end
			end
		end
	end
	local function claim(id, label)
		if taken[id] then
			table.insert(plan.clash, label .. " (the same developer product as " .. taken[id] .. " — one product sells ONE skin)")
			return false
		end
		taken[id] = label
		return true
	end

	-- TOOLS: the rows of ToolSkinData (sorted, so a plan reads the same twice)
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local keys = {}
		for key in pairs(plan.toolData and plan.toolData[tool] or {}) do table.insert(keys, key) end
		table.sort(keys)
		for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
			if key ~= "Default" and not ToolSkins.isReference(key) and not Convert.isId(key) then
				local row = find("Tool", tool, key)
				local label = "Tool:" .. tool .. ":" .. key
				local pid = productOf(row)
				if not pid then
					table.insert(plan.unmatched, label .. (row and " (no product yet)" or " (not on the website)"))
				elseif claim(pid, label) then
					table.insert(plan.tools, { slot = tool, old = key, id = pid, asset = row.id,
						productId = tonumber(row.product_id), shown = type(row.shop_name) == "string" and row.shop_name or nil })
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- SHIPS: this place's SkinCatalog rows
	local data = ShipSkins.catalogData(true)
	for slot, rows in pairs(type(data) == "table" and data or {}) do
		if type(rows) == "table" and not PAINT[slot] then
			for key in pairs(rows) do
				if type(key) == "string" and key ~= "Default" and not Convert.isId(key) then
					local row = find("Ship", slot, key)
					local label = "Ship:" .. slot .. ":" .. key
					local pid = productOf(row)
					if not pid then
						table.insert(plan.unmatched, label .. (row and " (no product yet)" or " (not on the website)"))
					elseif claim(pid, label) then
						table.insert(plan.ships, { slot = slot, old = key, id = pid, asset = row.id,
							productId = tonumber(row.product_id),
							name = type(row.shop_name) == "string" and #row.shop_name > 0 and row.shop_name or nil,
							theme = ShipSkins.themeOfName(key, slot) })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(plan.unmatched)
	return plan
end

-- one ship row's text with its key turned into the id and the id fields added at its head
local function convertRow(text, s)
	local a, b = text:find("\t" .. escape(Util.keyExpr(s.old)) .. "%s*=%s*{")
	if not a then return nil end
	local head = { "legacy = " .. Util.str(s.old) }
	if s.name then table.insert(head, "name = " .. Util.str(s.name)) end
	if s.productId then table.insert(head, "productId = " .. Util.num(s.productId)) end
	if s.theme then table.insert(head, "theme = " .. Util.str(s.theme)) end
	if s.asset then table.insert(head, "asset = " .. Util.str(s.asset)) end
	local before = text:sub(1, a - 1)
	-- the comment above names the key first (CatalogText.findRow takes it as the row's): now the id
	before = before:gsub("^\t%-%- " .. escape(s.old) .. ":", "\t-- " .. s.id .. ": " .. s.old .. " —", 1)
	return before .. "\t" .. Util.keyExpr(s.id) .. " = { " .. table.concat(head, ", ") .. "," .. text:sub(b + 1)
end

-- carry out a plan (one undo step); answers ok, message
function Convert.run(plan)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsConvert", "Convert the skin catalogue to ids")
	local tools, ships, art = 0, 0, 0
	local skipped = {}
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		-- ships first: the catalogue source is checked as a whole before anything changes
		if #plan.ships > 0 then
			local module = ShipSkins.catalogModule()
			local src = ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(module)
			local done = {}
			for _, s in ipairs(plan.ships) do
				local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, s.slot)
				-- (not `open and findRow(...)`: an `and` keeps only the FIRST value findRow returns)
				local rowStart, rowEnd, text
				if open then rowStart, rowEnd, text = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, s.old) end
				local new = text and convertRow(text, s)
				if new then
					src = src:sub(1, rowStart - 1) .. new .. src:sub(rowEnd + 1)
					table.insert(done, s)
				else
					-- a row not on its own line (a one-line block, odd indent): left under its name, listed
					table.insert(skipped, s.slot .. "." .. s.old)
				end
			end
			plan.ships = done
			-- prove the new catalogue loads and holds every converted row before writing it
			local probe = module:Clone()
			probe.Source = src
			local okLoad, data = pcall(require, probe)
			probe:Destroy()
			if not (okLoad and type(data) == "table") then error("the converted catalogue did not load: " .. tostring(data)) end
			for _, s in ipairs(plan.ships) do
				local row = data[s.slot] and data[s.slot][s.id]
				if not (row and row.legacy == s.old) or data[s.slot][s.old] then
					error("the converted catalogue is missing " .. s.slot .. "." .. s.id .. " (" .. s.old .. ")")
				end
			end
			-- a plain .Source write: only a property write marks the Package as changed (ShipSkins.approve)
			module.Source = src
			ships = #plan.ships
			local root = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SkinAppearances")
			for _, s in ipairs(plan.ships) do
				local folder = root and root:FindFirstChild(s.slot)
				local a = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(s.old)
				if a and not folder:FindFirstChild(s.id) then
					a.Name = s.id
					art += 1
				elseif a then
					table.insert(skipped, "SkinAppearances." .. s.slot .. "." .. s.old .. " (a folder named " .. s.id .. " is already there)")
				end
			end
		end
		local data = plan.toolData
		for _, t in ipairs(plan.tools) do
			local rows = data[t.slot]
			local r = rows and rows[t.old]
			if rows and rows[t.id] then
				table.insert(skipped, "ToolSkinData." .. t.slot .. "." .. t.old .. " (a row " .. t.id .. " is already there)")
			elseif r then
				r.attrs = type(r.attrs) == "table" and r.attrs or {}
				if t.asset then r.attrs.WebsiteAsset = t.asset end
				if r.attrs.LegacyKey == nil then r.attrs.LegacyKey = t.old end
				if t.productId then r.attrs.ProductId = t.productId end
				local shown = r.attrs.Shown
				if t.shown and #t.shown > 0 and not (type(shown) == "string" and #shown > 0) then r.attrs.Shown = t.shown end
				rows[t.id] = r
				rows[t.old] = nil
				tools += 1
			end
		end
		if data and (plan.buildTools or tools > 0) then
			local okW, whyW = ToolData.write(data)
			if not okW then error(whyW) end
		end
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Nothing converted: " .. tostring(err) end
	local parts = {}
	if tools > 0 then table.insert(parts, tools .. " tool skins in ToolSkinData") end
	if ships > 0 then table.insert(parts, ships .. " ship skins in SkinCatalog (" .. art .. " art folders)") end
	local skippedNote = #skipped > 0 and (" Left under their names: " .. table.concat(skipped, ", ") .. ".") or ""
	local built = ""
	if plan.buildTools then
		local n = 0
		for _, rows in pairs(plan.toolData) do for _ in pairs(rows) do n += 1 end end
		built = "Built ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkinData from the old ToolSkins folder (" .. n .. " skins"
			.. (#plan.leftOut > 0 and ("; left out: " .. table.concat(plan.leftOut, ", ")) or "")
			.. "). Right-click it → Convert to Package (owner: the ZAAL STUDIO group), then delete the old"
			.. " ToolSkins folder here. "
	end
	if #parts == 0 then
		return true, built .. "Nothing to convert here — every skin is already an id or has no product yet." .. skippedNote
	end
	return true, built .. "Converted " .. table.concat(parts, " and ") .. " to their developer product ids (Ctrl+Z undoes it). "
		.. ((ships > 0 or tools > 0) and ("Publish " .. table.concat(
			ships > 0 and tools > 0 and { "SkinCatalog, SkinAppearances", "ToolSkinData" }
			or ships > 0 and { "SkinCatalog and SkinAppearances" } or { "ToolSkinData" }, " and ") .. ", then save the place.")
			or "Save the place.") .. skippedNote
end

return Convert
modules.ImportTab:
--[[
	ImportTab — the Import tab: the website's MERCH models, brought into the Assets place.

	Left: every merch model on the website, by slot, with what Import would do for it:
	  NEW          on the website, not in the place — Import brings it in
	  NOT ON ROBLOX  no Roblox model yet — Upload & import asks the website to upload it first
	  IN PLACE     already here: never touched (newer website versions are flagged)
	  TOOL / DEFAULT  tool skins live in PVP&NPC ASSETS; Default rows are the references
	Right: one item (Import, which opens its check on the default; Open in Ship skins), or the summary.
	Owner only: it reads the website with the owner's agent token (Settings).
]]

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)
local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)
local Importer = require(script.Parent.Importer)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local ToolData = require(script.Parent.ToolData)

local new, T, col = Theme.new, Theme.text, Theme.color

local ImportTab = {}

local ctx -- { ui, toast, query = fn, active = fn, openSkin = fn(key) }
local tab = {
	rows = nil, -- the website's merch models, once loaded
	why = nil, -- why they could not be loaded
	selected = nil, -- a row
	filter = "new", -- "new" | "all"
	busy = false,
}

function ImportTab.init(context)
	ctx = context
end

-- the area the panel is on (the start screen's pick): tools import tool skins, ship the ship skins
local function inTools()
	return ctx ~= nil and ctx.area ~= nil and ctx.area() == "tools"
end

-- the model of this row already in the place, or nil
local function hereModel(row)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	if tool then return Importer.toolModel(row.name, tool) end
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	local folder = slot and workspace:FindFirstChild(Slots.SHIP[slot].folder)
	return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(row.name) or nil
end

local function problemOf(row)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	if tool then return Importer.toolNameProblem(row, tool) end
	return Importer.nameProblem(row)
end

local function suggestionOf(row)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	if tool then return ToolSkins.suggestName(row.name, tool) or tostring(row.name) end
	return Importer.suggestName(row)
end

-- what Import would do with a row: "new" | "upload" | "here" | "badname" | "default" | "elsewhere" | "other"
-- ("elsewhere" = the other area's: a tool skin on the Ship side, a ship skin on the Tools side)
local function stateOf(row)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	if (tool ~= nil) ~= inTools() then return "elsewhere" end
	if not tool and not Importer.slotOf(row) then return "other" end
	if Importer.isDefault(row.name) then return "default" end
	if hereModel(row) then return "here" end
	if problemOf(row) then return "badname" end
	if not row.roblox_asset_id then return "upload" end
	return "new"
end

local STATE_PILL = {
	new = { "NEW", "accent" }, upload = { "NOT ON ROBLOX", "warn" }, here = { "IN PLACE", "ok" },
	badname = { "FIX NAME", "bad" }, elsewhere = { "OTHER AREA", "info" }, default = { "DEFAULT", "info" }, other = { "OTHER", "info" },
}

-- a newer website version than the one imported (the model's ZAALWebsiteVersion)
local function newerOnWebsite(row)
	local m = hereModel(row)
	local v = m and m:GetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteVersion")
	return type(v) == "number" and (tonumber(row.version) or 0) > v
end

-- a new area: no plan or pick left from the other one
function ImportTab.reset()
	tab.tidy = nil
	tab.selected = nil
end

function ImportTab.load()
	tab.rows, tab.why = Website.merchModels()
	if tab.rows then
		table.sort(tab.rows, function(a, b) return tostring(a.name):lower() < tostring(b.name):lower() end)
	end
end

-- upload (when needed) and import one row; answers ok, message
local function importRow(row, update)
	if not row.roblox_asset_id then
		-- Roblox checks a new model for a few minutes. The website never uploads twice: pressing again
		-- only asks about the same upload. So say so in big letters on the card (2026-10-03, the
		-- owner: a small toast made him press again and again, worried it uploaded each time)
		local data, why = Website.uploadToRoblox({ row.id })
		if not data then return false, why end
		local r = data.results and data.results[1]
		if not r then return false, "The website did not answer for " .. row.name .. "." end
		if r.status == "pending" then
			row._sentAt = os.time()
			return false, row.name .. ": sent to Roblox — Roblox is checking it. Try Import again in a minute."
		end
		if not r.roblox_asset_id then
			return false, row.name .. ": upload " .. tostring(r.status) .. (r.message and (" — " .. r.message) or "")
		end
		row.roblox_asset_id = r.roblox_asset_id
		row.roblox_asset_type = r.roblox_asset_type
	end
	if Importer.toolOf(row) then
		if update then return Importer.updateTool(row) end
		return Importer.importTool(row, tab.rows)
	end
	if update then return Importer.update(row, tab.rows) end
	return Importer.import(row, tab.rows)
end

-- LIST ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function ImportTab.renderList()
	local list = ctx.ui.list
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	if not Website.token() then
		T("Import reads the website with your token: Settings → paste it (the owner: the agent token; a designer: your own Blender token, from the Dashboard).", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = list
		return
	end
	if not tab.rows then
		T(tab.why or "Loading the website's merch…", { TextColor3 = tab.why and col.bad or col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = list
		return
	end
	local q = ctx.query():lower()
	local order = 0
	local seg = Theme.segmented({ { "new", "To import" }, { "all", "All merch" } }, tab.filter, function(k)
		tab.filter = k
		ImportTab.renderList()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 0 })
	seg.Parent = list
	local bySlot, slotOrder = {}, {}
	for _, row in ipairs(tab.rows) do
		local st = stateOf(row)
		local show = st ~= "elsewhere" and ((tab.filter == "all") or st == "new" or st == "upload" or st == "badname" or (st == "here" and newerOnWebsite(row)))
		if show and (q == "" or tostring(row.name):lower():find(q, 1, true)) then
			local slot = Importer.toolOf(row) or Importer.slotOf(row) or "Other"
			if not bySlot[slot] then
				bySlot[slot] = {}
				table.insert(slotOrder, slot)
			end
			table.insert(bySlot[slot], { row = row, st = st })
		end
	end
	table.sort(slotOrder, function(a, b)
		local order = inTools() and Slots.TOOL_ORDER or Slots.ORDER
		local ia, ib = table.find(order, a) or 99, table.find(order, b) or 99
		if ia ~= ib then return ia < ib end
		return a < b
	end)
	for _, slot in ipairs(slotOrder) do
		order += 1
		T(slot:upper() .. "  ·  " .. #bySlot[slot], { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = order }).Parent = list
		for _, e in ipairs(bySlot[slot]) do
			order += 1
			local sel = tab.selected == e.row
			local r = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.bg, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 },
				{ Theme.corner(6) })
			T(e.row.name, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextWrapped = false }).Parent = r
			local pill = STATE_PILL[e.st]
			local label = pill[1]
			if e.st == "here" and newerOnWebsite(e.row) then label = "NEWER ON WEB" end
			Theme.pill(label, col[pill[2]] or col.info, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0) }).Parent = r
			r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				tab.selected = e.row
				ImportTab.renderList()
				ImportTab.renderDetail()
			end)
			r.Parent = list
		end
	end
	if order == 0 then
		T(tab.filter == "new" and "Nothing to import — every website merch model is in the place." or "No merch matches.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = list
	end
end

-- DETAIL --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function counts()
	local c = { new = 0, upload = 0, here = 0, elsewhere = 0, default = 0, other = 0, badname = 0 }
	for _, row in ipairs(tab.rows or {}) do
		local st = stateOf(row)
		c[st] += 1
	end
	return c
end

function ImportTab.renderDetail()
	local d = ctx.ui.detail
	for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
	if not tab.rows then return end

	-- SUMMARY + import all
	local c = counts()
	local head = Theme.card("Import from the website", 1)
	T(("%d to import  ·  %d need a Roblox upload first  ·  %d need a name fix on the website  ·  %d already in the place  ·  %d %s")
		:format(c.new, c.upload, c.badname, c.here, c.elsewhere, inTools() and "ship skins (the Ship side)" or "tool skins (the Tools side)"),
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = head
	T(inTools()
		and "Import one at a time: each lands in its tool's row with the fit of a skin of the same tool, and opens in the hand to check (Hold / Aim / Throw…). Update swaps the mesh and keeps the fit."
		or "Import one at a time: each lands on its slot's default to be checked (move, turn, scale, rename pieces), then Confirm puts it in its grid cell. A skin already here changes only by its Update button (its setup kept, then checked the same way).",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = head
	local hr = Theme.row(8, 3, 32)
	-- one at a time, on purpose: every import is checked on the default before it is placed
	Theme.button("Reload website list", "ghost", function()
		ImportTab.load()
		ImportTab.renderList()
		ImportTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = hr
	Theme.button(tab.tidy and "Hide the tidy plan" or "Tidy the place…", "secondary", function()
		tab.tidy = not tab.tidy and (inTools() and Importer.toolTidyPlan(tab.rows) or Importer.tidyPlan(tab.rows)) or nil
		ImportTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = hr
	hr.Parent = head
	head.Parent = d

	-- TIDY: the plan first, then one undo step
	if tab.tidy and inTools() then
		local plan = tab.tidy
		local card = Theme.card("Tidy the tool skins", 2)
		local seconds = {}
		for _, mv in ipairs(plan.moves) do
			if mv.why then table.insert(seconds, mv.inst.Name) end
		end
		T(("%d to move  ·  %d already in their place  ·  pads: %d new, %d moved, %d spare taken out")
			:format(#plan.moves, plan.stay, plan.pads.add, plan.pads.move, plan.pads.remove), { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
		T("The room's three rows (Sword, Bucket, Flintlock): the references first, then the skins by tier (Legendary → Common, from the website), each with its own pad in front — step on it to equip that skin — its name in front of the pad and a coloured tier plate behind each group. Plates go in workspace._ToolGridLabels.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
		if #seconds > 0 then
			T("A second model of one name goes at the end of its row: " .. table.concat(seconds, ", "), { TextColor3 = col.warn, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = card
		end
		local tr = Theme.row(8, 5, 32)
		Theme.button(("Tidy now — move %d"):format(#plan.moves), "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = Importer.toolTidy(Importer.toolTidyPlan(tab.rows)) -- fresh: the place may have changed
			ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			tab.tidy = nil
			ImportTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = tr
		tr.Parent = card
		card.Parent = d
	elseif tab.tidy then
		local plan = tab.tidy
		local card = Theme.card("Tidy the place", 2)
		local unsorted = {}
		for _, mv in ipairs(plan.moves) do
			if mv.where == "Unsorted" then table.insert(unsorted, mv.inst.Name .. " — " .. mv.why) end
		end
		T(("%d to move into the grid  ·  %d already in their cell  ·  %d theme columns  ·  %d reference columns")
			:format(#plan.moves, plan.stay, #plan.layout.order - 1, plan.layout.refCols), { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
		T("Columns: references, then themes grouped Legendary → Epic → Rare → Common (from the website), then Unsorted. Rows: Wheel, then Body — each theme's colour ship (workspace.ship) scaled down to a cell and wearing the theme's sail (a theme with no colour ship gets a display ship in workspace._GridBodies, default colours) — then the other slots. Only models inside the slot folders and workspace.ship move; labels go on the ground in workspace._GridLabels.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
		if #unsorted > 0 then
			T("Unsorted (fix the name, then tidy again):\n• " .. table.concat(unsorted, "\n• "),
