				{ TextColor3 = col.warn, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = card
		end
		if #plan.left > 0 then
			T("Left where they are: " .. table.concat(plan.left, ", "), { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = card
		end
		local tr = Theme.row(8, 5, 32)
		Theme.button(("Tidy now — move %d"):format(#plan.moves), "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = Importer.tidy(Importer.tidyPlan(tab.rows)) -- fresh: the place may have changed
			ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			tab.tidy = nil
			ImportTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = tr
		tr.Parent = card
		card.Parent = d
	end

	-- ONE ITEM
	local row = tab.selected
	if not row then return end
	local st = stateOf(row)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	local card = Theme.card(row.name, 3)
	local theme = (not tool) and slot and ShipSkins.themeOfName(row.name, slot)
	T(("%s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  v%s  ·  %s"):format(tool or slot or tostring(row.slot or "?"), tool and "tool skin" or ("theme " .. (theme or "—")),
		row.tier and (tostring(row.tier):sub(1, 1):upper() .. tostring(row.tier):sub(2)) or "no tier", tostring(row.version or "?"),
		tostring(row.status or "?")), { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
	T(("File %s  ·  Roblox model %s"):format(tostring(row.file or "?"), row.roblox_asset_id and tostring(row.roblox_asset_id) or "none yet"),
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
	local fmt = Importer.formatOf(row)
	T(fmt == "FBX" and ("Format: FBX  ·  comes in at " .. Importer.FBX_SCALE .. "× (FBX is authored in centimetres)")
		or ("Format: " .. (fmt or "unknown") .. (fmt == "GLB" and "  ·  comes in as it is" or "")),
		{ TextColor3 = fmt == "FBX" and col.warn or col.text, TextSize = 13, FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
	local clash = (not tool) and Importer.themeClash(row, tab.rows) or nil
	if clash then T("! " .. clash, { TextColor3 = col.warn, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card end
	if row._sentAt and not row.roblox_asset_id and (st == "new" or st == "upload") then
		local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 2,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, { Theme.corner(8), Theme.pad(12, 14, 12, 14), Theme.vlist(6) })
		T("✓  Sent to Roblox", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 20, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = box
		T("Roblox is checking the model (it takes a minute or two). Try Import again in a minute — pressing again does NOT upload it twice, it only asks whether Roblox is done.",
			{ TextSize = 15, LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }).Parent = box
		local mins = math.floor((os.time() - row._sentAt) / 60)
		T(mins < 1 and "Sent just now." or ("Sent " .. mins .. " min ago."), { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = box
		box.Parent = card
	end
	local ar = Theme.row(8, 3, 32)
	if st == "badname" then
		T(problemOf(row), { TextColor3 = col.bad, LayoutOrder = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }).Parent = ar
	elseif st == "new" or st == "upload" then
		local b, api = Theme.button(row._sentAt and "Try import again" or (st == "upload" and "Upload to Roblox & import" or "Import"), "primary", function()
			if tab.busy then return end
			tab.busy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				ctx.toast((st == "upload" and "Uploading " or "Importing ") .. row.name .. "…")
				local ok, msg = importRow(row)
				tab.busy = false
				ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
				if ok and tool and ctx.reviewTool then ctx.reviewTool(row.name) return end
				if ok and ctx.review then ctx.review(row.name, Importer.slotOf(row)) return end
				if ctx.active() then
					ImportTab.renderList()
					ImportTab.renderDetail()
				end
			end)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 })
		api.setEnabled(not tab.busy)
		b.Parent = ar
	elseif st == "here" then
		local newer = newerOnWebsite(row)
		-- UPDATE: the website's current version into the skin here, its setup kept, then the review
		local ub, uapi = Theme.button(newer and ("Update to v" .. tostring(row.version)) or "Update from website", newer and "primary" or "secondary", function()
			if tab.busy then return end
			tab.busy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				ctx.toast("Updating " .. row.name .. " from the website…")
				local ok, msg = importRow(row, true)
				tab.busy = false
				ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
				if ok and tool and ctx.reviewTool then ctx.reviewTool(row.name) return end
				if ok and ctx.review then ctx.review(row.name, Importer.slotOf(row)) return end
				if ctx.active() then
					ImportTab.renderList()
					ImportTab.renderDetail()
				end
			end)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 0 })
		uapi.setEnabled(not tab.busy)
		ub.Parent = ar
		local here = hereModel(row)
		local v = here and here:GetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteVersion")
		T(newer and ("v" .. tostring(v) .. " here, v" .. tostring(row.version) .. " on the website") or (type(v) == "number" and ("v" .. v .. " here") or "placed by hand (version unknown)"),
			{ TextColor3 = newer and col.warn or col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = ar
		Theme.button(tool and "Open in Tool skins" or "Open in Ship skins", "secondary", function()
			if tool and ctx.openTool then ctx.openTool(row.name) else ctx.openSkin(row.name) end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = ar
	else
		T(({ elsewhere = inTools() and "A ship skin — import it on the Ship side, in the Assets place." or "A tool skin — import it on the Tools side, in the PVP&NPC ASSETS place.",
			default = "A Default skin — the references are kept by hand.",
			other = "Not a skin slot this place holds." })[st] or "", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = ar
	end
	ar.Parent = card
	-- RENAME on the website from here (the website name is the skin key everywhere). FIX NAME items
	-- start on the suggested fix; since 2026-10-03 (the owner) every item can be renamed, its own name
	-- in the box. A skin already IN THE SHOP never is: players own it under that key, and a new key
	-- would take it from them. One already in the place but not in the shop is renamed here too (one
	-- undo step), or the plugin would stop matching it and offer it as a new import.
	if st ~= "default" then
		tab.renameFor = tab.renameFor or {}
		local fixing = st == "badname" or clash ~= nil
		local suggested = tab.renameFor[row.id] or (fixing and suggestionOf(row) or tostring(row.name))
		local here = hereModel(row)
		local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
		local inShop
		if tool then
			-- (a row of ToolSkinData still keyed by this NAME: one held by its product id can be renamed)
			inShop = ToolData.row(ToolData.read(), tool, tostring(row.name)) ~= nil
		else
			local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
			local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
			inShop = slot ~= nil and type(cat) == "table" and type(cat[slot]) == "table" and cat[slot][row.name] ~= nil
		end
		local rr = Theme.row(8, 4, 32)
		T(fixing and "New name" or "Rename", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = rr
		local box = Theme.input(suggested, suggested, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = 1 })
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function() tab.renameFor[row.id] = box.Text end)
		box.Parent = rr
		local rb, rapi = Theme.button("Rename on website", fixing and "primary" or "secondary", function()
			if tab.busy or inShop then return end
			local to = (box.Text ~= "" and box.Text or suggested):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			if not to:match("^[%w_]+$") then ctx.toast("'" .. to .. "' is not a valid skin key (letters, digits and _ only).", "bad") return end
			if to == row.name then ctx.toast("That is already its name.", "warn") return end
			tab.busy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, msg = Website.renameAsset(row.id, to)
				tab.busy = false
				if ok then
					-- the model in the place follows, so it still matches its website row
					if here and here.Parent then
						local CHS = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
						local rec = CHS:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Rename " .. here.Name .. " to " .. to)
						here.Name = to
						if rec then CHS:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
						msg ..= " The model in the place is renamed too — save the place."
					end
					row.name = to
					tab.renameFor[row.id] = nil
				end
				ctx.toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
				if ctx.active() then
					ImportTab.renderList()
					ImportTab.renderDetail()
				end
			end)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
		rapi.setEnabled(not tab.busy and not inShop)
		rb.Parent = rr
		rr.Parent = card
		T(inShop and "Already in the shop: players own it under this name, so it cannot be renamed."
			or ("Renames the item and its Drive folder / files on the website. A Roblox model already uploaded keeps its id."
				.. (here and " The model in the place is renamed with it." or "")),
			{ TextColor3 = inShop and col.warn or col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 5 }).Parent = card
	end
	card.Parent = d
end

function ImportTab.leave() end

-- the website rows once loaded (the grid's tiers), for a Confirm outside this tab
function ImportTab.rows() return tab.rows end

return ImportTab
modules.Importer:
--[[
	Importer — brings a website MERCH model into the Assets place as a skin, ready for the checks.

	The website keeps each model as the designer's one .glb / .fbx; on request it uploads that file
	to Roblox as a Model (group asset; asset_versions.roblox_asset_id). That Model arrives as
	Model › <Blender scene> › one Model per Blender object (named "LeftHand.005") › one MeshPart
	("tripo_mesh_…"), each piece's pivot at its mesh centre for a .glb. Import turns it into what the
	game reads (see ShipSkins): a Model named the skin key, its MeshParts DIRECT children named after
	their sockets, anchored, tagged with the theme, filed in workspace.<Slot> and placed in its cell
	of the GRID below. Skins already in the place are never touched (the owner's rule, 2026-10-02).

	PIVOTS: a piece that arrives with its own pivot (an .fbx keeps Blender's origin) keeps it; when
	every piece sits at its mesh centre (a .glb), each takes the pivot of the same socket on the
	closest existing skin of the slot, scaled to the new mesh — then, for a slot with a reference
	rig, the checks' "Line up pivots" places them by the rig. The designer finishes with Preview.

	GRID (the owner's layout, 2026-10-02): one COLUMN per theme, every slot of that theme stacked
	down it (one ROW per slot, GRID_ORDER); an item a theme lacks leaves its cell empty. Columns
	are grouped by tier, Legendary → Epic → Rare → Common → no tier, the references first.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local ToolBundles = require(script.Parent.ToolBundles)

local Importer = {}

-- GRID -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- an empty stretch of the baseplate: the old layout overlaps where the preview ship spawns
Importer.ORIGIN = Vector3.new(-200, 0, -460)
local COL_W = 16 -- the widest non-sail skin (a door) is 12.7 studs
local TIER_GAP = 16 -- extra room between tier groups
-- each slot's row depth: its largest skin (measured 2026-10-02) + room to walk between
local ROW_DEPTH = { Wheel = 9, Lantern = 7, Cannon = 11, Anchor = 11, Window = 13, Door = 7, Bell = 7, Board = 11,
	Sail = 8, Harpoon = 7, Stove = 7, Body = 20 }
local SLOT_GAP = 6 -- extra room between one slot's row and the next
-- the rows, front to back (the owner, 2026-10-02: Board second, Lantern after Anchor) — the
-- panels keep Slots.ORDER
local GRID_ORDER = { "Wheel", "Board", "Cannon", "Anchor", "Lantern", "Window", "Door", "Bell", "Sail", "Harpoon", "Stove" }
for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
	if not table.find(GRID_ORDER, slot) then table.insert(GRID_ORDER, slot) end
end
-- BODY (the owner, 2026-10-02): each theme's colour ship (workspace.ship, tagged with its theme)
-- stands in the second row (after Wheel), scaled down to a cell. Only its size and place change — the preview,
-- the ColorTuner and Body colours read its colours by tag and part path, never its size.
Importer.BODY = "Body"
Importer.BODY_FOLDER = "ship"
local BODY_FOOTPRINT = 14 -- the widest side of a scaled colour ship, studs (a cell is 16)
-- a turned box's reach along world X and Z
local function axisExtents(cf, size)
	local r = cf.Rotation
	local x, y, z = r.XVector * size.X, r.YVector * size.Y, r.ZVector * size.Z
	return math.abs(x.X) + math.abs(y.X) + math.abs(z.X), math.abs(x.Z) + math.abs(y.Z) + math.abs(z.Z)
end
local function horizontalExtent(cf, size)
	local ex, ez = axisExtents(cf, size)
	return math.max(ex, ez)
end
table.insert(GRID_ORDER, 2, Importer.BODY) -- second, right after Wheel (the owner, 2026-10-02)
local TIER_ORDER = { "Legendary", "Epic", "Rare", "Common" }
local NO_TIER = "No tier"
Importer.REFERENCE = "Default" -- the references' own column (templates, *Default)

local function tierName(t)
	if type(t) ~= "string" then return nil end
	return Slots.TIERS[t:lower()]
end

-- the website slot of a row -> the plugin's ship slot (Slots.SHIP key), or nil for tools / others.
-- `slot` is only set for the pricing list (no Door / Bell / Stove); the path's last folder is the rest.
local function norm(s) return (tostring(s or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")) end
function Importer.slotOf(row)
	-- row.slot is nil for a slot the Pricing grid lacks (Door, Bell, Stove): a list STARTING with nil
	-- reads as empty to ipairs, so every door was "not a ship slot" (2026-10-02) — both, nil-safe
	local cands = { tostring(row.slot or ""), ((tostring(row.path or ""):match("([^/]+)$") or ""):gsub("^%s+", "")) }
	for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
		local n = norm(c)
		if n ~= "" then
			for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
				local s = norm(slot)
				if n == s or n == s .. "s" or n == norm(Slots.SHIP[slot].folder) then return slot end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Importer.isTool(row)
	local n = norm(row.slot)
	return n == "sword" or n == "flintlock" or n == "bucket"
end

function Importer.isDefault(name)
	return tostring(name):lower():find("default", 1, true) ~= nil
end

-- one column per theme however it is spelt (Ghosty_Boo and GhostyBoo, Saltyrust and SaltyRust)
local function canon(theme) return (tostring(theme):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")) end
Importer.canon = canon

-- a slot folder's REFERENCES (the slot's reference rig first, then defaults / templates / models
-- tagged not-a-skin): they stand side by side in the reference columns
function Importer.referencesOf(slot)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local folder = def and workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
	local out = {}
	if not folder then return out end
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if (def.texture and m:IsA("MeshPart")) or (not def.texture and m:IsA("Model")) then
			local tagged = false
			for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(m)) do
				if Slots.NOT_A_SKIN_TAGS[t] then tagged = true end
			end
			if m.Name == def.reference or Slots.isReferenceName(m.Name) or tagged then table.insert(out, m) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b)
		if (a.Name == def.reference) ~= (b.Name == def.reference) then return a.Name == def.reference end
		return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
	end)
	return out
end

-- every theme's column: the website's merch (the tiers live there) + the skins already placed.
-- answers { order = { theme, ... }, x = { [canon theme] = X }, tier = { [theme] = tier }, z = { [slot] = Z },
--           refCols = n, unsortedX = X } — x is read through Importer.columnX
function Importer.layout(rows)
	local votes, spelling = {}, {} -- [canon] = { [tier] = count }, [canon] = the first spelling seen
	local function vote(theme, tier)
		local k = canon(theme)
		spelling[k] = spelling[k] or theme
		votes[k] = votes[k] or {}
		local t = tier or NO_TIER
		votes[k][t] = (votes[k][t] or 0) + 1
	end
	for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
		local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
		if slot and not Importer.isDefault(row.name) then
			local theme = ShipSkins.themeOfName(row.name, slot)
			if theme then vote(theme, tierName(row.tier)) end
		end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		local theme = s.nameTheme
		if theme and not votes[canon(theme)] then vote(theme, nil) end
	end
	local refCols = 1
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		refCols = math.max(refCols, #Importer.referencesOf(slot))
	end
	-- a theme's tier: the one most of its items carry (ties: the higher)
	local rank = {}
	for i, t in ipairs(TIER_ORDER) do rank[t] = i end
	rank[NO_TIER] = #TIER_ORDER + 1
	local tierOf, themes = {}, {}
	for k, v in pairs(votes) do
		local best, bestN
		for t, n in pairs(v) do
			if t ~= NO_TIER and (not bestN or n > bestN or (n == bestN and rank[t] < rank[best])) then best, bestN = t, n end
		end
		local theme = spelling[k]
		tierOf[theme] = best or NO_TIER
		table.insert(themes, theme)
	end
	table.sort(themes, function(a, b)
		if rank[tierOf[a]] ~= rank[tierOf[b]] then return rank[tierOf[a]] < rank[tierOf[b]] end
		return a:lower() < b:lower()
	end)
	local x = { [canon(Importer.REFERENCE)] = Importer.ORIGIN.X }
	local cx, last = Importer.ORIGIN.X + refCols * COL_W + TIER_GAP, nil
	for _, theme in ipairs(themes) do
		if last and tierOf[theme] ~= last then cx += TIER_GAP end
		x[canon(theme)] = cx
		cx += COL_W
		last = tierOf[theme]
	end
	local z, cz = {}, Importer.ORIGIN.Z
	for _, slot in ipairs(GRID_ORDER) do
		local d = ROW_DEPTH[slot] or 10
		z[slot] = cz + d / 2
		cz += d + SLOT_GAP
	end
	table.insert(themes, 1, Importer.REFERENCE)
	tierOf[Importer.REFERENCE] = "Reference"
	return { order = themes, x = x, z = z, tier = tierOf, refCols = refCols, unsortedX = cx + TIER_GAP, depth = cz - Importer.ORIGIN.Z }
end

-- a theme's column X in a layout (sub = 2, 3 … for the 2nd, 3rd reference side by side)
function Importer.columnX(layout, theme, sub)
	local x = layout.x[canon(theme)]
	return x and x + ((sub or 1) - 1) * COL_W or nil
end

-- stand a skin (Model or a sail's MeshPart) in its cell: centred on it, resting on the ground,
-- a sail turned side-on so its 36-stud width runs down its row
function Importer.place(inst, slot, theme, layout, sub)
	return Importer.placeAt(inst, slot, Importer.columnX(layout, theme, sub), layout.z[slot])
end

-- the cell's centre (cx, cz) — answers false when either is missing
function Importer.placeAt(inst, slot, cx, cz)
	if not (cx and cz) then return false end
	local isModel = inst:IsA("Model")
	local function bounds()
		if isModel then return inst:GetBoundingBox() end
		return inst.CFrame, inst.Size
	end
	-- a sail faces the front of the grid (its width across the row, along X). Turned only when it
	-- runs along Z: turning it every time stacked the quarter turns, and two tidies laid every
	-- sail edge-on into one long overlapping wall (2026-10-02)
	if slot == "Sail" then
		local cf, size = bounds()
		local ex, ez = axisExtents(cf, size)
		if ez > ex then
			local turn = CFrame.new(cf.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0) * CFrame.new(-cf.Position)
			if isModel then inst:PivotTo(turn * inst:GetPivot()) else inst.CFrame = turn * inst.CFrame end
		end
	end
	local cf, size = bounds()
	-- the lowest corner of the (possibly turned) box: that is what rests on the ground
	local lowest
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, sy in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			for _, sz in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				local y = (cf * CFrame.new(size.X / 2 * sx, size.Y / 2 * sy, size.Z / 2 * sz)).Y
				lowest = lowest and math.min(lowest, y) or y
			end
		end
	end
	local move = Vector3.new(cx - cf.X, Importer.ORIGIN.Y - lowest + 0.05, cz - cf.Z)
	if isModel then inst:PivotTo(inst:GetPivot() + move) else inst.CFrame = inst.CFrame + move end
	return true
end

-- TIDY (the owner, 2026-10-02): every skin already in the place into the same grid an import
-- lands in. Only the models (a sail: its MeshPart) inside the slot folders move — the game and the
-- place's scripts find skins by folder and name, never by position; loose parts (Fitile, Candle)
-- and everything outside the folders stay. A skin with no theme in its name, or a second skin for
-- a taken cell, goes to the UNSORTED columns at the far end, so nothing is left scattered.
local function centreOf(inst)
	local cf = inst:IsA("Model") and inst:GetBoundingBox() or inst.CFrame
	return cf.Position
end

-- answers { moves = { { inst, slot, x, z, where, why? } }, stay = n, left = { "…" }, layout }
function Importer.tidyPlan(rows)
	local layout = Importer.layout(rows)
	local plan = { moves = {}, stay = 0, left = {}, layout = layout }
	local themeOf = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		themeOf[s.model] = s.nameTheme
	end
	local unsortedUsed = {} -- [slot] = how many already in the unsorted columns
	local function add(inst, slot, x, where, why, scale)
		-- a sail is scaled down to a cell like the colour ships (only its SurfaceAppearance is
		-- ever read — the preview and the catalogue never use the mesh's size)
		if slot == "Sail" and inst:IsA("BasePart") and not scale then
			local w = horizontalExtent(inst.CFrame, inst.Size)
			if math.abs(w - BODY_FOOTPRINT) > 0.5 then scale = BODY_FOOTPRINT / w end -- up too: a sail that rode a mast is small
		end
		local z = layout.z[slot]
		local p = centreOf(inst)
		if math.abs(p.X - x) < 0.5 and math.abs(p.Z - z) < 0.5 and not scale then
			plan.stay += 1
			return
		end
		table.insert(plan.moves, { inst = inst, slot = slot, x = x, z = z, where = where, why = why, scale = scale })
	end
	local function unsorted(inst, slot, why, scale)
		unsortedUsed[slot] = (unsortedUsed[slot] or 0) + 1
		add(inst, slot, layout.unsortedX + (unsortedUsed[slot] - 1) * COL_W, "Unsorted", why, scale)
	end
	-- the colour ships: the column of the first theme tag whose Body cell is free
	local bodies = workspace:FindFirstChild(Importer.BODY_FOLDER)
	if bodies then
		local ships = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(bodies:GetChildren()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") then table.insert(ships, m) end
		end
		table.sort(ships, function(a, b)
			local ta, tb = CollectionService:GetTags(a)[1] or a.Name, CollectionService:GetTags(b)[1] or b.Name
			return ta:lower() < tb:lower()
		end)
		local taken = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(ships) do
			local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
			local widest = math.max(size.X, size.Z)
			local scale = widest > BODY_FOOTPRINT + 0.5 and BODY_FOOTPRINT / widest or nil -- a factor on its present size
			local cell, themes = nil, {}
			for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(m)) do
				if layout.x[canon(t)] then
					table.insert(themes, t)
					if not cell and not taken[canon(t)] then cell = t end
				end
			end
			if cell then
				taken[canon(cell)] = m.Name
				add(m, Importer.BODY, Importer.columnX(layout, cell), cell, nil, scale)
			elseif #themes > 0 then
				unsorted(m, Importer.BODY, "a second colour ship for " .. table.concat(themes, " / ") .. " (the preview uses the first it finds)", scale)
			else
				unsorted(m, Importer.BODY, "no theme tag the grid knows (" .. table.concat(CollectionService:GetTags(m), ", ") .. ")", scale)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
		if folder then
			local refs, isRef = Importer.referencesOf(slot), {}
			for i, m in ipairs(refs) do
				isRef[m] = true
				add(m, slot, Importer.columnX(layout, Importer.REFERENCE, i), "Reference")
			end
			local kids = folder:GetChildren()
			table.sort(kids, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
			local taken = {}
			for _, m in ipairs(kids) do
				local fits = (def.texture and m:IsA("MeshPart")) or (not def.texture and m:IsA("Model"))
				if not fits then
					table.insert(plan.left, def.folder .. "." .. m.Name .. " (a loose " .. m.ClassName .. ")")
				elseif not isRef[m] then
					local theme = themeOf[m]
					if not theme then
						unsorted(m, slot, "no theme in its name")
					elseif taken[canon(theme)] then
						unsorted(m, slot, "same cell as " .. taken[canon(theme)])
					else
						taken[canon(theme)] = m.Name
						add(m, slot, Importer.columnX(layout, theme), theme)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return plan
end

-- the ground labels: one per column (theme + tier) at the grid's front, one per row (slot) at its
-- left. Rebuilt on every tidy in workspace._GridLabels (nothing reads it).
local LABELS = "_GridLabels"
-- a coloured plate on the ground with its name on top. at = (X, Z) centre, sx / sz its size along
-- X and Z. The text runs along X and reads from the theme plates' side (standing at low Z, looking
-- down the rows — the owner's view, 2026-10-02).
local function label(parent, text, at, sx, sz, plate, ink)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = (text:gsub("\n.*", ""))
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow, p.Locked = true, false, false, false, true
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = plate
	p.Size = Vector3.new(sx, 0.2, sz)
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(at.X, Importer.ORIGIN.Y + 0.1, at.Y)
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = 30
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	t.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	-- the Top face's canvas runs along Z, so the text is turned a quarter and its box swapped
	t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 30 * 0.9, sz * 30 * 0.85)
	t.Text = text
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
	-- the ink from the plate's brightness: a sunlit gold or light plate washed white text out
	-- (sunlit, even the purple and blue plates read better in dark ink; only near-black plates take white)
	local light = 0.299 * plate.R + 0.587 * plate.G + 0.114 * plate.B > 0.3
	t.TextColor3 = ink or (light and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	t.TextStrokeColor3 = light and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
	t.TextStrokeTransparency = light and 1 or 0
	t.Rotation = 270
	t.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = p
	p.Parent = parent
end

local TIER_COLOUR = {
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(230, 160, 20), Epic = Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 230), Rare = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 230),
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(110, 118, 130), Reference = Color3.fromRGB(40, 165, 95), [NO_TIER] = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 75),
}
local SLOT_PLATE = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 42)
local UNSORTED_PLATE = Color3.fromRGB(205, 60, 50)

function Importer.buildLabels(layout, unsortedCols)
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild(LABELS)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = LABELS
	-- theme plates down the left of the grid (before the first row), slot plates across its front
	local side, sz = Importer.ORIGIN.Z - 9, 14
	local sx = COL_W - 2
	for i = 1, layout.refCols do
		label(f, i == 1 and "Reference" or "Reference " .. i, Vector2.new(Importer.columnX(layout, Importer.REFERENCE, i), side), sx, sz,
			TIER_COLOUR.Reference)
	end
	for _, theme in ipairs(layout.order) do
		if theme ~= Importer.REFERENCE then
			local tier = layout.tier[theme]
			label(f, theme .. "\n" .. tier, Vector2.new(Importer.columnX(layout, theme), side), sx, sz, TIER_COLOUR[tier] or TIER_COLOUR[NO_TIER])
		end
	end
	for i = 1, unsortedCols or 0 do
		label(f, "Unsorted", Vector2.new(layout.unsortedX + (i - 1) * COL_W, side), sx, sz, UNSORTED_PLATE)
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(GRID_ORDER) do
		local d = ROW_DEPTH[slot] or 10
		label(f, slot, Vector2.new(Importer.ORIGIN.X - 17, layout.z[slot]), 16, math.min(d + SLOT_GAP - 2, 10), SLOT_PLATE)
	end
	f.Parent = workspace
end

-- DRESSED BODIES (the owner, 2026-10-02): every theme column's Body cell shows a ship wearing the
-- theme's sail. A theme with no colour ship in its cell gets a DISPLAY copy in
-- workspace._GridBodies — its own colour ship when that stands in another column (one ship
-- tagged GhostTide + SailorCat + SharkBite), else a masted colour ship in the DEFAULT colours
-- (read off ServerStorage.ShipTemplate). Display copies carry no tags and no scripts, so nothing
-- (the preview, the ColorTuner, Body colours) ever takes one for a real colour ship. The sail
-- skin is laid exactly over the ship's own sail (the same mesh), which is hidden: on a real
-- colour ship only made see-through (ZAALGridHidden keeps what it was; no reader looks at it).
local GRID_BODIES = "_GridBodies"
local HIDDEN_ATTR = "ZAALGridHidden"

local function mastSail(ship)
	local st = ship:FindFirstChild("Stations")
	local mast = st and st:FindFirstChild("Mast")
	local sail = mast and mast:FindFirstChild("Sail")
	return (sail and sail:IsA("MeshPart")) and sail or nil
end

local function defaultPalette()
	local template = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("ShipTemplate")
	local palette = template and Paint.read(template) or {}
	if next(palette) then return palette end
	-- the canonical default (StylePreviewService DEFAULT_PALETTE / notes/default-ship-palette.md)
	return { Hull = Color3.fromRGB(184, 93, 40), Deck = Color3.fromRGB(170, 85, 0), Rim = Color3.fromRGB(115, 58, 0),
		Mast = Color3.fromRGB(115, 58, 0), MastSteps = Color3.fromRGB(156, 82, 52), Stairs = Color3.fromRGB(170, 85, 0) }
end

-- only what shows: a ship is ~650 instances (joints, seats, prompts, sounds, attachments…) and a
-- display copy needs its parts, meshes and textures
local function toVisible(root)
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d.Parent and not (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("Folder") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
			or d:IsA("Texture") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("DataModelMesh") or d:IsA("MaterialVariant")) then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			-- invisible handles / seats; a see-through holder (Mast) keeps its visible children
			if d.Transparency >= 1 and not d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then d:Destroy() end
		end
	end
end

local function untag(root)
	local all = root:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(all, root)
	for _, d in ipairs(all) do
		for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(d)) do CollectionService:RemoveTag(d, t) end
	end
end

-- the masted ship's mast (Stations.Mast) copied onto `ship` at the same place relative to the
-- ship's pivot (every colour ship is the same hull: measured within 0.07 studs), painted with
-- `colours`, untagged — answers its Sail
local function addMast(ship, base, src, colours, parent, name)
	if not src then return nil end
	local mast = Instance.new("Model")
	mast.Name = name
	for _, c in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do c:Clone().Parent = mast end
	toVisible(mast)
	local rel = base:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(mast:GetPivot())
	mast.Parent = parent
	Paint.apply(mast, colours) -- GetTagged: painted while still tagged
	untag(mast)
	local ratio = ship:GetScale() / base:GetScale()
	if math.abs(ratio - 1) > 0.01 then
		mast:ScaleTo(ratio)
		rel = rel.Rotation + rel.Position * ratio
	end
	mast:PivotTo(ship:GetPivot() * rel)
	local sail = mast:FindFirstChild("Sail")
	return (sail and sail:IsA("MeshPart")) and sail or nil
end

function Importer.dressBodies(layout)
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild(GRID_BODIES)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local donors = workspace:FindFirstChild(Importer.BODY_FOLDER)
	local ships = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(donors and donors:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if m:IsA("Model") then
			table.insert(ships, m)
			local s = mastSail(m)
			if s and s:GetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR) ~= nil then -- an earlier tidy hid it
				s.Transparency = s:GetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR)
				s:SetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR, nil)
			end
		end
	end
	local z = layout.z[Importer.BODY]
	local inCell, ownShip = {}, {}
	for _, m in ipairs(ships) do
		local p = centreOf(m)
		for _, theme in ipairs(layout.order) do
			local x = theme ~= Importer.REFERENCE and Importer.columnX(layout, theme)
			if x and math.abs(p.X - x) < 1 and math.abs(p.Z - z) < 1 then inCell[canon(theme)] = m end
		end
		for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(m)) do
			ownShip[canon(t)] = ownShip[canon(t)] or m
		end
	end
	local sails = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if s.slot == "Sail" and s.nameTheme and s.model:IsA("MeshPart") and not sails[canon(s.nameTheme)] then
			sails[canon(s.nameTheme)] = s.model
		end
	end
	local base -- a masted, plain-colour ship to paint the default on
	for _, m in ipairs(ships) do
		if not base and mastSail(m) and not m:GetAttribute("FullLook") then base = m end
	end
	local palette = defaultPalette()
	-- the mast to copy, taken now: the loop hides the base's own sail when its theme comes up,
	-- and a see-through sail would not survive a later copy
	local mastSource = base and base:FindFirstChild("Stations") and base.Stations:FindFirstChild("Mast")
	mastSource = mastSource and mastSource:Clone()
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = GRID_BODIES
	folder.Parent = workspace
	for _, theme in ipairs(layout.order) do
		local k = canon(theme)
		if theme ~= Importer.REFERENCE then
			local ship = inCell[k]
			if not ship then
				local own = ownShip[k]
				local src = own or base
				if src then
					local copy = src:Clone()
					copy.Name = theme .. (own and "Colours" or "DefaultBody")
					-- its source's sail may already be hidden for that source's own theme: show it,
					-- or the strip drops it and the copy gets a second mast
					local cs = mastSail(copy)
					if cs and cs:GetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR) ~= nil then
						cs.Transparency = cs:GetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR)
						cs:SetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR, nil)
					end
					toVisible(copy)
					copy.Parent = folder
					if not own then Paint.apply(copy, palette) end -- GetTagged: painted while still tagged
					untag(copy)
					copy:SetAttribute("Style", nil)
					copy:SetAttribute("FullLook", nil)
					local _, size = copy:GetBoundingBox()
					local widest = math.max(size.X, size.Z)
					if widest > BODY_FOOTPRINT + 0.5 then copy:ScaleTo(copy:GetScale() * BODY_FOOTPRINT / widest) end
					Importer.placeAt(copy, Importer.BODY, Importer.columnX(layout, theme), z)
					ship = copy
				end
			end
			local sail, onMast = sails[k], ship and mastSail(ship)
			-- a ship with no mast (the Gold full look, the shared colour ships) gets a DISPLAY mast
			-- from the masted ship, in the ship's own mast colours (default where it has none), so
			-- the sail has somewhere to go. Never added to a real colour ship: the preview reads
			-- its Mast colour and the Gold look part by part, so it lives in _GridBodies.
			if sail and ship and not onMast and base then
				local colours = table.clone(palette)
				for g, c in pairs(Paint.read(ownShip[k] or ship)) do colours[g] = c end
				onMast = addMast(ship, base, mastSource, colours, ship:IsDescendantOf(folder) and ship or folder, theme .. "Mast")
			end
			if sail and onMast then
				sail.Size = onMast.Size
				sail.CFrame = onMast.CFrame
				if onMast:IsDescendantOf(folder) then
					onMast:Destroy()
				else
					onMast:SetAttribute(HIDDEN_ATTR, onMast.Transparency)
					onMast.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- after a colour ship is repainted or made (Body colours), re-dress the Body row so the display
-- copies, display masts and sails follow — the grid's columns read back off its ground labels
-- (no website list needed). Answers false when the place has not been tidied.
function Importer.redressBodies()
	local labels = workspace:FindFirstChild(LABELS)
	local body = labels and labels:FindFirstChild(Importer.BODY)
	if not body then return false end
	local layout = { order = { Importer.REFERENCE }, x = {}, z = { [Importer.BODY] = body.Position.Z } }
	for _, p in ipairs(labels:GetChildren()) do
		local gui = p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
		local t = gui and gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if t and t.Text:find("\n") then -- a theme plate: "<Theme>\n<tier>"
			table.insert(layout.order, p.Name)
			layout.x[canon(p.Name)] = p.Position.X
		end
	end
	Importer.dressBodies(layout)
	return true
end

-- carry out a plan in ONE undo step — answers ok, message
function Importer.tidy(plan)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Tidy the Assets place")
	local moved = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local cols = 0
		for _, mv in ipairs(plan.moves) do
			if mv.scale then -- a factor on the present size
				if mv.inst:IsA("Model") then
					mv.inst:ScaleTo(mv.inst:GetScale() * mv.scale)
				else
					mv.inst.Size *= mv.scale
				end
			end
			if Importer.placeAt(mv.inst, mv.slot, mv.x, mv.z) then moved += 1 end
			if mv.where == "Unsorted" then cols = math.max(cols, math.floor((mv.x - plan.layout.unsortedX) / COL_W + 0.5) + 1) end
		end
		Importer.buildLabels(plan.layout, cols)
		Importer.dressBodies(plan.layout)
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Tidy stopped: " .. tostring(err) .. " (nothing kept — Ctrl+Z not needed)" end
	return true, ("Moved %d into the grid (Ctrl+Z undoes it all). Save the place to keep it."):format(moved)
end

-- NAME CHECK before anything is imported: the website name IS the skin key in the game, the shop
-- and the website, so it must already be right there (rename on the website, then import).
-- answers nil when fine, else the reason
function Importer.nameProblem(row)
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	if not slot then return nil end
	local name = tostring(row.name)
	if not name:match("^[%w_]+$") then
		return "'" .. name .. "' is not a valid skin key (letters, digits and _ only: no -, spaces or dots). Rename it on the website."
	end
	if not ShipSkins.themeOfName(name, slot) then
		return "'" .. name .. "' does not end in " .. slot .. ", but it is filed under " .. slot
			.. " on the website — rename it to <Theme>" .. slot .. ", or move it to the right folder."
	end
	return nil
end

-- the name a FIX NAME item should have: separators out (Ghosty-BooWheel -> GhostyBooWheel), and
-- the slot it is filed under as the ending (GrapeFizzCannon under Anchor -> GrapeFizzAnchor)
function Importer.suggestName(row)
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	local name = tostring(row.name):gsub("[^%w]", "")
	if not slot then return name end
	if ShipSkins.themeOfName(name, slot) then
		-- keep the designer's theme, end in the slot's own spelling
		return name:sub(1, #name - #slot) .. slot
	end
	-- ends in another slot's name: swap that ending for this slot
	for _, other in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local theme = ShipSkins.themeOfName(name, other)
		if theme then return theme .. slot end
	end
	return name .. slot
end

-- the same theme spelled two ways (Ghosty_Boo / GhostyBoo, PAstelBlue / PastelBlue): a warning
function Importer.themeClash(row, rows)
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	local theme = slot and ShipSkins.themeOfName(row.name, slot)
	if not theme then return nil end
	local key = theme:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")
	for _, other in ipairs(rows or {}) do
		local s = Importer.slotOf(other)
		local t = s and ShipSkins.themeOfName(other.name, s)
		if t and t ~= theme and t:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "") == key then
			return "'" .. theme .. "' is also spelled '" .. t .. "' (" .. other.name .. ") — one theme should be spelled one way."
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- IMPORT ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- a Blender object's name without its ".005" duplicate suffix
local function cleanName(s)
	return (tostring(s):gsub("%.%d+$", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

-- the pieces of a loaded website model: { part, name } — a piece's name is its Blender object's
-- (the Model wrapping one MeshPart), else the part's own
local function piecesOf(root)
	local out = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local parent = d.Parent
			local name = d.Name
			if parent and parent:IsA("Model") and parent ~= root and #parent:GetChildren() >= 1 then
				local parts = 0
				for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("BasePart") then parts += 1 end end
				if parts == 1 then name = parent.Name end
			end
			table.insert(out, { part = d, name = cleanName(name) })
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function identity(cf)
	local _, angle = cf:ToAxisAngle()
	return cf.Position.Magnitude < 1e-3 and math.abs(angle) < 1e-3
end

-- the closest existing skin of the slot (by the size of the piece on the same socket) — the donor
-- of pivots for a .glb that brought none
local function donorFor(slot, model, def)
	local best, bestScore
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if s.slot == slot and s.model ~= model and s.model:IsA("Model") then
			local score, matched = 0, 0
			for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					local q = s.model:FindFirstChild(p.Name)
					if q and q:IsA("BasePart") then
						matched += 1
						score += (q.Size - p.Size).Magnitude
					end
				end
			end
			if matched > 0 then
				score = score / matched - matched * 2 -- more matching pieces first
				if not bestScore or score < bestScore then best, bestScore = s.model, score end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- PIECE NAMES: the pieces of a skin not named after a socket (a Blender object nobody named:
-- "tripo_node_a690e204…"). One-socket slots take any name.
function Importer.unnamedPieces(model, slot)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local out = {}
	if not (def and def.sockets and #def.sockets > 1 and model:IsA("Model")) then return out end
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and not Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name) then table.insert(out, p) end
	end
	return out
end

-- GUESS the sockets of a skin's pieces from an existing skin of the slot with the same pieces:
-- each piece is matched to the donor piece with the most similar shape and place in its model
-- (both measured against the model's own extent, so a bigger skin still matches), as the best
-- one-to-one assignment. answers { [part] = socket } and the donor's name, or nil
function Importer.guessSockets(model, slot)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	if not (def and def.sockets and #def.sockets > 1) then return nil end
	local pieces = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(pieces, p) end
	end
	if #pieces == 0 or #pieces > 7 then return nil end
	-- the donor: a skin of the slot whose pieces are all named, as many as ours (or the most)
	local donor, donorPieces
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if s.slot == slot and s.model ~= model and s.model:IsA("Model") then
			local named, seen, okAll = {}, {}, true
			for _, q in ipairs(s.model:GetChildren()) do
				if q:IsA("BasePart") then
					local sock = Slots.socketFor(def, q.Name)
					if not sock or seen[sock] then okAll = false break end
					seen[sock] = true
					table.insert(named, { part = q, socket = sock })
				end
			end
			if okAll and #named >= #pieces and (not donorPieces or math.abs(#named - #pieces) < math.abs(#donorPieces - #pieces)) then
				donor, donorPieces = s.model, named
			end
		end
	end
	if not donorPieces then return nil end
	local function frame(parts)
		local lo, hi
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
			lo = lo and lo:Min(p.Position) or p.Position
			hi = hi and hi:Max(p.Position) or p.Position
		end
		local centre = (lo + hi) / 2
		local scale = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do scale = math.max(scale, p.Size.Magnitude) end
		return centre, math.max(scale, (hi - lo).Magnitude, 1e-3)
	end
	local qParts = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(donorPieces) do table.insert(qParts, e.part) end
	local pc, ps = frame(pieces)
	local qc, qs = frame(qParts)
	local function cost(p, q)
		local where = ((p.Position - pc) / ps - (q.Position - qc) / qs).Magnitude
		local shape = (p.Size / ps - q.Size / qs).Magnitude
		return where + shape
	end
	-- best one-to-one assignment (at most 7 pieces: a plain search is quick)
	local best, bestCost = nil, math.huge
	local used, pick = {}, {}
	local function search(i, sum)
		if sum >= bestCost then return end
		if i > #pieces then
			best, bestCost = table.clone(pick), sum
			return
		end
		for j, e in ipairs(donorPieces) do
			if not used[j] then
				used[j] = true
				pick[i] = e.socket
				search(i + 1, sum + cost(pieces[i], e.part))
				used[j] = false
			end
		end
	end
	search(1, 0)
	if not best then return nil end
	local map = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(pieces) do map[p] = best[i] end
	return map, donor.Name
end

-- name a skin's unnamed pieces by the guess (named pieces are kept) — answers how many, donor
function Importer.applyGuess(model, slot)
	local map, donorName = Importer.guessSockets(model, slot)
	if not map then return 0, nil end
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local n = 0
	for p, socket in pairs(map) do
		if not Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name) then
			p.Name = socket
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n, donorName
end

-- REVIEW ON THE DEFAULT (the owner's flow, 2026-10-02): a fresh import is checked where it will
-- be worn. Each piece is mounted on the slot's DEFAULT model the way the game mounts on sockets
-- (PivotTo the default piece of the same socket — a reference / default piece's pivot is its
-- socket frame), the default fades so both show, the camera frames it, and the panel's Move /
-- Rotate / Scale / piece names fix it. Confirm stands it in its grid cell. ZAALNeedsReview marks a
-- skin not checked yet (every import; Import all new leaves them all for later).
local REVIEW_ATTR = "ZAALNeedsReview"
local POSED_ATTR = "ZAALReviewPosed"
Importer.REVIEW_ATTR = REVIEW_ATTR
Importer.POSED_ATTR = POSED_ATTR

-- each piece of a model to its socket, or nil for a piece no socket name fits. Two pieces under
-- one socket name (DefaultWheel had both named Rotationpart, so the wheel was mounted on the
-- stand's pivot) are told apart by the shape guess; a socket still claimed twice is dropped.
-- `template`: the model is a slot TEMPLATE, whose pieces are named "<Socket>Template"
-- (CannonTemplate's CloseMouthTemplate, AnchorTemplate's CapPartTemplate) — the suffix is dropped
local function piecesBySocket(model, slot, template)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local named, count = {}, {}
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		local s = p:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and not s and template then
			local bare = p.Name:gsub("[Tt][Ee][Mm][Pp][Ll][Aa][Tt][Ee]%s*$", "")
			if bare ~= "" and bare ~= p.Name then s = Slots.socketFor(def, bare) end
		end
		if s then
			named[p] = s
			count[s] = (count[s] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	local clash = false
	for _, n in pairs(count) do
		if n > 1 then clash = true end
	end
	if not clash then return named, true end
	local guess = Importer.guessSockets(model, slot)
	if guess then
		for p, s in pairs(guess) do
			if named[p] and count[named[p]] > 1 then named[p] = s end
		end
	end
	local seen = {}
	for _, s in pairs(named) do
		seen[s] = (seen[s] or 0) + 1
	end
	for p, s in pairs(named) do
		if seen[s] > 1 then named[p] = nil end
	end
	return named, false
end

-- the slot's default model in its folder: the reference rig, else a model named *Default* /
-- Default* — one whose pieces each have their own socket name first
-- is this one of the slot's TEMPLATE models (name has "template")
local function isTemplateModel(m)
	return m:IsA("Model") and m.Name:lower():find("template", 1, true) ~= nil
end

-- the model an import review mounts on. THE TEMPLATE FIRST (2026-10-03, the owner: "the import
-- review is putting items on Defaults, I want them on templates"): the slot's template with the
-- most pieces that map to sockets ("Template" suffix dropped); only a slot with no usable template
-- falls back to its reference / Default (below). Reviews only — the pivot check keeps its own reference.
function Importer.defaultModelFor(slot)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local folder = def and workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestT, bestN
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if isTemplateModel(m) then
			local n = 0
			for _ in pairs((piecesBySocket(m, slot, true))) do n += 1 end
			if n > 0 and (not bestN or n > bestN) then bestT, bestN = m, n end
		end
	end
	if bestT then return bestT end
	if def.reference and folder:FindFirstChild(def.reference) then return folder[def.reference] end
	-- the reference models (defaults and templates), the one whose pieces carry the MOST socket names
	-- winning (2026-10-03: WindowDefault's pieces are DefaultMesh / NegatePart — no socket names —
	-- so nothing was mounted on it; WindowTemplate's are BasePart / CoverPart); ties: a clean one,
	-- then a *Default* over a *Template*
	local best, bestScore
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		local l = m.Name:lower()
		if m:IsA("Model") and (l:find("default", 1, true) or l:find("template", 1, true)) then
			local named, clean = piecesBySocket(m, slot)
			local n = 0
			for _ in pairs(named) do n += 1 end
			local score = n * 4 + (clean and 2 or 0) + (l:find("default", 1, true) and 1 or 0)
			if n > 0 and (not bestScore or score > bestScore) then best, bestScore = m, score end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- LINE UP A PIECE'S AXES with the default's (2026-10-03: OliveWindow came in from a .glb whose
-- pieces run along X where the template's run along Z, so on the template the frame lay flat and
-- the cover stood crooked). Of the 24 quarter-turns, the one that makes the piece's box match the
-- default piece's box best (smallest turn on a tie); its pivot is then set to the default's in
-- that turned frame, so PivotTo(socket) — the game's mount — lands it lined up. answers the turn
-- (nil = it already lines up)
local QUARTER_TURNS = (function()
	local out, seen = {}, {}
	for _, x in ipairs({ 0, 1, 2, 3 }) do
		for _, y in ipairs({ 0, 1, 2, 3 }) do
			for _, z in ipairs({ 0, 1, 2, 3 }) do
				local r = CFrame.Angles(x * math.pi / 2, y * math.pi / 2, z * math.pi / 2)
				local key = string.format("%d%d%d%d%d%d", math.round(r.XVector.X), math.round(r.XVector.Y), math.round(r.XVector.Z),
					math.round(r.YVector.X), math.round(r.YVector.Y), math.round(r.YVector.Z))
				if not seen[key] then
					seen[key] = true
					local _, angle = r:ToAxisAngle()
					table.insert(out, { r = r, angle = math.abs(angle) })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.angle < b.angle end)
	return out
end)()

local function alignPiece(piece, target)
	local function err(r)
		local sz = r:VectorToWorldSpace(piece.Size)
		local d = Vector3.new(math.abs(sz.X), math.abs(sz.Y), math.abs(sz.Z)) - target.Size
		return d.Magnitude / math.max(target.Size.Magnitude, 1e-3)
	end
	local bestR, bestE = nil, math.huge
	for _, q in ipairs(QUARTER_TURNS) do
		local e = err(q.r)
		if e < bestE - 0.02 then bestR, bestE = q.r, e end
	end
	if not bestR or err(CFrame.identity) <= bestE + 0.02 then return nil end
	-- piece.CFrame = target.CFrame * R  ⇔  pivot = R⁻¹ · the target's own PivotOffset
	piece.PivotOffset = bestR:Inverse() * target.PivotOffset
	return bestR
end

-- BETTER: a pivot from a SKIN of the slot whose same-socket piece is built the same way (its box's
-- axes match within a third) — the slot's own convention, which a reference rig need not follow
-- (2026-10-03: WindowTemplate's cover is a tilted slab with an identity pivot, while every window
-- skin's cover pivot is the hinge, turned (179, 90, -120) — matched to the template the cover stood
-- out of the hull). Its pivot is copied, the position scaled to this piece's size. answers the donor
local function pivotFromSkins(piece, slot, socket, except)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local best, bestErr
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		-- a skin turned half round (ZAALTurned) or still being checked is no guide: its pivot
		-- already carries the turn, so a new import copying it would be turned twice (2026-10-03)
		if s.slot == slot and s.model ~= except and s.model:IsA("Model") and not Slots.isReferenceName(s.model.Name)
			and not s.model:GetAttribute("ZAALTurned") and not s.model:GetAttribute(REVIEW_ATTR) then
			for _, d in ipairs(s.model:GetChildren()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, d.Name) == socket then
					local e = (piece.Size - d.Size).Magnitude / math.max(d.Size.Magnitude, 1e-3)
					if not bestErr or e < bestErr then best, bestErr = d, e end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best or bestErr > 0.35 then return nil end
	local ratio = Vector3.new(piece.Size.X / best.Size.X, piece.Size.Y / best.Size.Y, piece.Size.Z / best.Size.Z)
	local po = best.PivotOffset
	piece.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(po.Position * ratio) * po.Rotation
	return best
end

local faded = {} -- [part] = true while a default is faded for a review
local function fade(model, on)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if on then
				faded[d] = true
				d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0.6
			elseif faded[d] then
				faded[d] = nil
				d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end
		end
	end
end

-- WHERE A REVIEW MOUNTS: on the TEMPLATE — the reference whose pieces carry socket names
-- (defaultModelFor — WindowTemplate, whose BasePart / CoverPart the game mounts on). 2026-10-03 it
-- moved onto the Default in Reference 1 (sockets carried across by the two models' box centres);
-- the same day the owner put it back on the template. `host` stays the model the skin sits on, so
-- carrying across is one line away if it is ever wanted again.
-- answers def, host (the model the skin sits on), targets { [socket] = CFrame }, parts { [socket] = piece }
--
-- THE SHIP'S OWN SOCKETS (2026-10-03, the owner: "I rotate it on import, but on the ship it did not
-- apply, or applied wrongly"). A template's pieces are NOT the game's sockets: measured, CannonTemplate
-- is the cannon turned half round (OpenMouth at x +2.16 from its base where the ship has −2.15, its
-- RotationPart turned 180°) — everything tuned against its pivots came out wrong on the ship. So the
-- frames come from ServerStorage.ShipTemplate through SkinSockets (the game's own mount, targetCF
-- included), and are laid onto the template by the best slide + turn about the vertical axis that
-- matches the sockets both have. The skin sits on the template; every frame it is tuned against is the
-- ship's. `fitError` = mean studs a template piece sits from its fitted socket (a template laid out
-- differently from the ship shows a large one).
local SkinSockets = require(script.Parent.SkinSockets)

local function shipSocketFrames(slot)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local ship = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("ShipTemplate")
	local geo = SkinSockets.slots[slot]
	if not (ship and geo) then return nil end
	local okI, items = pcall(geo.items, ship)
	local item = okI and type(items) == "table" and items[1]
	if not item then return nil end
	local okS, sockets = pcall(geo.sockets, item)
	if not okS or type(sockets) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local frames = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(def.sockets) do
		local part = sockets[s]
		if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local okT, cf = true, nil
			if geo.targetCF then okT, cf = pcall(geo.targetCF, s, sockets, { rig = def.rig }) end
			frames[s] = (okT and typeof(cf) == "CFrame") and cf or part.CFrame
		end
	end
	return next(frames) and frames or nil
end

-- the slide + vertical turn that best lays the ship's socket points onto the template's piece points
local function fitOnto(pairsList)
	local n = #pairsList
	if n == 0 then return nil end
	if n == 1 then
		local e = pairsList[1]
		local _, yaw = (e.pCF * e.qCF:Inverse()):ToOrientation()
		return CFrame.new(e.p) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(-e.q), 0
	end
	local cp, cq = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	for _, e in ipairs(pairsList) do cp += e.p cq += e.q end
	cp, cq = cp / n, cq / n
	local function cost(a)
		local r = CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0)
		local sum = 0
		for _, e in ipairs(pairsList) do
			local d = r:VectorToWorldSpace(e.q - cq) - (e.p - cp)
			sum += d:Dot(d)
		end
		return sum
	end
	local best, bestC = 0, math.huge
	for deg = 0, 359 do
		local c = cost(math.rad(deg))
		if c < bestC then best, bestC = math.rad(deg), c end
	end
	for k = -20, 20 do -- refine to 0.05°
		local a = best + math.rad(k * 0.05)
		local c = cost(a)
		if c < bestC then best, bestC = a, c end
	end
	local map = CFrame.new(cp) * CFrame.Angles(0, best, 0) * CFrame.new(-cq)
	local mean = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(pairsList) do mean += ((map * e.q) - e.p).Magnitude end
	return map, mean / n
end

local function reviewTargets(slot)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local socketModel = Importer.defaultModelFor(slot)
	if not (def and socketModel) then return def, nil end
	local host = socketModel
	local targets, parts = {}, {}
	local byPiece = piecesBySocket(socketModel, slot, isTemplateModel(socketModel))
	for d, sock in pairs(byPiece) do parts[sock] = d end
	local frames = shipSocketFrames(slot)
	if frames then
		local list = {}
		for sock, d in pairs(parts) do
			if frames[sock] then
				local pCF = d:GetPivot()
				table.insert(list, { p = pCF.Position, q = frames[sock].Position, pCF = pCF, qCF = frames[sock] })
			end
		end
		local map, fitError = fitOnto(list)
		if map then
			for sock, cf in pairs(frames) do targets[sock] = map * cf end
			return def, host, targets, parts, fitError
		end
	end
	-- no ShipTemplate (or no shared socket): the model's own pivots, as before
	for d, sock in pairs(byPiece) do targets[sock] = d:GetPivot() end
	return def, host, targets, parts, nil
end
Importer.reviewHostFor = function(slot) return select(2, reviewTargets(slot)) end

-- mount the skin on its slot's default (one undo step) and frame it — answers ok, message
local turnPieces -- below, with Face the other way

function Importer.startReview(inst, slot)
	local def, default, targets, parts, fitError = reviewTargets(slot)
	if not (def and default and inst:IsA("Model")) then
		return false, "No default " .. slot:lower() .. " in workspace." .. (def and def.folder or "?") .. " to check it on."
	end
	local matched = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
		local s = p:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
		if s and targets[s] then matched += 1 end
	end
	if matched == 0 then
		return false, "None of " .. inst.Name .. "'s pieces has a socket name " .. Importer.defaultModelFor(slot).Name .. " also has — name the pieces (Setup → Name the pieces), then Check it on the default."
	end
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Check " .. inst.Name .. " on the default")
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		-- each piece's axes lined up with its default piece's (a .glb and the template's file can
		-- disagree by a quarter turn) — its pivot, which is what Approve takes to the game
		-- once per skin (ZAALAxesAligned): a pivot turned by hand afterwards is not undone
		if not inst:GetAttribute("ZAALAxesAligned") then
			inst:SetAttribute("ZAALTurned", nil) -- lined up afresh: not turned until the slot says so
			-- ONE piece (the slot's first socket — the frame, the base) takes its pivot from the slot's
			-- skins (or the reference); every other piece keeps where the FILE put it relative to that
			-- one (2026-10-03: a .glb window cover came out 180° turned — a box match cannot tell a
			-- half turn, but the file's own layout can: the cover was authored closed over the frame)
			local pieces, anchor = {}, nil
			for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
				local s = p:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
				if s and targets[s] then
					table.insert(pieces, { part = p, socket = s, at = p.CFrame })
					if not anchor or s == def.sockets[1] then anchor = pieces[#pieces] end
				end
			end
			if anchor then
				local donorPiece = pivotFromSkins(anchor.part, slot, anchor.socket, inst)
				if not donorPiece and parts[anchor.socket] then alignPiece(anchor.part, parts[anchor.socket]) end
				local function layOut(anchorPO)
					anchor.part.PivotOffset = anchorPO
					local anchorMounted = targets[anchor.socket] * anchorPO:Inverse()
					local placed = {}
					for _, e in ipairs(pieces) do
						if e ~= anchor then
							local mounted = anchorMounted * anchor.at:ToObjectSpace(e.at)
							e.part.PivotOffset = mounted:ToObjectSpace(targets[e.socket])
							placed[e.socket] = anchorMounted:PointToObjectSpace(mounted.Position)
						end
					end
					return placed
				end
				-- FRONT OR BACK (2026-10-03: GrapeWindow's whole window faced into the hull — a box
				-- looks the same turned half round, and the new files face the other way from the old
				-- skins). The skin the first piece's pivot came from shows where its OTHER pieces sit
				-- around it once mounted (the cover on the outside of the frame); of the first piece
				-- and its three half turns, the one that puts ours on the same side wins.
				local base = anchor.part.PivotOffset
				local donor = donorPiece and donorPiece.Parent
				local want = {}
				if donor then
					local dAnchor = targets[anchor.socket] * donorPiece.PivotOffset:Inverse()
					for _, d in ipairs(donor:GetChildren()) do
						local s = d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= donorPiece and Slots.socketFor(def, d.Name)
						if s and targets[s] then
							want[s] = dAnchor:PointToObjectSpace((targets[s] * d.PivotOffset:Inverse()).Position)
						end
					end
				end
				local best, bestErr = base, nil
				if next(want) then
					for _, flip in ipairs({ CFrame.identity, CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.pi, 0, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi) }) do
						local po = flip * base
						local placed = layOut(po)
						local err = 0
						for sock, w in pairs(want) do
							if placed[sock] then err += (placed[sock] - w).Magnitude end
						end
						if not bestErr or err < bestErr - 1e-3 then best, bestErr = po, err end
					end
				end
				layOut(best)
				-- this slot's imports face the other way (learned from Face the other way)
				if Importer.turnSlots[slot] then
					turnPieces(inst, def, targets)
				end
			end
			inst:SetAttribute("ZAALAxesAligned", true)
		end
		-- the whole skin first (so pieces with no default counterpart come along), then each piece
		local first
		for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
			local s = p:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
			if s and targets[s] then first = { p, targets[s] } break end
		end
		if first then inst:PivotTo(first[2] * (first[1]:GetPivot():Inverse() * inst:GetPivot())) end
		for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
			local s = p:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
			if s and targets[s] then p:PivotTo(targets[s]) end
		end
		inst:SetAttribute(POSED_ATTR, true)
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Could not put it on the default: " .. tostring(err) end
	fade(default, true)
	-- the camera on it, from the default's front
	local cf, size = default:GetBoundingBox()
	-- level, from the front of the grid: a pivot can face anywhere (WindowDefault's looks straight
	-- down, so the camera came from under the floor)
	local look = Importer.defaultModelFor(slot):GetPivot().LookVector -- the socket model faces the grid's way
	local front = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	front = front.Magnitude > 0.5 and front.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local dist = math.clamp(size.Magnitude * 1.6, 6, 40)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + (front + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(cf.Position)
	local fitNote = (fitError and fitError > 0.3)
		and (" Note: " .. default.Name .. " is laid out differently from the ship (%.1f studs) — the skin is placed by the SHIP's sockets, so it may not sit exactly on it."):format(fitError)
		or ""
	return true, inst.Name .. " is on " .. default.Name .. " (faded) — move, turn, scale or rename its pieces, then Confirm." .. fitNote
end

-- FACE THE OTHER WAY (2026-10-03, the owner: the new windows all faced into the hull): the whole skin
-- turned half round about the up axis through its first piece, every piece's pivot rewritten so
-- the game's mount lands it turned, and the review re-mounted — one undo step. A file authored
-- facing the other way from the slot's skins looks the same as a box, so this is the eye's call.
-- SLOTS WHOSE IMPORTS FACE THE OTHER WAY (learned): pressing Face the other way on an import sets
-- its slot here (App keeps it in the plugin settings), and every later import of that slot turns by
-- itself — the website's files for a slot all come from one export, so one look settles them all.
-- Windows start ON: the owner checked them (2026-10-03, "all the window should rotate 180")
Importer.turnSlots = { Window = true }
Importer.TURN_KEY = "ZAALAssets_TurnSlots"

turnPieces = function(inst, def, targets)
	local pieces, anchor = {}, nil
	for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
		local s = p:IsA("BasePart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
		if s and targets[s] then
			local e = { part = p, socket = s, mounted = targets[s] * p.PivotOffset:Inverse() }
			table.insert(pieces, e)
			if not anchor or s == def.sockets[1] then anchor = e end
		end
	end
	if not anchor then return false end
	local A = anchor.mounted
	local up = A:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis)
	local axis = math.abs(up.X) >= math.abs(up.Y) and math.abs(up.X) >= math.abs(up.Z) and Vector3.xAxis
		or (math.abs(up.Y) >= math.abs(up.Z) and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.zAxis)
	local turn = A * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, math.pi) * A:Inverse()
	for _, e in ipairs(pieces) do
		local mounted = turn * e.mounted
		e.part.PivotOffset = mounted:ToObjectSpace(targets[e.socket])
		e.part:PivotTo(targets[e.socket])
	end
	inst:SetAttribute("ZAALTurned", not inst:GetAttribute("ZAALTurned") or nil)
	return true
end

function Importer.turnAround(inst, slot)
	local def, default, targets = reviewTargets(slot)
	if not (def and default and inst:IsA("Model")) then return false, "No default to turn it on." end
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Turn " .. inst.Name .. " around")
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if not turnPieces(inst, def, targets) then error("none of its pieces has a socket name") end
		-- learned for the slot: on when this skin now faces turned, off when turned back
		Importer.turnSlots[slot] = inst:GetAttribute("ZAALTurned") == true
		if Importer.onTurnSlots then Importer.onTurnSlots(Importer.turnSlots) end
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Could not turn it: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, inst.Name .. " turned to face the other way (Ctrl+Z undoes it)."
		.. " Later " .. slot:lower() .. " imports " .. (Importer.turnSlots[slot] and "will come in turned like this." or "will no longer be turned.")
end

-- checked: back to its grid cell — answers ok, message
function Importer.finishReview(inst, slot, rows)
	local default = Importer.reviewHostFor(slot)
	if default then fade(default, false) end
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Confirm " .. inst.Name)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		inst:SetAttribute(REVIEW_ATTR, nil)
		inst:SetAttribute(POSED_ATTR, nil)
		inst:SetAttribute("ZAALAxesAligned", nil)
		local theme = ShipSkins.themeOfName(inst.Name, slot)
		Importer.place(inst, slot, theme or Importer.REFERENCE, Importer.layout(rows))
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Could not place it: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, inst.Name .. " checked and placed in its cell."
end

-- REMOVE an import from the place (one undo step): out of its folder, the default unfaded
function Importer.remove(inst, slot)
	if not (inst and inst.Parent) then return false, "It is not in the place." end
	local name = inst.Name
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Remove " .. name)
	local host = slot and Importer.reviewHostFor(slot)
	if host then fade(host, false) end
	inst.Parent = nil -- not Destroy: Ctrl+Z brings it back
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
	return true, name .. " removed from the place (Ctrl+Z brings it back; Import brings it in again)."
end

-- leaving a review without confirming: the default comes back (the skin stays on it, still marked)
function Importer.unfadeAll()
	for d in pairs(faded) do
		if d.Parent then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end
	end
	table.clear(faded)
end

-- import one website row (with roblox_asset_id) — answers ok, message
-- FILE FORMAT (the owner, 2026-10-03): the website file's kind, and the FBX rule — an .fbx is authored
-- in centimetres, so it comes in at 0.01 of the size Roblox loads it at (a .glb comes in as it is)
Importer.FBX_SCALE = 0.01
function Importer.formatOf(row)
	local ext = tostring(row.file or ""):match("%.(%w+)%s*$")
	return ext and ext:upper() or nil
end
local function fbxFactor(row)
	return Importer.formatOf(row) == "FBX" and Importer.FBX_SCALE or 1
end
-- LoadAsset, then the FBX rule on everything loaded — answers the container, or nil + why
local function loadWebModel(row, id)
	local ok, loaded = pcall(function() return InsertService:LoadAsset(id) end)
	if not ok then return nil, "Roblox would not load model " .. tostring(id) .. ": " .. tostring(loaded) end
	local f = fbxFactor(row)
	if f ~= 1 then
		for _, d in ipairs(loaded:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("Model") then
				d:ScaleTo(d:GetScale() * f)
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Size *= f
			end
		end
	end
	return loaded
end

function Importer.import(row, rows)
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	if not slot then return false, row.name .. ": not a ship skin slot this place holds." end
	local bad = Importer.nameProblem(row)
	if bad then return false, bad end
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
	if folder and folder:FindFirstChild(row.name) then return false, row.name .. " is already in the place — left as it is." end
	local id = tonumber(row.roblox_asset_id)
	if not id then return false, row.name .. " has no Roblox model yet." end

	local loaded, whyLoad = loadWebModel(row, id)
	if not loaded then return false, whyLoad end

	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Import " .. row.name)
	local notes = {}
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local pieces = piecesOf(loaded)
		if #pieces == 0 then error("the model has no mesh in it") end
		local theme = ShipSkins.themeOfName(row.name, slot)

		local inst -- what goes in the folder: a Model, or for a sail its one MeshPart
		if def.texture then
			-- a sail is ONE MeshPart named the key, its look a SurfaceAppearance
			table.sort(pieces, function(a, b) return a.part.Size.Magnitude > b.part.Size.Magnitude end)
			inst = pieces[1].part
			inst.Name = row.name
			if #pieces > 1 then table.insert(notes, (#pieces - 1) .. " extra mesh(es) left out: a sail is one surface") end
		else
			inst = Instance.new("Model")
			inst.Name = row.name
			for _, pc in ipairs(pieces) do
				local socket = (#def.sockets > 1 or #pieces == 1) and Slots.socketFor(def, pc.name) or nil
				pc.part.Name = socket or pc.name
				pc.part.Parent = inst
			end
			-- pieces nobody named in Blender (tripo_node_…): guess them from a skin of the slot
			if #Importer.unnamedPieces(inst, slot) > 0 then
				local n, donorName = Importer.applyGuess(inst, slot)
				if n > 0 then table.insert(notes, ("%d piece name%s guessed from %s — check them"):format(n, n == 1 and "" or "s", tostring(donorName))) end
				local left = #Importer.unnamedPieces(inst, slot)
				if left > 0 then table.insert(notes, left .. " piece(s) still unnamed — name them in Setup") end
			end
		end
		for _, d in ipairs((inst:IsA("Model") and inst:GetDescendants()) or { inst }) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true end
		end

		-- PIVOTS: kept when the file brought them, else copied from the closest skin of the slot
		if inst:IsA("Model") then
			local brought = false
			for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and not identity(p.PivotOffset) then brought = true end
			end
			if brought then
				table.insert(notes, "pivots kept from the file")
			else
				local donor = donorFor(slot, inst, def)
				if donor then
					local copied = 0
					for _, p in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
						local q = p:IsA("BasePart") and donor:FindFirstChild(p.Name)
						if q and q:IsA("BasePart") then
							local s = Vector3.new(p.Size.X / q.Size.X, p.Size.Y / q.Size.Y, p.Size.Z / q.Size.Z)
							p.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(q.PivotOffset.Position * s) * q.PivotOffset.Rotation
							copied += 1
						end
					end
					table.insert(notes, ("pivots copied from %s (%d piece%s)"):format(donor.Name, copied, copied == 1 and "" or "s"))
				else
					table.insert(notes, "pivots at each mesh's centre — no skin of this slot to copy from")
				end
			end
		end

		if theme then CollectionService:AddTag(inst, theme) end
		inst:SetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteId", tostring(row.id))
		inst:SetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteVersion", tonumber(row.version) or 0)
		if inst:IsA("Model") then inst:SetAttribute(REVIEW_ATTR, true) end -- not checked on the default yet
		if not folder then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = def.folder
			folder.Parent = workspace
		end
		inst.Parent = folder
		Importer.place(inst, slot, theme or Importer.REFERENCE, Importer.layout(rows))
	end)
	loaded:Destroy()
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	if not ok then return false, "Import of " .. row.name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err) end

	-- a slot with a reference rig: line the pivots up by it (the checks' own fix), one more undo step
	if def.reference then
		for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
			if s.slot == slot and s.key == row.name then
				local okI, r = pcall(ShipSkins.inspect, s, nil)
				if okI and r then
					for _, c in ipairs(r.checks or {}) do
						if c.fix and type(c.fix.label) == "string" and c.fix.label:find("^Line up pivots") then
							local rec2 = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Line up pivots " .. row.name)
							local okF = pcall(c.fix.fn)
							if rec2 then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec2, okF and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
							if okF then table.insert(notes, "pivots lined up by " .. def.reference) end
						end
					end
				end
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return true, row.name .. " imported into workspace." .. def.folder .. (#notes > 0 and (" — " .. table.concat(notes, "; ")) or "") .. "."
end

-- UPDATE a skin already in the place from the website's current version (the owner's call,
-- 2026-10-02: re-import, keep the setup). The model stays — its name, tags, attributes, rigs
-- (FaceRig, CandleRig) — and so does every piece the website still has: it only takes the new
-- mesh and texture (MeshPart:ApplyMesh), keeping its pivot, turn and scale. Then it goes to the
-- review on the default, mounted as tuned.
-- answers ok, message
function Importer.update(row, rows)
	local slot = Importer.slotOf(row)
	if not slot then return false, row.name .. ": not a ship skin slot this place holds." end
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
	local old = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(row.name)
	if not old then return false, row.name .. " is not in the place — Import it instead." end
	if def.texture or not old:IsA("Model") then
		return false, "Update is not built for sails yet: their look is a SurfaceAppearance, not the website's texture."
	end
	local id = tonumber(row.roblox_asset_id)
	if not id then return false, row.name .. " has no Roblox model yet." end
	local loaded, whyLoad = loadWebModel(row, id)
	if not loaded then return false, whyLoad end

	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Update " .. row.name)
	local notes = {}
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local pieces = piecesOf(loaded)
		if #pieces == 0 then error("the model has no mesh in it") end
		-- the new pieces, named as Import names them; the guess's best donor is the old skin itself
		local fresh = Instance.new("Model")
		fresh.Name = row.name .. "_update"
		for _, pc in ipairs(pieces) do
			local socket = (#def.sockets > 1 or #pieces == 1) and Slots.socketFor(def, pc.name) or nil
			pc.part.Name = socket or pc.name
			pc.part.Anchored = true
			pc.part.Parent = fresh
		end
		if #Importer.unnamedPieces(fresh, slot) > 0 then
			local n = Importer.applyGuess(fresh, slot)
			if n > 0 then table.insert(notes, n .. " piece name(s) guessed — check them") end
		end
		-- old pieces by socket
		local oldBy = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(old:GetChildren()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				local s = Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name) or p.Name
				if not oldBy[s] then oldBy[s] = p end
			end
		end
		-- a new piece with no old counterpart rides along rigidly from one that has one
		local anchorNew, anchorOld
		for _, p in ipairs(fresh:GetChildren()) do
			local s = Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name) or p.Name
			if oldBy[s] then anchorNew, anchorOld = p, oldBy[s] break end
		end
		local rigid = CFrame.new()
		if anchorNew then
			-- where the new layout lands if the anchor piece takes the old piece's pivot point
			anchorNew.PivotOffset = anchorOld.PivotOffset
			rigid = anchorOld:GetPivot() * anchorNew:GetPivot():Inverse()
		end
		local swapped, added = 0, 0
		for _, p in ipairs(fresh:GetChildren()) do
			local s = Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name) or p.Name
			local o = oldBy[s]
			if o and o:IsA("MeshPart") and p:IsA("MeshPart") then
				-- ONLY THE MESH AND TEXTURE CHANGE (2026-10-03, the owner: Update keeps the pivot,
				-- turn and scale tuned on the preview, and the setup). The old piece stays — its name,
				-- tags, attributes, rigs and children — and takes the new geometry at the old piece's
				-- scale (its size over its mesh's own size), where it stood, on the same pivot
				local cf, po = o.CFrame, o.PivotOffset
				local scale = o.Size / o.MeshSize
				o:ApplyMesh(p)
				o.Size = p.MeshSize * scale
				o.CFrame = cf
				o.PivotOffset = po
				o.TextureID = p.TextureID
				local look = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if look then
					local was = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if was then was.Parent = nil end
					look.Parent = o
				end
				oldBy[s] = nil
				swapped += 1
			elseif o then
				-- not two meshes (a Part stand-in): the new piece takes the old one's place by its pivot
				p.PivotOffset = o.PivotOffset
				p:PivotTo(o:GetPivot())
				for _, c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
					if not (c:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or c:IsA("JointInstance") or c:IsA("WeldConstraint")) then
						if c:IsA("BasePart") then
							local rel = o.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(c.CFrame)
							c.Parent = p
							c.CFrame = p.CFrame * rel
						else
							c.Parent = p
						end
					end
				end
				o.Parent = nil -- not Destroy: undoable
				oldBy[s] = nil
				swapped += 1
				p.Parent = old
			else
				p.CFrame = rigid * p.CFrame
				added += 1
				p.Parent = old
			end
		end
