		-- pieces here the website's file does not have (one added in Studio, a stand-in) STAY
		-- (2026-10-03, the owner: never remove a piece on Update, only add)
		local kept = 0
		for _ in pairs(oldBy) do kept += 1 end
		fresh:Destroy()
		old:SetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteVersion", tonumber(row.version) or 0)
		old:SetAttribute(REVIEW_ATTR, true)
		old:SetAttribute("ZAALAxesAligned", true) -- the review mounts it as tuned, nothing lined up afresh
		table.insert(notes, ("%d piece%s swapped%s%s"):format(swapped, swapped == 1 and "" or "s",
			added > 0 and (", " .. added .. " new") or "", kept > 0 and (", " .. kept .. " not in the website's file kept") or ""))
	end)
	loaded:Destroy()
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Update of " .. row.name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, row.name .. " updated to v" .. tostring(row.version) .. " — " .. table.concat(notes, "; ") .. ". Check it on the default."
end

-- TOOLS (2026-10-02, the owner: tools "should work same as ship") -----------------------------------
-- In the PVP&NPC ASSETS place a tool skin is a Model holding one MeshPart, tagged <Tool>Skin, in its
-- tool's folder. Import brings a website model in as exactly that, with mount attributes from a
-- skin of the same tool to start from (the fit is then judged in the hand); Update swaps the mesh and
-- keeps the fit; Tidy lays every tool skin out in one row per tool, references first, then by tier.
Importer.TOOL_FOLDER = {} -- Sword = "Sword", … (Slots.TOOL; Slots.toolFolder finds it, or the old name's)
for tool, def in pairs(Slots.TOOL) do Importer.TOOL_FOLDER[tool] = def.folder end

-- the website row's tool ("Sword" / "Flintlock" / "Bucket"), or nil
function Importer.toolOf(row)
	for _, c in ipairs({ tostring(row.slot or ""), (tostring(row.path or ""):match("([^/]+)$") or "") }) do
		local n = norm(c)
		for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
			if n == tool:lower() or n == tool:lower() .. "s" then return tool end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the tool skin model of that name in this place (tagged), or nil
function Importer.toolModel(name, tool)
	local def = Slots.TOOL[tool]
	if not def then return nil end
	for _, m in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(def.tag)) do
		if m:IsA("Model") and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and m.Name == name then return m end
	end
	local folder = Slots.toolFolder(tool, false)
	local m = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return (m and m:IsA("Model")) and m or nil
end

-- why a website tool name cannot be a shop key, or nil
function Importer.toolNameProblem(row, tool)
	local name = tostring(row.name)
	if name:find("[%.%s/]") then return "'" .. name .. "' has a space, dot or slash — rename it on the website." end
	if not name:match("^" .. tool .. "_%w") then
		local want = ToolSkins.suggestName(name, tool)
		return "'" .. name .. "' should be " .. tool .. "_<Name>" .. (want and (" (e.g. " .. want .. ")") or "") .. " — rename it on the website."
	end
	return nil
end

-- the biggest MeshPart of a loaded website model
local function biggestMesh(root)
	local best, vol = nil, -1
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
			local v = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
			if v > vol then best, vol = d, v end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- a skin of the same tool whose mount attributes a new one starts from: the first non-reference
-- skin carrying every required one
local function toolDonor(tool, except)
	local def = Slots.TOOL[tool]
	local list = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(def.tag)) do
		if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= except and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not ToolSkins.isReference(m.Name) then
			local full = true
			for attr in pairs(def.required) do
				if m:GetAttribute(attr) == nil then full = false end
			end
			if full then table.insert(list, m) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower() end)
	return list[1]
end

local function loadToolMesh(row)
	local id = tonumber(row.roblox_asset_id)
	if not id then return nil, row.name .. " is not on Roblox yet." end
	local loaded, whyLoad = loadWebModel(row, id)
	if not loaded then return nil, whyLoad end
	local mesh = biggestMesh(loaded)
	if not mesh then
		loaded:Destroy()
		return nil, "Model " .. tostring(id) .. " has no MeshPart."
	end
	mesh = mesh:Clone()
	loaded:Destroy()
	for _, d in ipairs(mesh:GetChildren()) do
		if d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then d:Destroy() end
	end
	mesh.Anchored = true
	return mesh
end

-- the scale a tool skin wears over its mesh's own size (Size / MeshSize — the place's flintlocks are
-- ×2.44): a website model arrives at its native size, so an import takes its donor's scale and an
-- update keeps the old mesh's (2026-10-02: an import landed a third the size, floating over the hand)
local function meshScale(part)
	if not (part and part:IsA("MeshPart")) then return nil end
	local m = part.MeshSize
	if m.X <= 0 or m.Y <= 0 or m.Z <= 0 then return nil end
	return (part.Size.X / m.X + part.Size.Y / m.Y + part.Size.Z / m.Z) / 3
end

-- THE TOOL ROOM (2026-10-03, the owner: "tidy them with their Tier, beside their stages, with names").
-- PVP&NPC ASSETS is a room of three rows along +X, one per tool: a skin stands in its display folder,
-- and 4.7 studs in front of it (-Z) is its PAD — stepping on a pad equips the nearest skin of that row
-- within 8 studs (ServerScriptService.SkinPadService; pads carry no link, so any pad works for any
-- skin). Tidy lays each row out again: the references first, then Legendary → Epic → Rare → Common
-- (the website's tiers), every skin with its own pad in front, a name plate in front of the pad and a
-- tier plate behind each group. Cells are 8.5 apart — more than the pads' 8-stud reach, so a pad can
-- only ever find its own skin. Pads are reused; missing ones are copied from the row's first pad,
-- spare ones taken out (Ctrl+Z brings them back).
local TOOL_ROW_Z = { Sword = -3, Bucket = -23, Flintlock = -43 } -- the pads' line, when a row has no pads yet
local TOOL_PAD_COLOUR = { Sword = Color3.fromRGB(91, 93, 105), Bucket = Color3.fromRGB(82, 124, 174), Flintlock = Color3.fromRGB(160, 95, 53) }
local TOOL_PAD_TO_SKIN = 4.7 -- SkinPadService: "Pads sit 4.7 away"
local TOOL_CELL = 8.5 -- > the pads' 8-stud reach (SkinPadService MAX_LINK_DISTANCE)
local TOOL_TIER_GAP = 5
local TOOL_START_X = 0
local TOOL_LABELS = "_ToolGridLabels"
Importer.TOOL_REFERENCE = "Reference"

local function padsOf(tool)
	local f = Slots.toolPads(tool, false)
	local list = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(f and f:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list, p) end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Position.X < b.Position.X end)
	return list, f
end

local function median(list)
	table.sort(list)
	return #list > 0 and list[math.ceil(#list / 2)] or nil
end

local toolEntries
-- the row's line: the pads' Z (their median), the skins as far behind them as they stand now (the
-- median gap: 4.7 for the swords, nearer 4 for buckets and flintlocks), else 4.7
local function rowZ(tool)
	local pads = padsOf(tool)
	local zs = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pads) do table.insert(zs, p.Position.Z) end
	local padZ = median(zs) or TOOL_ROW_Z[tool]
	local gaps = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(toolEntries(tool)) do
		local gap = (m:IsA("Model") and m:GetBoundingBox().Position or m.Position).Z - padZ
		if gap > 2 and gap < 7 then table.insert(gaps, gap) end
	end
	local gap = median(gaps)
	return padZ, padZ + (gap and math.floor(gap * 100 + 0.5) / 100 or TOOL_PAD_TO_SKIN)
end

-- the skins of a row: every tagged Model or bare MeshPart in the workspace (gun1 is a bare MeshPart)
function toolEntries(tool)
	local list = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(Slots.TOOL[tool].tag)) do
		if (m:IsA("Model") or m:IsA("MeshPart")) and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then table.insert(list, m) end
	end
	local folder = Slots.toolFolder(tool, false)
	for _, m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if (m:IsA("Model") or m:IsA("MeshPart")) and not table.find(list, m) then table.insert(list, m) end
	end
	return list
end

-- answers { rows = { [tool] = { padZ, skinZ, cells = { { name, tier, x } }, groups = { { tier, x0, x1 } }, endX } },
--           bundles = { padZ, skinZ, groups = { { name, x0, x1 } }, cells = { { inst, tool, name, tier, x } } } }
-- A skin in a bundle (ToolBundles) is left out of its tool row: it stands with its bundle in the
-- BUNDLES row, TOOL_BUNDLE_ROW studs past the last tool row — still in its tool's display folder, with
-- a pad of its own tool in front (a pad only looks in its own tool's folder, so mixed tools side by
-- side never mix up).
local TOOL_BUNDLE_ROW = 20 -- the rows' spacing (Sword −3, Bucket −23, Flintlock −43 → Bundles −63)
local TOOL_BUNDLE_GAP = 6
local BUNDLE_PLATE = Color3.fromRGB(30, 150, 140)

function Importer.toolLayout(rows)
	local rank = {}
	for i, t in ipairs(TIER_ORDER) do rank[t] = i end
	rank[NO_TIER] = #TIER_ORDER + 1
	local webTier = {}
	for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
		local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
		local t = tierName(row.tier)
		if tool and t then webTier[tool .. "|" .. tostring(row.name):lower()] = t end
	end
	local function tierOfSkin(tool, m)
		if ToolSkins.isReference(m.Name) then return Importer.TOOL_REFERENCE end
		return webTier[tool .. "|" .. m.Name:lower()] or tierName(m:GetAttribute("Tier")) or NO_TIER
	end
	local members = ToolBundles.members()
	local layout = { rows = {} }
	local lastPadZ
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local padZ, skinZ = rowZ(tool)
		lastPadZ = lastPadZ and math.min(lastPadZ, padZ) or padZ
		local refs, skins, seen = {}, {}, {}
		for _, m in ipairs(toolEntries(tool)) do
			local k = m.Name:lower()
			if not members[m] and not seen[k] then
				seen[k] = true
				if ToolSkins.isReference(m.Name) then
					table.insert(refs, m.Name)
				else
					table.insert(skins, { name = m.Name, tier = tierOfSkin(tool, m) })
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(refs, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
		table.sort(skins, function(a, b)
			if rank[a.tier] ~= rank[b.tier] then return rank[a.tier] < rank[b.tier] end
			return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
		end)
		local r = { padZ = padZ, skinZ = skinZ, cells = {}, groups = {}, pos = {} }
		local x, last = TOOL_START_X, nil
		local function put(name, tier)
			if tier ~= last then
				if last then x += TOOL_TIER_GAP end
				table.insert(r.groups, { tier = tier, x0 = x, x1 = x })
				last = tier
			end
			r.groups[#r.groups].x1 = x
			table.insert(r.cells, { name = name, tier = tier, x = x })
			r.pos[name:lower()] = x
			x += TOOL_CELL
		end
		for _, name in ipairs(refs) do put(name, Importer.TOOL_REFERENCE) end
		for _, s in ipairs(skins) do put(s.name, s.tier) end
		r.endX = x
		layout.rows[tool] = r
	end
	-- THE BUNDLES ROW: each bundle a group, its skins in the tools' order (Sword, Flintlock, Bucket)
	local bpad = (lastPadZ or TOOL_ROW_Z.Flintlock) - TOOL_BUNDLE_ROW
	local br = { padZ = bpad, skinZ = bpad + TOOL_PAD_TO_SKIN, groups = {}, cells = {} }
	local x = TOOL_START_X
	for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do
		if #b.items > 0 then
			table.insert(br.groups, { name = b.name, x0 = x, x1 = x })
			for _, it in ipairs(b.items) do
				if it.tool then
					br.groups[#br.groups].x1 = x
					table.insert(br.cells, { inst = it.model, tool = it.tool, name = it.model.Name, tier = tierOfSkin(it.tool, it.model), x = x })
					x += TOOL_CELL
				end
			end
			x += TOOL_BUNDLE_GAP
		end
	end
	layout.bundles = br
	return layout
end

-- answers { moves = { { inst, tool, x, z, why? } }, stay = n, pads = { add, move, remove }, layout,
--           cells = { [tool] = { { x, padZ } } } }
function Importer.toolTidyPlan(rows)
	local layout = Importer.toolLayout(rows)
	local plan = { moves = {}, stay = 0, pads = { add = 0, move = 0, remove = 0 }, layout = layout, cells = {}, bundled = #layout.bundles.cells }
	local members = ToolBundles.members()
	local function moveTo(m, tool, x, z, why)
		local p = m:IsA("Model") and m:GetBoundingBox().Position or m.Position
		local folder = Slots.toolFolder(tool, false)
		local inFolder = folder ~= nil and m.Parent == folder
		if math.abs(p.X - x) < 0.3 and math.abs(p.Z - z) < 0.3 and inFolder then
			plan.stay += 1
		else
			table.insert(plan.moves, { inst = m, tool = tool, x = x, z = z, why = why })
		end
	end
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local r = layout.rows[tool]
		local list = toolEntries(tool)
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
		local taken, extraX = {}, r.endX + TOOL_TIER_GAP
		local cells = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(list) do
			if not members[m] then
				local k = m.Name:lower()
				local x, why = r.pos[k], nil
				if taken[k] then
					x, why = extraX, "a second " .. m.Name
					extraX += TOOL_CELL
				end
				taken[k] = true
				table.insert(cells, { x = x, padZ = r.padZ })
				moveTo(m, tool, x, r.skinZ, why)
			end
		end
		plan.cells[tool] = cells
	end
	local br = layout.bundles
	for _, c in ipairs(br.cells) do
		table.insert(plan.cells[c.tool], { x = c.x, padZ = br.padZ })
		moveTo(c.inst, c.tool, c.x, br.skinZ, nil)
	end
	-- one pad in front of every skin: the pads reused in order (row by row, then along X)
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local cells = plan.cells[tool]
		table.sort(cells, function(a, b)
			if a.padZ ~= b.padZ then return a.padZ > b.padZ end
			return a.x < b.x
		end)
		local pads = padsOf(tool)
		for i, c in ipairs(cells) do
			local p = pads[i]
			if not p then
				plan.pads.add += 1
			elseif math.abs(p.Position.X - c.x) > 0.05 or math.abs(p.Position.Z - c.padZ) > 0.05 then
				plan.pads.move += 1
			end
		end
		plan.pads.remove += math.max(0, #pads - #cells)
	end
	return plan
end

local function newPad(tool, padsFolder)
	local pads = padsOf(tool)
	local p
	if pads[1] then
		p = pads[1]:Clone()
	else
		p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = tool .. "Pad"
		p.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
		p.Anchored, p.CanCollide = true, true
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Color = TOOL_PAD_COLOUR[tool]
	end
	p.Parent = padsFolder
	return p
end

local function padsFolderOf(tool)
	return Slots.toolPads(tool, true)
end

local function setPad(pad, x, padZ)
	pad.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, pad.Size.Y / 2, padZ) * (pad.CFrame - pad.CFrame.Position)
end

local function tierInk(tier)
	local plate = tier == Importer.TOOL_REFERENCE and TIER_COLOUR.Reference or (TIER_COLOUR[tier] or TIER_COLOUR[NO_TIER])
	return plate, plate:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
end

-- the plates: the row's tool, a tier plate behind each group, the skin's name in front of its pad;
-- the bundles row: BUNDLES, each bundle's name behind its skins, the names in their tier's colour
function Importer.buildToolLabels(layout)
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild(TOOL_LABELS)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = TOOL_LABELS
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local r = layout.rows[tool]
		-- in the tier strip, just before the first group (left of the row are the spawn and the test rigs)
		label(f, tool:upper(), Vector2.new(TOOL_START_X - 6.5, r.skinZ + 4), 3.6, 2.5, SLOT_PLATE)
		for _, g in ipairs(r.groups) do
			local plate = tierInk(g.tier)
			label(f, g.tier, Vector2.new((g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, r.skinZ + 4), g.x1 - g.x0 + TOOL_CELL - 1, 2.5, plate)
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(r.cells) do
			local _, ink = tierInk(c.tier)
			label(f, c.name, Vector2.new(c.x, r.padZ - 3.4), TOOL_CELL - 1, 1.8, SLOT_PLATE, ink)
		end
	end
	local br = layout.bundles
	if br and #br.cells > 0 then
		label(f, "BUNDLES", Vector2.new(TOOL_START_X - 6.5, br.skinZ + 4), 3.6, 2.5, SLOT_PLATE)
		for _, g in ipairs(br.groups) do
			label(f, g.name, Vector2.new((g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, br.skinZ + 4), g.x1 - g.x0 + TOOL_CELL - 1, 2.5, BUNDLE_PLATE)
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(br.cells) do
			local _, ink = tierInk(c.tier)
			label(f, c.name, Vector2.new(c.x, br.padZ - 3.4), TOOL_CELL - 1, 1.8, SLOT_PLATE, ink)
		end
	end
	f.Parent = workspace
end

-- carry out a tool plan in ONE undo step — answers ok, message
function Importer.toolTidy(plan)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Tidy the tool skins")
	local moved, padsDone = 0, 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for _, mv in ipairs(plan.moves) do
			local folder = Slots.toolFolder(mv.tool, true)
			if mv.inst.Parent ~= folder then mv.inst.Parent = folder end
			-- what the room's sync and the plugin's lists look for
			if mv.inst:IsA("Model") and not CollectionService:HasTag(mv.inst, Slots.TOOL[mv.tool].tag) then
				CollectionService:AddTag(mv.inst, Slots.TOOL[mv.tool].tag)
			end
			if Importer.placeAt(mv.inst, mv.tool, mv.x, mv.z) then moved += 1 end
		end
		for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
			local folder = padsFolderOf(tool)
			local pads = padsOf(tool)
			local cells = plan.cells[tool] or {}
			for i, c in ipairs(cells) do
				local p = pads[i] or newPad(tool, folder)
				setPad(p, c.x, c.padZ)
				padsDone += 1
			end
			for i = #cells + 1, #pads do
				pads[i].Parent = nil -- not Destroy: Ctrl+Z brings it back
			end
		end
		Importer.buildToolLabels(plan.layout)
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Tidy stopped: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, ("Moved %d tool skins into their rows, each with its pad (%d pads). Ctrl+Z undoes it all; save the place to keep it.")
		:format(moved, padsDone)
end

-- a new import: at the end of its row with a pad of its own in front (Tidy sorts it into its tier)
function Importer.toolAppend(inst, tool)
	local padZ, skinZ = rowZ(tool)
	local endX = TOOL_START_X - TOOL_CELL
	for _, m in ipairs(toolEntries(tool)) do
		if m ~= inst then
			local p = m:IsA("Model") and m:GetBoundingBox().Position or m.Position
			if math.abs(p.Z - skinZ) < 3 then endX = math.max(endX, p.X) end
		end
	end
	local x = endX + TOOL_CELL
	Importer.placeAt(inst, tool, x, skinZ)
	setPad(newPad(tool, padsFolderOf(tool)), x, padZ)
	return x
end

-- IMPORT a website tool skin: a Model named after it holding its mesh, tagged, in its tool's folder,
-- standing in its grid cell, the mount attributes of a skin of the same tool to start from, and
-- ZAALNeedsReview until it has been checked in the hand — answers ok, message, model
function Importer.importTool(row, rows)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	local def = tool and Slots.TOOL[tool]
	if not def then return false, tostring(row.name) .. " is not a Sword, Flintlock or Bucket skin." end
	if Importer.toolModel(row.name, tool) then return false, row.name .. " is already in this place — use Update." end
	local mesh, why = loadToolMesh(row)
	if not mesh then return false, why end
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Import " .. row.name)
	local model, fitFrom
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = row.name
		mesh.Name = row.name
		local donor = toolDonor(tool)
		local scale = meshScale(donor and donor:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true))
		if scale and math.abs(scale - 1) > 1e-3 then mesh.Size = mesh.MeshSize * scale * fbxFactor(row) end
		mesh.Parent = model
		local fitted = {}
		for _, set in ipairs({ def.required, def.optional }) do
			for attr in pairs(set) do
				local v = donor and donor:GetAttribute(attr)
				if v ~= nil then
					model:SetAttribute(attr, v)
					table.insert(fitted, attr)
				end
			end
		end
		model:SetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteId", row.id)
		model:SetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteVersion", tonumber(row.version))
		-- no Confirm step any more (2026-10-03, the owner: the same workflow as the ship): it opens in
		-- the hand, is adjusted there and Applied
		CollectionService:AddTag(model, def.tag)
		model.Parent = Slots.toolFolder(tool, true)
		Importer.toolAppend(model, tool) -- the end of its row, with its own pad (Tidy sorts it by tier)
		fitFrom = donor and donor.Name or nil
		model:SetAttribute("ZAALScaledBy", scale and math.floor(scale * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000 or nil)
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Import of " .. row.name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err) end
	local from = fitFrom
	return true, row.name .. " imported" .. (from and (" — fit copied from " .. from .. "; check it in the hand.") or " — set its fit in the hand."), model
end

-- UPDATE a tool skin already here to the website's newest version: the mesh is swapped where the old
-- one stood, the fit (mount attributes) kept — answers ok, message, model
function Importer.updateTool(row)
	local tool = Importer.toolOf(row)
	local model = tool and Importer.toolModel(row.name, tool)
	if not model then return false, tostring(row.name) .. " is not in this place." end
	local mesh, why = loadToolMesh(row)
	if not mesh then return false, why end
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Update " .. row.name)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local old = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
		local at = old and old.CFrame
		local scale = meshScale(old)
		if scale and math.abs(scale - 1) > 1e-3 then mesh.Size = mesh.MeshSize * scale * fbxFactor(row) end
		mesh.Name = old and old.Name or row.name
		if old then
			for _, c in ipairs(old:GetChildren()) do
				if not (c:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or c:IsA("JointInstance") or c:IsA("WeldConstraint")) then c.Parent = mesh end
			end
			old:Destroy()
		end
		mesh.Parent = model
		if at then mesh.CFrame = at end
		model:SetAttribute("ZAALWebsiteVersion", tonumber(row.version))
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Update of " .. row.name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, row.name .. " updated to v" .. tostring(row.version) .. " — its fit kept; check it in the hand.", model
end

return Importer
modules.Main:
