end

local function attrEditor(model, order)
	local card = Theme.card("Attributes of " .. model.Name, order)
	local names = {}
	for k in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
		if k:sub(1, 4) ~= "RBX_" then table.insert(names, k) end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	if #names == 0 then
		T("This model has no attributes.", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
		return card
	end
	for i, k in ipairs(names) do
		local v = model:GetAttribute(k)
		local kind = typeof(v)
		local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = i })
		T(k, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextWrapped = false }).Parent = row
		local function show(x)
			local t = typeof(x)
			if t == "Color3" then return Theme.rgb(x) end
			if t == "Vector3" then return string.format("%.3f, %.3f, %.3f", x.X, x.Y, x.Z) end
			if t == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", x) end
			if t == "Font" then return x.Family:match("([^/]+)%.json$") or x.Family end
			if t == "CFrame" then return string.format("pos %.3f, %.3f, %.3f", x.X, x.Y, x.Z) end
			return tostring(x)
		end
		if kind == "boolean" then
			local b
			b = Theme.button(v and "On" or "Off", v and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				recorded("Attribute " .. k, function() model:SetAttribute(k, not model:GetAttribute(k)) end)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 28), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None })
			b.Parent = row
		elseif kind == "number" or kind == "string" or kind == "Vector3" or kind == "Color3" then
			if kind == "Color3" then
				new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.5, -10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = v, BorderSizePixel = 0 },
					{ Theme.corner(5), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) }).Parent = row
			end
			local off = kind == "Color3" and 28 or 0
			local box = Theme.input("", show(v), { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, off, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -off, 0, 28),
				FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 12 })
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = box.Text
				local nv
				if kind == "number" then
					nv = tonumber(txt)
				elseif kind == "string" then
					nv = txt
				elseif kind == "Vector3" then
					local a, b, c = txt:match("^%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)[,%s]+(%-?[%d%.]+)[,%s]+(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*$")
					nv = a and Vector3.new(tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)) or nil
				elseif kind == "Color3" then
					nv = Theme.parseColor(txt)
				end
				if nv ~= nil then
					recorded("Attribute " .. k, function() model:SetAttribute(k, nv) end)
					ctx.toast(k .. " = " .. show(nv), "ok")
				else
					box.Text = show(model:GetAttribute(k))
					ctx.toast("Could not read '" .. txt .. "' as a " .. kind .. ".", "warn")
				end
			end)
			box.Parent = row
		else
			T(show(v) .. "  (" .. kind .. ", edit in Properties)", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12,
				Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = row
		end
		row.Parent = card
	end
	return card
end

-- LIGHT & VFX: a lantern's light and flame are PROPERTIES of CandleRig.Fitile's PointLight and
-- its ParticleEmitters (CandleFire / CandleLight / CandleSmoke), not attributes. Approve copies
-- that Fitile into SkinAppearances, so these are exactly what the game shows.
local function fmt(x) return string.format("%.3g", x) end

local function editRow(card, order, label, current, parse, apply, swatch)
	local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = order })
	T(label, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd }).Parent = row
	local off = 0
	if swatch then
		new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.5, -10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = swatch, BorderSizePixel = 0 },
			{ Theme.corner(5), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) }).Parent = row
		off = 28
	end
	local box = Theme.input("", current, { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, off, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -off, 0, 28), FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 12 })
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local v = parse(box.Text)
		if v == nil then
			box.Text = current
			ctx.toast("Could not read '" .. box.Text .. "'.", "warn")
			return
		end
		recorded(label, function() apply(v) end)
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end)
	box.Parent = row
	row.Parent = card
end

local function num(s) return tonumber((s:gsub("%s", ""))) end
local function range(s)
	local a, b = s:match("^%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*[%-–,to%s]+%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*$")
	if a then return NumberRange.new(math.min(tonumber(a), tonumber(b)), math.max(tonumber(a), tonumber(b))) end
	local one = tonumber((s:gsub("%s", "")))
	return one and NumberRange.new(one) or nil
end

local function lightEditor(model, order)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
	local fitile = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
	if not fitile then return nil end
	local card = Theme.card("Light & VFX of " .. model.Name, order)
	T("CandleRig.Fitile — what the game shows on every lantern of this skin. Colours: r, g, b or #hex.",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = card
	local o = 0
	local function nextOrder() o += 1 return o end
	for _, light in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if light:IsA("Light") then
			T(light.Name, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = nextOrder() }).Parent = card
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Colour", Theme.rgb(light.Color), Theme.parseColor, function(v) light.Color = v end, light.Color)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Brightness", fmt(light.Brightness), num, function(v) light.Brightness = v end)
			if light:IsA("PointLight") or light:IsA("SpotLight") then
				editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Range", fmt(light.Range), num, function(v) light.Range = v end)
			end
			local sh = Theme.row(8, nextOrder(), 30)
			T("Shadows", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = sh
			Theme.button(light.Shadows and "On" or "Off", light.Shadows and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				recorded("Shadows", function() light.Shadows = not light.Shadows end)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = sh
			sh.Parent = card
		end
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local kp = e.Color.Keypoints
			local c0, c1 = kp[1].Value, kp[#kp].Value
			local head = Theme.row(8, nextOrder(), 30)
			T(e.Name, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = head
			Theme.button(e.Enabled and "On" or "Off", e.Enabled and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				recorded(e.Name .. " on/off", function() e.Enabled = not e.Enabled end)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = head
			head.Parent = card
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Start colour", Theme.rgb(c0), Theme.parseColor, function(v)
				local k = e.Color.Keypoints
				k[1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, v)
				e.Color = ColorSequence.new(k)
			end, c0)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "End colour", Theme.rgb(c1), Theme.parseColor, function(v)
				local k = e.Color.Keypoints
				k[#k] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, v)
				e.Color = ColorSequence.new(k)
			end, c1)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Rate", fmt(e.Rate), num, function(v) e.Rate = v end)
			local sk = e.Size.Keypoints
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Size (start)", fmt(sk[1].Value), num, function(v)
				-- scale the whole size curve so its shape is kept
				local k = e.Size.Keypoints
				local f = (k[1].Value ~= 0) and (v / k[1].Value) or nil
				local out = {}
				for i, p in ipairs(k) do
					out[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p.Time, f and p.Value * f or (i == 1 and v or p.Value), p.Envelope)
				end
				e.Size = NumberSequence.new(out)
			end)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Lifetime (min – max)", fmt(e.Lifetime.Min) .. " – " .. fmt(e.Lifetime.Max), range, function(v) e.Lifetime = v end)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Speed (min – max)", fmt(e.Speed.Min) .. " – " .. fmt(e.Speed.Max), range, function(v) e.Speed = v end)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Light emission", fmt(e.LightEmission), num, function(v) e.LightEmission = math.clamp(v, 0, 1) end)
			local tk = e.Transparency.Keypoints
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Transparency (start)", fmt(tk[1].Value), num, function(v)
				local k = e.Transparency.Keypoints
				k[1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, math.clamp(v, 0, 1), k[1].Envelope)
				e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(k)
			end)
		end
	end
	return card
end

-- THEME TIER (owner only: needs the website token) ------------------------------------------
-- One tier for every skin of the theme, on the website (Robux product) and in the game (gold
-- price, economy itemTier) in ONE change: Check runs it as a dry run, Apply writes it.
local TIERS = { { "common", "Common" }, { "rare", "Rare" }, { "epic", "Epic" }, { "legendary", "Legendary" } }
local tierState = { theme = nil, pick = nil, plan = nil, busy = false, fetched = {} }

local function themeSkins(theme)
	local skins, names = {}, {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			table.insert(skins, s)
			table.insert(names, s.key)
		end
	end
	return skins, names
end

local function cap(s)
	if type(s) == "table" then s = s.tier end -- the website answers from / to as { tier, price, exclusive }
	return type(s) == "string" and (s:sub(1, 1):upper() .. s:sub(2)) or "no tier"
end

local function renderThemeTier(head)
	local theme = tab.theme
	if tierState.theme ~= theme then
		tierState.theme, tierState.pick, tierState.plan = theme, nil, nil
	end
	local skins, names = themeSkins(theme)

	-- what the website says now; ask once per theme when some are not known yet
	local now, missing, unknown = {}, {}, false
	for _, s in ipairs(skins) do
		local n = s.key
		local row = Website.get(n, s.slot)
		if row == nil then
			unknown = true
		elseif row == false or not row.merch then
			table.insert(missing, n)
		else
			local t = row.tier and cap(row.tier) or "No tier"
			now[t] = (now[t] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	if unknown and not tierState.fetched[theme] then
		tierState.fetched[theme] = true
		task.spawn(function()
			Website.fetch(names)
			if tab.theme == theme then PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
		end)
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, t in ipairs({ "Common", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "No tier" }) do
		if now[t] then table.insert(parts, now[t] .. " " .. t) end
	end
	if #missing > 0 then table.insert(parts, #missing .. " not for sale on the website") end

	T("THEME TIER  ·  owner", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 50 }).Parent = head
	T("Sets every " .. theme .. " skin (" .. #names .. ") to one tier: the website's Robux product and the game's gold price, in one change. "
		.. (unknown and "Asking the website what they are now…" or ("Now: " .. (#parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ", ") or "nothing on the website") .. ".")),
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 60 }).Parent = head

	-- narrow dock: the actions get their own line under the tiers
	local r3 = Theme.row(8, 70, 32)
	local actions = tab.narrow and Theme.row(8, 75, 32) or r3
	Theme.segmented(TIERS, tierState.pick or "", function(k)
		tierState.pick, tierState.plan = k, nil
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r3
	local checkB, checkApi = Theme.button(tierState.busy and "Working…" or "Check", "secondary", function()
		if tierState.busy or not tierState.pick then return end
		tierState.busy = true
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		local ok, data = Website.setTiers(skins, tierState.pick, true)
		tierState.busy = false
		if ok then
			tierState.plan = { tier = tierState.pick, data = data }
		else
			ctx.toast(data, "bad")
		end
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
	checkApi.setEnabled(tierState.pick ~= nil and not tierState.busy)
	checkB.Parent = actions
	local plan = tierState.plan
	local willChange = plan and ((plan.data.would_update or 0) > 0 or (plan.data.game_changed or 0) > 0)
	local applyB, applyApi = Theme.button(plan and ("Apply " .. cap(plan.tier) .. " to " .. (plan.data.would_update or 0) .. " skins") or "Apply",
		"primary", function()
		if tierState.busy or not plan then return end
		tierState.busy = true
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		local ok, data = Website.setTiers(skins, plan.tier, false)
		tierState.busy = false
		tierState.plan = nil
		if ok then
			local msg = (data.updated or 0) .. " set to " .. cap(plan.tier) .. " on the website"
				.. (data.game_published and ", game gold tiers published" or "")
				.. (data.game_error and (" — game NOT published: " .. tostring(data.game_error)) or "")
				.. ((data.failed or 0) > 0 and (" · " .. data.failed .. " refused") or "") .. "."
			ctx.toast(msg, data.game_error and "warn" or "ok")
			tierState.fetched[theme] = nil
		else
			ctx.toast(data, "bad")
		end
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
	applyApi.setEnabled(willChange and not tierState.busy or false)
	applyB.Parent = actions
	r3.Parent = head
	if actions ~= r3 then actions.Parent = head end

	-- the dry run, in words: what changes, what is refused and why, and the game side
	if plan then
		local lines = {}
		local byStatus = { ["would update"] = {}, unchanged = {}, failed = {} }
		for _, r in ipairs(plan.data.results or {}) do
			local list = byStatus[r.status]
			if list then
				table.insert(list, r.status == "would update" and (r.asset .. " " .. cap(r.from) .. "→" .. cap(r.to))
					or r.status == "failed" and (r.asset .. ": " .. tostring(r.message or "refused"))
					or r.asset)
			end
		end
		if #byStatus["would update"] > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Will change: " .. table.concat(byStatus["would update"], ", ")) end
		if #byStatus.unchanged > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Already " .. cap(plan.tier) .. ": " .. table.concat(byStatus.unchanged, ", ")) end
		if #byStatus.failed > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Refused (left as they are): " .. table.concat(byStatus.failed, " · ")) end
		if plan.data.game_error then
			table.insert(lines, "Game: NOT published — " .. tostring(plan.data.game_error))
		elseif plan.data.game_would_publish then
			table.insert(lines, "Game: " .. tostring(plan.data.game_changed) .. " gold tiers will be published.")
		elseif plan.data.game_message then
			table.insert(lines, "Game: " .. tostring(plan.data.game_message))
		end
		if plan.data.game_warning then table.insert(lines, "Warning: " .. tostring(plan.data.game_warning)) end
		if not willChange then table.insert(lines, "Nothing to change.") end
		T(table.concat(lines, "\n"), { TextColor3 = #byStatus.failed > 0 and col.warn or col.text, LayoutOrder = 80 }).Parent = head
	end
end

-- TIER FOR ONE SKIN (owner) ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Opened from a set row's tier chip. Picks the tier (and, for a skin not on sale yet,
-- Exclusive = season pass / bundle only, no price): the website's Robux product and the
-- game's gold price change together, like the Ship skins tab's Tier card. The website only
-- tiers a skin that is on sale — a price (set on the Merch page) or Exclusive.
function renderTierPicker(parent, skin, order)
	local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col.raised, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order }, { Theme.corner(6), Theme.pad(8, 10, 8, 10), Theme.vlist(6) })
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local onSale = type(web) == "table" and (web.price ~= nil or web.exclusive == true)
	T("Tier for " .. skin.key .. (type(web) == "table" and (web.price and ("  ·  " .. web.price .. " gold") or (web.exclusive and "  ·  Exclusive" or "  ·  no price yet: Set tier puts it on sale at the tier price")) or "  ·  not on the website"),
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = box
	local r1 = Theme.row(8, 2, 30)
	Theme.segmented(TIERS, tab.tierPick or "", function(k)
		tab.tierPick = k
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r1
	r1.Parent = box
	local r2 = Theme.row(8, 3, 30)
	if not onSale then
		Theme.segmented({ { "no", "On sale at tier price" }, { "yes", "Exclusive" } }, tab.tierExclusive and "yes" or "no", function(k)
			tab.tierExclusive = k == "yes" or nil
			PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r2
	end
	local setB, setApi = Theme.button(tierState.busy and "Working…" or "Set tier", "primary", function()
		if tierState.busy or not tab.tierPick then return end
		tierState.busy = true
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		local ok, msg = Website.setTier(skin.key, tab.tierPick, tab.tierExclusive, skin.slot)
		tierState.busy = false
		if ok then
			tab.tierEdit = nil
			tierState.fetched[tab.theme] = nil
			Website.fetch({ skin.key })
		end
		ctx.toast(ok and (skin.key .. ": " .. tostring(msg))
			or tostring(msg),
			ok and "ok" or "bad")
		PreviewTab.renderList()
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
	setApi.setEnabled(tab.tierPick ~= nil and not tierState.busy and type(web) == "table")
	setB.Parent = r2
	Theme.button("Cancel", "ghost", function()
		tab.tierEdit = nil
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = r2
	r2.Parent = box
	box.Parent = parent
end

local NARROW = 600 -- detail width (px) below which the set rows stack
local widthConn
function PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	local d = ctx.ui.detail
	tab.narrow = d.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and d.AbsoluteSize.X < NARROW
	if not widthConn then
		-- re-lay the rows when the dock is resized across the threshold
		widthConn = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			local narrow = d.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and d.AbsoluteSize.X < NARROW
			if narrow ~= tab.narrow and ctx.active() then PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
		end)
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
	if not tab.theme then
		local empty = Theme.card(nil, 1)
		T("Pick a theme on the left to see the whole set on the ship.", { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 16, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = empty
		T("Then swap any slot, nudge pieces, drag them on the ship and take the edits back, tune the model's attributes, and flip day / night to judge the lights.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = empty
		empty.Parent = d
		return
	end

	-- HEADER + LIGHTING
	local head = Theme.card(nil, 1)
	T(tab.theme .. " — the whole set", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 20, LayoutOrder = 10 }).Parent = head
	T("On " .. Preview.SHIP_NAME .. ", placed by the game's own code. Everything you change here is a real edit of the Assets models (Ctrl+Z undoes each).",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 20 }).Parent = head
	-- narrow dock: the body switch and Restore lighting drop to their own lines

	local bodyRow = tab.narrow and Theme.row(8, 35, 32) or r1

		tab.body = k == "theme"

	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = bodyRow
	r1.Parent = head
	if bodyRow ~= r1 then bodyRow.Parent = head end
	-- time of day: the top bar (Studio / Day / Sunset / Night), for every tab
	if Website.ownerToken() then renderThemeTier(head) end
	head.Parent = d

	-- THE SET
	local setCard = Theme.card("The set", 2)
	local all = bySlot()
	local order = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local list = all[slot]
		if list and #list > 0 then

modules.Review:
--[[
	Review — designers adjust, the owner approves.

	Owner mode = this computer has the owner's website agent token (only the owner can
	make one; the website refuses any other). Everyone else is in Designer mode: they
	can preview, adjust, set up faces / lights / text, tune body colours and colour
	ships — all edits of the Assets models — but Approve (writing the shop Packages)
	and Tier (website + game price) are the owner's. A designer's Approve is "Send for
	review": attributes on the model say who asked, when and why, and the owner's
	Review filter lists them. The owner's Approve clears them.

	This is a convenience, not the security: see docs/notes/shipyard/zaal-assets-plugin.md
	§Designers (package and place publish permissions are what actually protect live).
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)

local Review = {}

local A_STATE, A_BY, A_AT, A_NOTE = "ZAALReview", "ZAALReviewBy", "ZAALReviewAt", "ZAALReviewNote"

function Review.isOwner()
	return Website.isOwnerToken()
end

local myName
function Review.me()
	if myName then return myName end
	local ok, id = pcall(function() return game:GetService("StudioService"):GetUserId() end)
	if ok and id and id > 0 then
		local okName, name = pcall(Players.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, Players, id)
		myName = okName and name or ("user " .. id)
	else
		myName = "a designer"
	end
	return myName
end

local function recorded(name, fn)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsReview", name)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	return ok, err
end

function Review.mark(inst, note)
	local who = Review.me()
	return recorded("Send " .. inst.Name .. " for review", function()
		inst:SetAttribute(A_STATE, "ready")
		inst:SetAttribute(A_BY, who)
		inst:SetAttribute(A_AT, os.time())
		inst:SetAttribute(A_NOTE, (note and #note > 0) and note or nil)
	end)
end

function Review.clear(inst)
	if not inst or inst:GetAttribute(A_STATE) == nil then return true end
	return recorded("Clear review of " .. inst.Name, function()
		for _, a in ipairs({ A_STATE, A_BY, A_AT, A_NOTE }) do inst:SetAttribute(a, nil) end
	end)
end

-- { by, at, note } when the instance waits for the owner, else nil
function Review.get(inst)
	if not inst or inst:GetAttribute(A_STATE) ~= "ready" then return nil end
	return { by = inst:GetAttribute(A_BY) or "someone", at = inst:GetAttribute(A_AT), note = inst:GetAttribute(A_NOTE) }
end

function Review.ago(t)
	if type(t) ~= "number" then return "" end
	local s = os.time() - t
	if s < 90 then return "just now" end
	if s < 5400 then return math.floor(s / 60 + 0.5) .. " min ago" end
	if s < 129600 then return math.floor(s / 3600 + 0.5) .. " h ago" end
	return math.floor(s / 86400 + 0.5) .. " days ago"
end

function Review.text(info)
	return "Sent for review by " .. tostring(info.by) .. " " .. Review.ago(info.at)
		.. (info.note and (": \"" .. info.note .. "\"") or ".")
end

return Review
modules.Screenshot:
--[[
	Screenshot — the owner's Studio view for a "Needs fix" (2026-10-03, the owner: "take a screenshot
	from my Studio viewpoint and attach it, medium resolution", "lighter is better").

	CaptureService works in edit mode and gives a temporary capture; AssetService opens it as an
	EditableImage whose pixels can be read. It is drawn down to WIDTH pixels wide (medium), each
	pixel packed into 2 bytes (RGB565: 5 / 6 / 5 bits — invisible on a screenshot) and Zstd-compressed
	— Roblox compresses with Zstd only, so the plugin cannot write a PNG or a JPEG itself; the website
	(1.112.0, studioScreenshot.ts) turns it into a JPEG. Measured on the owner's view: 1833×1413 →
	960×740, ~470 KB sent, packed in 0.04 s, ~100 KB stored.

	    Screenshot.take() -> shot | nil, why
	        shot = { width, height, format, data (base64 string), image (EditableImage, for the preview) }
	    Screenshot.payload(shot) -> what the website's `screenshot` field takes
	    Screenshot.discard(shot)   frees the preview image
]]

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
local CaptureService = game:GetService("CaptureService")
local EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")

local Screenshot = {}

local WIDTH = 960
local FORMAT = "rgb565-zstd"

function Screenshot.take()
	local captured
	local okCall, callErr = pcall(function()
		CaptureService:CaptureScreenshot(function(contentId) captured = contentId end)
	end)
	if not okCall then return nil, "Studio would not take a screenshot: " .. tostring(callErr) end
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while captured == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 6 do task.wait(0.05) end
	if not captured then return nil, "The screenshot did not arrive — try again." end

	local okSrc, src = pcall(function() return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(captured)) end)
	if not okSrc then return nil, "Could not read the screenshot: " .. tostring(src) end
	local scale = math.min(1, WIDTH / src.Size.X)
	local w = math.max(16, math.floor(src.Size.X * scale + 0.5))
	local h = math.max(16, math.floor(src.Size.Y * scale + 0.5))
	local okDst, dst = pcall(function() return AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(w, h) }) end)
	if not okDst then
		src:Destroy()
		return nil, "Could not make the small copy: " .. tostring(dst)
	end
	dst:DrawImageTransformed(Vector2.new(w / 2, h / 2), Vector2.new(scale, scale), 0, src,
		{ CombineType = Enum.ImageCombineType.Overwrite })
	src:Destroy()

	local rgba = dst:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, dst.Size)
	local px = w * h
	local packed = buffer.create(px * 2)
	for p = 0, px - 1 do
		local r, g, b = buffer.readu8(rgba, p * 4), buffer.readu8(rgba, p * 4 + 1), buffer.readu8(rgba, p * 4 + 2)
		buffer.writeu16(packed, p * 2, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.rshift(r, 3), 11), bit32.lshift(bit32.rshift(g, 2), 5), bit32.rshift(b, 3)))
	end
	local okZ, z = pcall(function() return EncodingService:CompressBuffer(packed, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd, 9) end)
	if not okZ then
		dst:Destroy()
		return nil, "Could not pack the screenshot: " .. tostring(z)
	end
	return {
		width = w,
		height = h,
		format = FORMAT,
		data = buffer.tostring(EncodingService:Base64Encode(z)),
		image = dst,
	}
end

function Screenshot.payload(shot)
	return { width = shot.width, height = shot.height, format = shot.format, data = shot.data }
end

function Screenshot.discard(shot)
	if shot and shot.image then
		pcall(function() shot.image:Destroy() end)
		shot.image = nil
	end
end

return Screenshot
modules.Setup:
--[[
	Setup — the one-click extras a new skin model needs before it can go in the shop.

	Wheel   Add face        a FaceRig copied from another wheel skin. A donor with the
	                        SAME hub mesh gives its exact place and scale; otherwise the
	                        newest face is used and pushed out to this hub's front surface
	                        (measured by raycast against both hubs).
	Lantern Add light       a CandleRig (light + fire / glow / smoke) copied from
	                        LanternDefaultFinal, placed like a lantern with the same base
	                        mesh (or MidNightLantern), tinted: light, fire end and smoke
	                        start take the colour, the glow stays warm (the 09-23 recipe).
	Board   Add name text   a BoardTextPlane on the board's front + the Text* attributes
	                        (font, colours, outline, scale) the game reads.

	Every action is one undo step (Ctrl+Z) and is a real edit of the model — save the place.
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local ShipNameText = require(script.Parent.ShipNameText)

local Setup = {}

local WARM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 237, 209)

local function recorded(name, fn)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsSetup", name)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	return ok, err
end

local function pieceFor(model, slot, socket)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("MeshPart") and Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name) == socket then return p end
	end
	return nil
end

local function anchorAll(inst)
	for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true end
	end
end

-- the front surface of a hub along -Z (its local frame), at (x, y) in pivot space
local function hubFront(hub, x, y)
	local piv = hub:GetPivot()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { hub }
	local res = workspace:Raycast(piv * Vector3.new(x, y, -8), piv:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, 16)), params)
	return res and piv:PointToObjectSpace(res.Position).Z or nil
end

-- WHEEL -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Setup.faceDonor(model)
	local folder = model.Parent
	local hub = pieceFor(model, "Wheel", "RotationPart")
	local same, newest
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if m ~= model and m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChild("FaceRig") then
			local h = pieceFor(m, "Wheel", "RotationPart")
			if h then
				if hub and h.MeshId == hub.MeshId then same = same or { model = m, hub = h } end
				if m.Name == "MidNightWheel" or not newest then newest = { model = m, hub = h } end
			end
		end
	end
	return same, newest
end

function Setup.addFace(model)
	local hub = pieceFor(model, "Wheel", "RotationPart")
	if not hub then return false, "No RotationPart (hub) piece to put the face on." end
	local same, other = Setup.faceDonor(model)
	local donor = same or other
	if not donor then return false, "No other wheel has a FaceRig to copy." end
	local rig = donor.model.FaceRig
	local rel = donor.hub:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(rig:GetPivot())
	local how = "copied from " .. donor.model.Name .. " (same hub)"
	if not same then
		local zNew = hubFront(hub, rel.X, rel.Y)
		local zOld = hubFront(donor.hub, rel.X, rel.Y)
		if zNew and zOld then
			rel = CFrame.new(rel.X, rel.Y, rel.Z + (zNew - zOld)) * rel.Rotation
			how = string.format("copied from %s and moved %.2f studs to this hub's front", donor.model.Name, zNew - zOld)
		else
			how = "copied from " .. donor.model.Name .. " (could not measure this hub — check the depth)"
		end
	end
	local ok, err = recorded("Add face to " .. model.Name, function()
		local old = model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig")
		if old then old:Destroy() end
		local copy = rig:Clone()
		copy.Parent = model
		copy:PivotTo(hub:GetPivot() * rel)
		anchorAll(copy)
	end)
	return ok, ok and ("Face added — " .. how .. ". Move / scale / recolour the FaceRig to taste.") or tostring(err)
end

-- LANTERN ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function candleSource()
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lantern")
	local ref = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("LanternDefaultFinal")
	return ref and ref:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
end

function Setup.tintCandle(rig, color)
	local fitile = rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
	if not fitile then return end
	for _, c in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Light") then
			c.Color = color
		elseif c:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if c.Name == "CandleFire" then
				c.Color = ColorSequence.new(WARM, color)
			elseif c.Name == "CandleSmoke" then
				c.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- the lantern's light and its effects, one at a time (CandleRig.Fitile is what the game copies
-- onto every lantern of the skin: the catalogue's SkinAppearances.Lantern.<Key>.Fitile)
function Setup.candleLight(model)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
	local fitile = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
	return fitile and fitile:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light") or nil
end

function Setup.candleEffects(model)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
	local fitile = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
	local out = {}
	if fitile then
		for _, c in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then table.insert(out, c) end
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Brightness / Range of the light by a step, one undo step
function Setup.nudgeLight(model, prop, delta, lo, hi)
	local light = Setup.candleLight(model)
	if not light then return false end
	return recorded(prop .. " of " .. model.Name .. "'s light", function()
		light[prop] = math.clamp(math.floor((light[prop] + delta) * 100 + 0.5) / 100, lo, hi)
	end)
end

-- an effect's colour at its START (birth) or END: the ends of its ColorSequence, the middle kept
function Setup.effectColour(e, which)
	local k = e.Color.Keypoints
	return which == "end" and k[#k].Value or k[1].Value
end

function Setup.setEffectColour(e, which, color, live)
	local function apply()
		local k = e.Color.Keypoints
		if which == "end" then
			k[#k] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color)
		else
			k[1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, color)
		end
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(k)
	end
	if live then apply() return true end
	return recorded(e.Name .. " colour", apply)
end

-- OFF = Rate 0, not Enabled = false: the game keeps each effect's Enabled from the LANTERN
-- (lit / unlit is that switch — SkinService applyExtras, LanternGrab), so a skin's Enabled = false
-- never sticks. Rate 0 does, in the preview and in game; the old rate is kept to turn it back on.
local RATE_KEPT = "ZAALRate"
function Setup.effectOn(e)
	return e.Rate > 0
end

function Setup.toggleEffect(e)
	return recorded(e.Name .. " on / off", function()
		if e.Rate > 0 then
			e:SetAttribute(RATE_KEPT, e.Rate)
			e.Rate = 0
		else
			e.Rate = tonumber(e:GetAttribute(RATE_KEPT)) or 10
			e:SetAttribute(RATE_KEPT, nil)
			e.Enabled = true
		end
	end)
end

function Setup.candleColor(model)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
	local light = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile") and rig.Fitile:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light")
	return light and light.Color or nil
end

function Setup.addCandle(model, color)
	local base = pieceFor(model, "Lantern", "Base")
	if not base then return false, "No Base piece to put the candle on." end
	local source = candleSource()
	if not source then return false, "No workspace.Lantern.LanternDefaultFinal.CandleRig to copy." end
	local donor, fallback
	for _, m in ipairs(model.Parent:GetChildren()) do
		if m ~= model and m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChild("CandleRig") and m.Name ~= "LanternDefaultFinal" then
			local b = pieceFor(m, "Lantern", "Base")
			if b then
				if b.MeshId == base.MeshId then donor = donor or { model = m, base = b } end
				if m.Name == "MidNightLantern" or not fallback then fallback = { model = m, base = b } end
			end
		end
	end
	local d = donor or fallback
	if not d then return false, "No other lantern has a CandleRig to measure from." end
	local rel = d.base:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(d.model.CandleRig:GetPivot())
	local ok, err = recorded("Add light to " .. model.Name, function()
		local old = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
		if old then old:Destroy() end
		local rig = source:Clone()
		rig.Parent = model
		rig:PivotTo(base:GetPivot() * rel)
		anchorAll(rig)
		if color then Setup.tintCandle(rig, color) end
		for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored = true end
		end
	end)
	return ok, ok and ("Light and VFX added, placed like " .. d.model.Name .. (donor and " (same base)" or "")
		.. ". Tune CandleRig.Fitile's PointLight and emitters to taste.") or tostring(err)
end

function Setup.recolorCandle(model, color)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
	if not rig then return false, "No CandleRig yet — add the light first." end
	local ok, err = recorded("Recolour light of " .. model.Name, function() Setup.tintCandle(rig, color) end)
	return ok, ok and "Light recoloured." or tostring(err)
end

-- BOARD -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Setup.FONTS = { "LuckiestGuy", "Bangers", "Creepster", "Balthazar", "FredokaOne", "GothamBlack",
	"PermanentMarker", "SpecialElite", "Cartoon", "IndieFlower", "Fondamento", "Arcade" }

local TEXT_DEFAULTS = {
	TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90),
	TextOutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 8),
	TextOutlineThickness = 2.5,
	TextScale = 1,
}

function Setup.addText(model)
	local piece
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("MeshPart") then piece = p break end
	end
	if not piece then return false, "No board mesh." end
	-- a board with the same mesh gives the exact plane
	local donorRel, donorSize
	for _, m in ipairs(model.Parent:GetChildren()) do
		if m ~= model and m:IsA("Model") then
			local dp = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
			local plane = m:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
			if dp and plane and dp.MeshId == piece.MeshId then
				donorRel, donorSize = dp.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(plane.CFrame), plane.Size
				break
			end
		end
	end
	local ok, err = recorded("Add name text to " .. model.Name, function()
		local old = model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
		if old then old:Destroy() end
		local plane = Instance.new("Part")
		plane.Name = "BoardTextPlane"
		plane.Anchored = true
		plane.CanCollide, plane.CanQuery, plane.CanTouch = false, false, false
		plane.Transparency = 1
		if donorRel then
			plane.Size = donorSize
			plane.CFrame = piece.CFrame * donorRel
		else
			-- the mesh's front (-Z) face, a hair proud of it; 90% × 80% of the board
			plane.Size = Vector3.new(piece.Size.X * 0.9, piece.Size.Y * 0.8, 0.05)
			plane.CFrame = piece.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(piece.Size.Z / 2) - 0.03)
		end
		plane.Parent = piece
		if typeof(model:GetAttribute("TextFont")) ~= "Font" then model:SetAttribute("TextFont", Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy)) end
		for k, v in pairs(TEXT_DEFAULTS) do
			if model:GetAttribute(k) == nil then model:SetAttribute(k, v) end
		end
		Setup.stampName(model)
	end)
	return ok, ok and ("Name text added" .. (donorRel and " (placed like a board with the same mesh)" or
		" on the board's front — drag / resize the BoardTextPlane until the name sits right") .. ".") or tostring(err)
end

-- THE NAME STAYS ON THE MODEL (2026-10-03, the owner: "I want it static on it, like the other boards"):
-- every finished board carries a saved ShipNameGui on its BoardTextPlane spelling its own name (SUNNY DAY,
-- SNAP JAW…). Each name-text change redraws it from the Text* attributes, inside the same undo step.
-- The words: the letters already there (a board may spell something else, e.g. MID NIGHT), else the
-- model's name without "Board", split at capitals (GhostyBooBoard -> GHOSTY BOO).
local function shownName(model, plane)
	local old = plane:FindFirstChild("ShipNameGui")
	if old then
		local letters, n = {}, 0
		for _, l in ipairs(old:GetChildren()) do
			local i = tonumber(l.Name:match("^L(%d+)$"))
			if i and l:IsA("TextLabel") then letters[i] = l.Text; n = math.max(n, i) end
		end
		if n > 0 then
			local out = {}
			for i = 1, n do out[i] = letters[i] or " " end
			return table.concat(out)
		end
	end
	local base = model.Name:gsub("[Bb][Oo][Aa][Rr][Dd]$", "")
	base = base:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("[_%-]+", " ")
	return base
end

function Setup.stampName(model)
	local plane = model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
	if not (plane and plane:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
	local font = model:GetAttribute("TextFont")
	if type(font) == "string" then
		local ok, e = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[font] end)
		font = ok and e and Font.fromEnum(e) or nil
	end
	local thick = model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineThickness")
	local scale = model:GetAttribute("TextScale")
	local curve = model:GetAttribute("TextCurve")
	local style = {
		font = typeof(font) == "Font" and font or ShipNameText.FONT,
		color = typeof(model:GetAttribute("TextColor")) == "Color3" and model:GetAttribute("TextColor") or ShipNameText.COLOR,
		outline = typeof(model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineColor")) == "Color3" and model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineColor") or ShipNameText.OUTLINE,
		thick = (type(thick) == "number" and thick >= 0) and thick or ShipNameText.THICK,
		scale = (type(scale) == "number" and scale > 0) and scale or 1,
		curve = (type(curve) == "number" and curve > 0) and curve or nil,
	}
	local name = shownName(model, plane)
	for _, g in ipairs(plane:GetChildren()) do
		if g:IsA("SurfaceGui") and g.Name == "ShipNameGui" then g:Destroy() end
	end
	local gui = ShipNameText.build(plane.Size, name, style)
	if gui then gui.Parent = plane end
end

-- a board with a text plane but no saved name yet (GhostyBoo, set up before 2026-10-03)
function Setup.ensureName(model)
	local plane = model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
	if plane and plane:IsA("BasePart") and not plane:FindFirstChild("ShipNameGui") then
		recorded("Name text on " .. model.Name, function() Setup.stampName(model) end)
	end
end

function Setup.setTextColor(model, color)
	return recorded("Name colour of " .. model.Name, function() model:SetAttribute("TextColor", color); Setup.stampName(model) end)
end

function Setup.setOutlineColor(model, color)
	return recorded("Name outline of " .. model.Name, function() model:SetAttribute("TextOutlineColor", color); Setup.stampName(model) end)
end

function Setup.nextFont(model, step)
	local cur = model:GetAttribute("TextFont")
	local curName = "LuckiestGuy"
	if typeof(cur) == "Font" then curName = cur.Family:match("([^/]+)%.json$") or curName end
	local i = table.find(Setup.FONTS, curName) or 0
	local nextName = Setup.FONTS[((i - 1 + (step or 1)) % #Setup.FONTS) + 1]
	local okEnum, e = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[nextName] end)
	if not okEnum or not e then return false, "Unknown font " .. nextName end
	local ok, err = recorded("Name font of " .. model.Name, function() model:SetAttribute("TextFont", Font.fromEnum(e)); Setup.stampName(model) end)
	return ok, ok and nextName or tostring(err)
end

function Setup.setTextScale(model, delta)
	local s = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("TextScale")) or 1
	local nextScale = math.clamp(math.floor((s + delta) * 20 + 0.5) / 20, 0.4, 2)
	local ok = recorded("Name size of " .. model.Name, function() model:SetAttribute("TextScale", nextScale); Setup.stampName(model) end)
	return ok, nextScale
end

-- how far the name bends: the arc radius as a fraction of the board width (the game's
-- ShipNameText; 1.15 when unset). Smaller = rounder; FLAT is wide enough to read as straight.
Setup.CURVE_DEFAULT = 1.15
Setup.CURVE_FLAT = 20
function Setup.curveOf(model)
	local c = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("TextCurve"))
	return (c and c > 0) and c or Setup.CURVE_DEFAULT
end

-- step = -1 rounder / +1 flatter; steps are ×1.25 so they feel even at every curve
function Setup.setCurve(model, step)
	local c = Setup.curveOf(model)
	local nextCurve = step == 0 and Setup.CURVE_DEFAULT
		or math.clamp(math.floor(c * (step > 0 and 1.25 or 0.8) * 100 + 0.5) / 100, 0.4, Setup.CURVE_FLAT)
	local ok = recorded("Name curve of " .. model.Name, function()
		model:SetAttribute("TextCurve", nextCurve ~= Setup.CURVE_DEFAULT and nextCurve or nil)
		Setup.stampName(model)
	end)
	return ok, nextCurve
end

function Setup.setOutlineThickness(model, delta)
	local t = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineThickness")) or TEXT_DEFAULTS.TextOutlineThickness
	local nextT = math.clamp(math.floor((t + delta) * 2 + 0.5) / 2, 0, 8)
	local ok = recorded("Name outline thickness of " .. model.Name, function() model:SetAttribute("TextOutlineThickness", nextT); Setup.stampName(model) end)
	return ok, nextT
end

-- the name's place on the board: move the BoardTextPlane along its own axes (X right, Y up,
-- Z into / out of the wood) or resize it (the letters fit its width; the row sits mid-height)
function Setup.movePlane(model, offset)
	local plane = model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
	if not plane then return false end
	return recorded("Move name of " .. model.Name, function() plane.CFrame = plane.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset) end)
end

function Setup.resizePlane(model, delta)
	local plane = model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
	if not plane then return false end
	return recorded("Resize name area of " .. model.Name, function()
		plane.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(plane.Size.X + delta.X, 0.5), math.max(plane.Size.Y + delta.Y, 0.2), plane.Size.Z)
		Setup.stampName(model)
	end)
end

-- FACE TUNING (the wheel's FaceRig). The game keeps FaceScale, each part's offset from the
-- hub and its colours (ShipSkins faceAttributes) — not part sizes, and not the eyes' own
-- offsets (Motor6Ds from the eyes' RootPart place them). So: the whole face moves, turns
-- and scales; a group (Eyes / Mouth / Nose) or a free part moves and turns; any part recolours.
local function hubOf(model)
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("MeshPart") and Slots.socketFor(Slots.SHIP.Wheel, p.Name) == "RotationPart" then return p end
	end
	return nil
end

-- JaEyes / Jaeyes are the eyes' placeholders (the face is laid out from them). Every rig files
-- them under Mouth, but they belong to the eyes: they move, turn and colour with Eyes. The game
-- keys face parts by NAME (Face_<Part>_Offset in hub space), so the group a part sits in does
-- not matter to it — only the plugin's grouping does.
local function isEyePart(d)
	return d.Name:lower() == "jaeyes" or (d.Parent ~= nil and d.Parent.Name == "Eyes")
end
Setup.isEyePart = isEyePart

local function inside(d, list)
	for _, x in ipairs(list) do
		if d == x or d:IsDescendantOf(x) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- { { label, insts, anchor } } the face controls can move: the whole face, its groups (Eyes with
-- the placeholders; Mouth without them), its free parts. anchor's pivot is what turns about.
function Setup.faceTargets(model)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig")
	if not rig then return {} end
	local motorDriven, placeholders = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then motorDriven[d.Part1] = true end
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name:lower() == "jaeyes" then table.insert(placeholders, d) end
	end
	local out = { { "Whole face", { rig }, rig } }
	local eyesDone = false
	for _, c in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name == "Eyes" then
			local list = { c }
			for _, p in ipairs(placeholders) do
				if not inside(p, list) then table.insert(list, p) end
			end
			table.insert(out, { "Eyes", list, c })
			eyesDone = true
		elseif c:IsA("Model") then
			local list = {}
			for _, k in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
				if (k:IsA("BasePart") or k:IsA("Model")) and not isEyePart(k) then table.insert(list, k) end
			end
			if #list > 0 then table.insert(out, { c.Name, list, c }) end
		elseif c:IsA("BasePart") and c.Transparency < 1 and not isEyePart(c) then
			table.insert(out, { c.Name, { c }, c })
		end
	end
	if not eyesDone and #placeholders > 0 then table.insert(out, { "Eyes", placeholders, placeholders[1] }) end
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Parent ~= rig and d.Transparency < 1 and not motorDriven[d] and not isEyePart(d) then
			table.insert(out, { d.Parent.Name .. " · " .. d.Name, { d }, d })
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- { { label, parts } } for colour: everything but the eyes first, then each visible part
-- (eye parts and the placeholders listed under Eyes)
function Setup.faceColourParts(model)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig")
	local out = {}
	if not rig then return out end
	local each, notEyes = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			local eye = isEyePart(d)
			if not eye then table.insert(notEyes, d) end
			table.insert(each, { (eye and "Eyes" or d.Parent.Name) .. " · " .. d.Name, { d } })
		end
	end
	if #notEyes > 1 then table.insert(out, { "All except eyes", notEyes }) end
	for _, e in ipairs(each) do
		table.insert(out, e)
	end
	return out
end

-- move (offset, studs) and / or turn (degrees about X / Y / Z) a face target, in the HUB's frame
-- (X across the wheel, Y up, Z out of the face) so the buttons mean the same on every wheel.
-- Every inst of the target moves as one, turning about the anchor's pivot.
function Setup.nudgeFace(model, target, offset, turn)
	local hub = hubOf(model)
	local frame = hub and hub.CFrame.Rotation or CFrame.new()
	local insts, anchor = target[2], target[3]
	return recorded("Adjust face of " .. model.Name, function()
		local p = anchor:GetPivot()
		local r = CFrame.new()
		if turn then r = frame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(turn.X), math.rad(turn.Y), math.rad(turn.Z)) * frame:Inverse() end
		local pos = p.Position + (offset and frame:VectorToWorldSpace(offset) or Vector3.zero)
		local delta = CFrame.new(pos) * r * p.Rotation * p:Inverse()
		local starts = {}
		for _, x in ipairs(insts) do
			starts[x] = x:GetPivot()
		end
		for _, x in ipairs(insts) do
			x:PivotTo(delta * starts[x])
		end
	end)
end

function Setup.scaleFace(model, factor)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig")
	if not rig then return false end
	return recorded("Face size of " .. model.Name, function() rig:ScaleTo(rig:GetScale() * factor) end)
end

-- a face part's colour: its SurfaceAppearance tint when it has one (what shows), else Color
function Setup.facePartColour(part)
	local sa = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
	return sa and sa.Color or part.Color
end

function Setup.setFacePartColour(part, color, live)
	local function apply()
		local sa = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
		if sa then sa.Color = color else part.Color = color end
	end
	if live then apply() return true end
	return recorded("Face colour of " .. part.Name, apply)
end

-- several parts to one colour in ONE undo step (colours = { [part] = Color3 } puts each back)
function Setup.setFaceColours(parts, color, live, colours)
	local function apply()
		for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
			Setup.setFacePartColour(part, colours and colours[part] or color, true)
		end
	end
	if live then apply() return true end
	return recorded("Face colours", apply)
end

-- what a model still needs: { kind = "face"|"candle"|"text", has = bool }
function Setup.status(skin)
	local m = skin.model
	if skin.slot == "Wheel" then return { kind = "face", has = m:FindFirstChild("FaceRig") ~= nil } end
	if skin.slot == "Lantern" then return { kind = "candle", has = m:FindFirstChild("CandleRig") ~= nil } end
	if skin.slot == "Board" then return { kind = "text", has = m:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true) ~= nil } end
	if skin.slot == "Cannon" then return { kind = "mouth", has = true } end
	if skin.slot == "Window" then return { kind = "window", has = true } end
	if skin.slot == "Anchor" then return { kind = "anchor", has = true } end
	return nil
end

return Setup
modules.ShipSkins:
--[[
	ShipSkins — ship skins in the Assets place.

	scan()        every skin model in the slot folders (workspace.<folder>)
	inspect(skin) the checks for its type, the catalogue row it would write, and
	              whether the catalogue already has that exact row
	approve(...)  writes the row into ReplicatedStorage.SkinCatalog and the art into
	              ServerStorage.SkinAppearances.<Slot>.<Key> — both Packages, so the
	              owner then clicks Publish Package on each (Roblox allows no script
	              to publish a Package)

	The row follows the game's mount rule (SkinService.mountMesh): a piece is
	PivotTo(socket frame), so `pivot` is the piece's authored PivotOffset verbatim,
	and `scale` is Size / MeshSize (the uploaded size CreateMeshPartAsync returns).
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local CatalogText = require(script.Parent.CatalogText)
local SkinSockets = require(script.Parent.SkinSockets)

local ShipSkins = {}

-- the socket names the template ship really has for a slot, read with the game's own
-- SkinSockets (a placeholder is <Socket>Template on the ship, e.g. AimTemplate -> Aim).
-- nil when the place has no ServerStorage.ShipTemplate or the slot is not a mesh slot.
local templateCache = {}
function ShipSkins.templateSockets(slot)
	if templateCache[slot] ~= nil then return templateCache[slot] or nil end
	local names = false
	local tpl = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ShipTemplate")
	local def = SkinSockets.slots[slot]
	if tpl and def and def.items and def.sockets then
		local ok, items = pcall(def.items, tpl)
		local item = ok and items and items[1]
		if item then
			local okS, sockets = pcall(def.sockets, item)
			if okS and sockets then
				names = {}
				for name, part in pairs(sockets) do
					if part then table.insert(names, name) end
				end
				table.sort(names)
			end
		end
	end
	templateCache[slot] = names
	return names or nil
end

-- the template's socket FRAMES for a slot's first item ([socket] = CFrame), read with the
-- game's own SkinSockets (so a door's left / right is decided the game's way)
local frameCache = {}
function ShipSkins.templateFrames(slot)
	if frameCache[slot] ~= nil then return frameCache[slot] or nil end
	local frames = false
	local tpl = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ShipTemplate")
	local def = SkinSockets.slots[slot]
	if tpl and def and def.items and def.sockets then
		local ok, items = pcall(def.items, tpl)
		local okS, sockets = false, nil
		if ok and items and items[1] then okS, sockets = pcall(def.sockets, items[1]) end
		if okS and sockets then
			frames = {}
			for name, part in pairs(sockets) do frames[name] = part.CFrame end
		end
	end
	frameCache[slot] = frames
	return frames or nil
end

local PIVOT_POS_BAD = 0.25 -- studs between where a piece mounts and where it is parked
local PIVOT_POS_WARN = 0.15 -- the AnchorDefault reference itself sits 0.127 off (known, harmless)
local PIVOT_ROT_BAD = 5 -- degrees
local PIVOT_OK_ATTR = "ZAALPivotsOK" -- "<pos>/<rot>" the owner accepted by eye (Looks right — keep as is)

function ShipSkins.available()
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		if workspace:FindFirstChild(Slots.SHIP[slot].folder) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function ShipSkins.catalogModule()
	return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SkinCatalog")
end

function ShipSkins.appearancesRoot()
	return ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SkinAppearances")
end

-- the catalogue as data (a clone is required, so a stale require cache never lies)
local catalogCache
function ShipSkins.catalogData(refresh)
	if refresh or not catalogCache then
		catalogCache = nil
		local m = ShipSkins.catalogModule()
		if m then
			local ok, data = pcall(require, m:Clone())
			if ok and type(data) == "table" then catalogCache = data end
		end
	end
	return catalogCache
end

local function isSkinModel(model, def)
	if def.texture then return model:IsA("MeshPart") end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return false end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(model)) do
		if Slots.NOT_A_SKIN_TAGS[t] then return false end
	end
	if model.Name == def.reference then return false end
	return not Slots.isReferenceName(model.Name)
end

-- the theme a key names (<Theme><Slot>), or nil when it does not end in the slot name
local function themeOf(key, slot)
	if #key > #slot and key:sub(-#slot):lower() == slot:lower() then return key:sub(1, #key - #slot) end
	return nil
end

-- { { slot, key, model, nameTheme, bareName }, ... } in panel order
function ShipSkins.scan()
	table.clear(templateCache) -- the template may have been edited since
	local out = {}
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
		if folder then
			local list = {}
			for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if isSkinModel(m, def) then
					table.insert(list, { slot = slot, key = m.Name, model = m, kind = "ship" })
				end
			end
			table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
			-- two models with one name would be ONE catalogue key: the second overwrites the first
			local seen = {}
			for _, s in ipairs(list) do
				local k = s.key:lower()
				if seen[k] then
					seen[k].duplicate = true
					s.duplicate = true
				end
				seen[k] = s
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(list) do table.insert(out, s) end
		end
	end
	-- THEME comes from the NAME (<Theme><Slot>; the shop prices and the website matches by it),
	-- never from the tag: designers copy a model and its old tag goes with it (2026-09-28: Cupid,
	-- Mango, PastelBlue and SilverStorm sails were all tagged GrapeFizz). A name that is a bare
	-- theme (SilverStorm in Sailes) is read as that theme, and the name check offers the rename.
	local known = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(out) do
		local t = themeOf(s.key, s.slot)
		if t then
			s.nameTheme = t
			known[t:lower()] = t
		end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(out) do
		if not s.nameTheme and known[s.key:lower()] then
			s.nameTheme = known[s.key:lower()]
			s.bareName = true
		end
	end
	-- how many skins each theme name has, so a disagreement can tell a lone misnamed piece
	-- (SkyBlueWheel tagged Sky, next to SkyLantern / SkyCannon / SkyAnchor) from a copied tag
	local count = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(out) do
		if s.nameTheme then count[s.nameTheme] = (count[s.nameTheme] or 0) + 1 end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(out) do s.themeCounts = count end
	return out
end

-- the skin's theme tag(s), without the SkinSurface_ / *Skin helper tags
local function themeTags(model)
	local list = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(model)) do
		if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" and not t:match("Skin$") then table.insert(list, t) end
	end
	return list
end
ShipSkins.themeTags = themeTags

-- a ship skin's theme: from its name (see scan), else its tag for a name that names no theme
function ShipSkins.themeOf(skin)
	return skin.nameTheme or themeTags(skin.model)[1]
end

function ShipSkins.inTheme(skin, theme)
	return theme ~= nil and ShipSkins.themeOf(skin) == theme
end

-- socket frames of the folder's reference model: [socket] = CFrame
local function referenceFrames(def)
	if not def.reference then return nil end
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
	local ref = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(def.reference)
	if not ref then return nil end
	local frames = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(ref:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			local s = Slots.socketFor(def, p.Name)
			if s and not frames[s] then frames[s] = p:GetPivot() end
		end
	end
	return frames
end

local function tagsOf(inst)
	return CollectionService:GetTags(inst)
end

local function scaleOf(part)
	local ms = part.MeshSize
	if ms.X <= 0 or ms.Y <= 0 or ms.Z <= 0 then return nil, "mesh not loaded" end
	local r = Vector3.new(part.Size.X / ms.X, part.Size.Y / ms.Y, part.Size.Z / ms.Z)
	local function near(a, b) return math.abs(a - b) <= 0.005 * math.max(math.abs(b), 1e-6) end
	if near(r.X, 1) and near(r.Y, 1) and near(r.Z, 1) then return nil end
	if near(r.Y, r.X) and near(r.Z, r.X) then return r.X end
	return r
end

local function check(list, level, text, fix)
	table.insert(list, { level = level, text = text, fix = fix })
end

-- the style of the board's name text, off the model's Text* attributes (the
-- attributes the BoardTextPreview plugin draws with)
local function boardText(model, piece)
	local plane = model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
	if not (plane and plane:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil, "no BoardTextPlane part (where the ship's name is drawn)" end
	local font = model:GetAttribute("TextFont")
	local family, weight, style = nil, nil, nil
	if typeof(font) == "Font" then
		family, weight, style = font.Family, font.Weight.Name, font.Style.Name
	elseif type(font) == "string" then
		local ok, e = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[font] end)
		if ok and e then
			local f = Font.fromEnum(e)
			family, weight, style = f.Family, f.Weight.Name, f.Style.Name
		end
	end
	local pieceFrame = piece.CFrame * piece.PivotOffset -- = the Board socket once mounted
	return {
		font = family,
		weight = weight,
		style = style,
		color = typeof(model:GetAttribute("TextColor")) == "Color3" and model:GetAttribute("TextColor") or nil,
		outline = typeof(model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineColor")) == "Color3" and model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineColor") or nil,
		thickness = type(model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineThickness")) == "number" and model:GetAttribute("TextOutlineThickness") or nil,
		scale = type(model:GetAttribute("TextScale")) == "number" and model:GetAttribute("TextScale") or nil,
		curve = type(model:GetAttribute("TextCurve")) == "number" and model:GetAttribute("TextCurve") or nil,
		plane = pieceFrame:ToObjectSpace(plane.CFrame),
		size = plane.Size,
	}
end

local function faceAttributes(rig, hub)
	local attrs = { FaceScale = rig:GetScale() }
	local hubCF = hub:GetPivot()
	local motorDriven = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then motorDriven[d.Part1] = true end
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			if not motorDriven[part] then attrs["Face_" .. part.Name .. "_Offset"] = hubCF:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) end
			attrs["Face_" .. part.Name .. "_Color"] = part.Color
			local sa = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
			if sa then attrs["Face_" .. part.Name .. "_SAColor"] = sa.Color end
		end
	end
	return attrs
end

-- write one row, comment line included (no trailing newline)
local function rowText(skin, plan, keep)
	local slot, def = skin.slot, Slots.SHIP[skin.slot]
	local key = keep.catalogKey or skin.key -- its developer product id once it has one (2026-10-03), else the name
	local tags = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(tagsOf(skin.model)) do
		if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" then table.insert(tags, t) end
	end
	-- the comment names the KEY first (CatalogText.findRow takes it as the row's), then the skin's name
	local comment = string.format("\t-- %s: Assets workspace.%s.%s%s (skin plugin %s)", key, def.folder, skin.model.Name,
		#tags > 0 and (", tag " .. table.concat(tags, ", ")) or "", os.date("%Y-%m-%d"))
	local head = {}
	-- an id-keyed row says who it is: the name it had (old saves and configs still name it so), the
	-- name players see, its Robux product (the game's fallback) and its theme (the AI, the tiers)
	if keep.legacy then table.insert(head, "legacy = " .. Util.str(keep.legacy)) end
	if keep.name then table.insert(head, "name = " .. Util.str(keep.name)) end
	if keep.productId then table.insert(head, "productId = " .. Util.num(keep.productId)) end
	if keep.theme and key ~= skin.key then table.insert(head, "theme = " .. Util.str(keep.theme)) end
	if keep.asset and key ~= skin.key then table.insert(head, "asset = " .. Util.str(keep.asset)) end
	table.insert(head, "price = " .. Util.num(keep.price or 100))
	table.insert(head, "tier = " .. Util.str(keep.tier or "Common"))
	if keep.icon then table.insert(head, "icon = " .. Util.num(keep.icon)) end
	if def.texture then
		table.insert(head, "surface = true")
		return comment .. "\n\t" .. Util.keyExpr(key) .. " = { " .. table.concat(head, ", ") .. " },"
	end
	if def.rig then table.insert(head, "rig = " .. Util.str(def.rig)) end
	local lines = { comment, "\t" .. Util.keyExpr(key) .. " = { " .. table.concat(head, ", ") .. ", pieces = {" }
	for _, p in ipairs(plan.pieces) do
		local a = { "socket = " .. Util.str(p.socket), "mesh = " .. Util.num(p.mesh) }
		if p.texture then table.insert(a, "texture = " .. Util.num(p.texture)) end
		local b = { "pivot = " .. Util.cframe(p.pivot) }
		if p.sa then table.insert(b, "sa = " .. Util.str(p.sa)) end
		if p.transparency then table.insert(b, "transparency = " .. Util.n6(p.transparency)) end
		if p.doubleSided then table.insert(b, "doubleSided = true") end
		if p.scale then
			table.insert(b, "scale = " .. (typeof(p.scale) == "Vector3" and Util.vector3(p.scale) or Util.n6(p.scale)))
		end
		table.insert(lines, "\t\t{ " .. table.concat(a, ", ") .. ",")
		table.insert(lines, "\t\t\t" .. table.concat(b, ", ") .. " },")
	end
	if plan.text then
		local t = plan.text
		local f = {}
		if t.font then
			table.insert(f, "font = " .. Util.str(t.font))
			table.insert(f, "weight = " .. Util.str(t.weight or "Regular"))
			table.insert(f, "style = " .. Util.str(t.style or "Normal"))
		end
		if t.color then table.insert(f, "color = " .. Util.color3(t.color)) end
		if t.outline then table.insert(f, "outline = " .. Util.color3(t.outline)) end
		if t.thickness then table.insert(f, "thickness = " .. Util.num(t.thickness)) end
		if t.scale then table.insert(f, "scale = " .. Util.num(t.scale)) end
		if t.curve then table.insert(f, "curve = " .. Util.num(t.curve)) end
		table.insert(lines, "\t}, text = { " .. table.concat(f, ", ") .. ",")
		table.insert(lines, "\t\tplane = " .. Util.cframe(t.plane) .. ", size = " .. Util.vector3(t.size) .. " } },")
	else
		table.insert(lines, "\t} },")
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

--[[ inspect(skin, webRow) ->
	{ checks = {...}, plan = { pieces, text, candle, face, sail }, row = text,
	  current = existing row text or nil, status = "new" | "same" | "changed",
	  ok = no "bad" check } ]]
function ShipSkins.inspect(skin, webRow)
	local def = Slots.SHIP[skin.slot]
	local model = skin.model
	local key = skin.key
	local checks = {}
	local plan = { pieces = {} }

	-- NAME
	if skin.duplicate then
		check(checks, "bad", "Two models in workspace." .. def.folder .. " are named '" .. key .. "' — they would be one shop item. Rename one.")
	end
	if not Util.isIdentifier(key) then
		check(checks, "bad", "The name '" .. key .. "' is not a valid catalogue key (letters, digits, _ only, no spaces). Rename the model.")
	end
	-- the NAME is the truth for the theme (the shop prices by it, the website matches it);
	-- the tag only follows it, so a disagreement is blamed on whichever one is off
	local theme = skin.nameTheme or themeOf(key, skin.slot)
	if skin.bareName then
		local want = key .. skin.slot
		local taken = model.Parent and model.Parent:FindFirstChild(want)
		check(checks, "warn", "The name is missing '" .. skin.slot .. "' at the end: every " .. skin.slot:lower()
			.. " is <Theme>" .. skin.slot .. ", so this one is " .. want .. ". The website and the shop look it up by that name."
			.. (taken and (" A model named " .. want .. " already exists here — rename one of them by hand.") or ""),
			not taken and {
				label = "Rename to " .. want,
				fn = function()
					model.Name = want
					skin.key = want
					skin.bareName = nil
				end,
			} or nil)
	elseif not theme then
		check(checks, "warn", "The name should be <Theme>" .. skin.slot .. " (e.g. Mango" .. skin.slot
			.. "): prices use the theme at the front of the key.")
	end
	local tags = themeTags(model)
	local counts = skin.themeCounts or {}
	-- the only piece with this theme name, tagged with a theme that has others AND no <Tag><Slot>
	-- yet: the NAME is the odd one out. (When <Tag><Slot> exists, e.g. CupidSail tagged GrapeFizz
	-- next to GrapeFizzSail, the tag was copied and is the one to fix.)
	local want = #tags == 1 and (tags[1] .. skin.slot) or nil
	-- and never when the website already knows this exact name (CosmicCatchBoard, tagged MidNight):
	-- the website matches by name, so there the tag is the one to fix
	local lone = theme and not skin.bareName and want and tags[1] ~= theme and type(webRow) ~= "table"
		and (counts[theme] or 0) <= 1 and (counts[tags[1]] or 0) >= 2
		and not (model.Parent and model.Parent:FindFirstChild(want))
	if lone then
		local taken = false
		check(checks, "warn", "Named " .. theme .. " but tagged '" .. tags[1] .. "'. No other skin is " .. theme .. ", while "
			.. counts[tags[1]] .. " are " .. tags[1] .. ", so the NAME is probably the one to fix (" .. want .. "). "
			.. "If " .. theme .. " really is a new theme, retag it " .. theme .. " instead. Check the website name first: it matches by name.",
			not taken and {
				label = "Rename to " .. want,
				fn = function()
					model.Name = want
					skin.key = want
				end,
			} or nil)
	elseif theme then
		if not table.find(tags, theme) then
			check(checks, "warn", (#tags > 0
				and ("Tagged '" .. table.concat(tags, "', '") .. "' but the name says " .. theme
					.. ". The name is what the shop prices by, so the tag is the one to fix (it was probably copied along with the model).")
				or ("No theme tag: it should be tagged '" .. theme .. "'."))
				.. " Style Preview groups skins by this tag.", {
				label = "Tag it " .. theme,
				fn = function()
					for _, t in ipairs(tags) do CollectionService:RemoveTag(model, t) end
					CollectionService:AddTag(model, theme)
				end,
			})
		end
	end

	-- TEXTURE SLOT (sail)
	if def.texture then
		local sa = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
		if sa then
			plan.sail = sa
			check(checks, "ok", "SurfaceAppearance found — it becomes SkinAppearances." .. skin.slot .. "." .. key .. ".Surface")
		else
			check(checks, "bad", "No SurfaceAppearance on the sail mesh — the game paints sails from one.")
		end
	else
		-- PIECES
		local unanchored = 0
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d.Anchored then unanchored += 1 end
		end
		if unanchored > 0 then
			-- info, not a warning: the Style Preview anchors every folder part itself at Run
			check(checks, "info", unanchored .. " part(s) not anchored (the Style Preview anchors them at Run; anchor them to keep the folder tidy).", {
				label = "Anchor all",
				fn = function()
					for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
						if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true end
					end
				end,
			})
		end
		local bySocket = {}
		local unmapped = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				local socket = Slots.socketFor(def, part.Name)
				if not socket then
					table.insert(unmapped, part.Name)
				else
					bySocket[socket] = bySocket[socket] or {}
					table.insert(bySocket[socket], part)
				end
			elseif part:IsA("BasePart") then
				check(checks, "warn", "'" .. part.Name .. "' is a " .. part.ClassName .. ", not a MeshPart — the game only mounts meshes.")
			end
		end
		local tplSockets = ShipSkins.templateSockets(skin.slot)
		if #unmapped > 0 then
			check(checks, "bad", "Piece(s) not named after a socket: " .. table.concat(unmapped, ", ")
				.. ". " .. skin.slot .. " sockets: " .. table.concat(tplSockets or def.sockets, ", ") .. ".")
		end

		-- PIECE NAMES = the template's placeholder names. A near miss (AimPart for Aim, "base",
		-- other capitals) still mounts through the plugin's aliases, but every piece should carry
		-- the exact socket name so it reads the same in every tool and place.
		if #def.sockets > 1 then
			local renames, shared = {}, {}
			for socket, parts in pairs(bySocket) do
				for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
					if part.Name ~= socket then
						if #parts > 1 then
							table.insert(shared, part.Name)
						else
							table.insert(renames, { part = part, to = socket })
						end
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(renames, function(a, b) return a.to < b.to end)
			if #renames > 0 then
				local words = {}
				for _, r in ipairs(renames) do table.insert(words, r.part.Name .. " → " .. r.to) end
				check(checks, "warn", "Named differently from the template's placeholders: " .. table.concat(words, ", ")
					.. ". It still mounts (the plugin maps these), but each piece should carry its socket's exact name.", {
					label = #renames == 1 and ("Rename to " .. renames[1].to) or ("Rename " .. #renames .. " pieces"),
					fn = function()
						for _, r in ipairs(renames) do
							if r.part.Parent == model then r.part.Name = r.to end
						end
					end,
				})
			end
			if #shared > 0 then
				check(checks, "info", "Several meshes share one socket (" .. table.concat(shared, ", ")
					.. "): their names are kept apart on purpose.")
			end
			-- sockets on the template this skin leaves empty, and pieces for sockets it lacks
			if tplSockets then
				local empty = {}
				for _, s in ipairs(tplSockets) do
					if not bySocket[s] and (not def.pair) then table.insert(empty, s) end
				end
				if #empty > 0 and #empty < #tplSockets then
					check(checks, "info", "No piece for " .. table.concat(empty, ", ")
						.. " — the ship keeps its default mesh there.")
				end
				for socket in pairs(bySocket) do
					if not table.find(tplSockets, socket) then
						check(checks, "warn", "'" .. socket .. "' has no placeholder on ServerStorage.ShipTemplate ("
							.. skin.slot .. " placeholders: " .. table.concat(tplSockets, ", ") .. ") — nothing would mount it.")
					end
				end
			end
		end
		-- PIECES ON ONE SOCKET share ONE pivot: each mounts by its own pivot on the same socket
		-- frame, so a glass whose pivot sits apart from its door leaf lands apart (DiscoOcto's
		-- glasses: 0.53 and 0.81 studs off, one turned 180°). The fix only re-points pivots.
		for socket, parts in pairs(bySocket) do
			if #parts > 1 then
				local main = parts[1]
				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
					if p.Name == socket then main = p break end
				end
				local mainPivot = main.CFrame * main.PivotOffset
				local off, worst = {}, 0
				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
					if p ~= main then
						local pv = p.CFrame * p.PivotOffset
						local d = (pv.Position - mainPivot.Position).Magnitude
						local a = Util.angleBetween(pv, mainPivot)
						if d > 0.01 or a > 0.5 then
							table.insert(off, string.format("%s (%.2f studs, %.0f°)", p.Name, d, a))
							worst = math.max(worst, d)
						end
					end
				end
				if #off > 0 then
					check(checks, "bad", "Pieces on " .. socket .. " must share " .. main.Name .. "'s pivot, or they mount apart: "
						.. table.concat(off, ", ") .. ".", {
						label = "Give them " .. main.Name .. "'s pivot",
						fn = function()
							local target = main.CFrame * main.PivotOffset
							for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
								if p ~= main and p.Parent == model then p.PivotOffset = p.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(target) end
							end
						end,
					})
				end
			end
		end
		-- A DOUBLE DOOR's leaves turned like the template's: the two sockets face opposite ways,
		-- so a leaf turned wrong shows its back. (Their spacing is not checked: the game pushes a
		-- wide leaf out to its hinge by itself.)
		if skin.slot == "Door" and bySocket.LeftDoor and bySocket.RightDoor then
			local tf = ShipSkins.templateFrames("Door")
			if tf and tf.LeftDoor and tf.RightDoor then
				local function pivotOf(socket)
					for _, p in ipairs(bySocket[socket]) do
						if p.Name == socket then return p.CFrame * p.PivotOffset end
					end
					local p = bySocket[socket][1]
					return p.CFrame * p.PivotOffset
				end
				local got = pivotOf("LeftDoor"):ToObjectSpace(pivotOf("RightDoor"))
				local want = tf.LeftDoor:ToObjectSpace(tf.RightDoor)
				local a = Util.angleBetween(got, want)
				if a > 5 then
					check(checks, "bad", string.format("LeftDoor and RightDoor pivots are turned %.0f° apart from the template's two leaves"
						.. " — one leaf would show its back in game. Fix it with Preview on ship → Turn 90° (press twice), or in Blender/Studio.", a))
				else
					check(checks, "ok", string.format("Door leaves turned like the template's (within %.1f°).", a))
				end
			end
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.Parent ~= model and not d:FindFirstAncestor("CandleRig")
				and not d:FindFirstAncestor("FaceRig") then
				check(checks, "warn", "Nested mesh '" .. d:GetFullName():sub(#model:GetFullName() + 2)
					.. "' is not mounted — only the direct pieces are. Move it up or merge it into its piece.")
			end
		end
		local mapped = 0
		for _, socket in ipairs(def.sockets) do
			local parts = bySocket[socket]
			if parts then
				for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
					mapped += 1
					local mesh = Util.assetId(part.MeshId)
					local sa = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					local texture = Util.assetId(part.TextureID)
					local scale, why = scaleOf(part)
					if not mesh then check(checks, "bad", part.Name .. ": no mesh id.") end
					if why then check(checks, "warn", part.Name .. ": " .. why .. " — scale could not be measured, press Refresh in a moment.") end
					if not texture and not sa then check(checks, "warn", part.Name .. ": no texture and no SurfaceAppearance — it will be plain grey.") end
					if part.Transparency >= 0.999 then check(checks, "warn", part.Name .. ": fully transparent — it will be invisible in game.") end
					if part.PivotOffset.Position.Magnitude > 3 then
						check(checks, "warn", part.Name .. ": pivot is " .. string.format("%.1f", part.PivotOffset.Position.Magnitude)
							.. " studs from the mesh — usually a Blender origin, not the socket.")
					end
					local saName = nil
					if sa then saName = (#parts > 1) and (socket .. "_" .. part.Name) or socket end
					table.insert(plan.pieces, {
						part = part, socket = socket, mesh = mesh or 0, texture = texture, sa = saName, saInst = sa,
						pivot = part.PivotOffset, scale = scale,
						transparency = (part.Transparency > 0.001 and part.Transparency < 0.999) and part.Transparency or nil,
						doubleSided = part.DoubleSided or nil,
					})
				end
			end
		end
		if mapped == 0 then check(checks, "bad", "No pieces — nothing would be mounted.") end
		if def.pair then
			for _, s in ipairs(def.sockets) do
				if not bySocket[s] then check(checks, "warn", "No " .. s .. " piece — that leaf keeps the default door.") end
			end
		end

		-- PIVOTS against the reference rig: mount each piece on the reference sockets
		-- (the game's PivotTo rule) and compare the layout with how it is parked here
		local ref = referenceFrames(def)
		if ref then
			local pts = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(plan.pieces) do
				if ref[p.socket] then
					table.insert(pts, { p = p, mounted = ref[p.socket] * p.pivot:Inverse(), parked = p.part.CFrame })
				end
			end
			if #pts >= 2 then
				local maxPos, maxRot = 0, 0
				for i = 1, #pts do
					for j = i + 1, #pts do
						local want = pts[i].parked:ToObjectSpace(pts[j].parked)
						local got = pts[i].mounted:ToObjectSpace(pts[j].mounted)
						maxPos = math.max(maxPos, (want.Position - got.Position).Magnitude)
						maxRot = math.max(maxRot, Util.angleBetween(want, got))
					end
				end
				local msg = string.format("Pivots vs %s: pieces land within %.2f studs / %.1f° of how they are parked here.",
					def.reference, maxPos, maxRot)
				if maxPos > PIVOT_POS_BAD or maxRot > PIVOT_ROT_BAD then
					-- The fix keeps the BasePart's pivot (it decides where the whole skin mounts) and
					-- puts every other piece's pivot where the reference's layout says, measured from
					-- it — position AND rotation, in this model's own frame. Then each piece mounts
					-- exactly as it is parked. (It used to copy only the reference's WORLD rotation:
					-- every skin failing on 2026-09-28 was off in position with 0° rotation error,
					-- so the button changed nothing.)
					local anchor = pts[1]
					for _, pt in ipairs(pts) do
						if pt.p.socket == "BasePart" then anchor = pt break end
					end
					-- ACCEPTED BY EYE: the owner looked at it on the preview ship and it is right (an
					-- anchor mounts on the template rig with the game's own rules, so the reference
					-- layout can disagree with a skin that looks perfect). Stored as the numbers it was
					-- accepted at, so moving a pivot afterwards brings the check back.
					local seal = string.format("%.2f/%.1f", maxPos, maxRot)
					local accept = {
						label = "Looks right — keep as is",
						fn = function() model:SetAttribute(PIVOT_OK_ATTR, seal) end,
					}
					if model:GetAttribute(PIVOT_OK_ATTR) == seal then
						check(checks, "info", msg .. " Accepted as it looks on the ship.", {
							label = "Check again",
							fn = function() model:SetAttribute(PIVOT_OK_ATTR, nil) end,
						})
					elseif def.rig then
