						check(checks, "warn", msg .. " " .. skin.slot .. " pieces mount on the ship's " .. skin.slot:lower()
							.. " rig by the game's own rules, so this can differ while the skin looks right: judge it with Preview on ship.", accept)
					else
						check(checks, "info", "If it looks right with Preview on ship, keep it as it is.", accept)
						check(checks, "bad", msg .. " Too far — in game the pieces would sit apart or turned. Usually a pivot set wrong in Blender/Studio.", {
							label = "Line up pivots from " .. anchor.p.part.Name,
							fn = function()
								local a = anchor.p.part
								local m = (a.CFrame * a.PivotOffset) * ref[anchor.p.socket]:Inverse()
								for _, pt in ipairs(pts) do
									if pt ~= anchor then
										local part = pt.p.part
										part.PivotOffset = part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(m * ref[pt.p.socket])
									end
								end
							end,
						})
					end
				elseif maxPos > PIVOT_POS_WARN then
					check(checks, "warn", msg)
				else
					check(checks, "ok", msg)
				end
			end
		end

		-- EXTRAS
		if def.extras == "candle" then
			local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
			local fitile = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
			local light = fitile and fitile:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light")
			local emitters = 0
			if fitile then
				for _, c in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
					if c:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then emitters += 1 end
				end
			end
			if not fitile then
				check(checks, "bad", "No CandleRig.Fitile — the lantern's light and flame come from it. Copy the CandleRig from LanternDefaultFinal and tint it.")
			elseif not light or emitters == 0 then
				check(checks, "bad", "CandleRig.Fitile needs a light and its fire / glow / smoke emitters.")
			else
				plan.candle = fitile
				local rgb = Util.color3(light.Color):gsub("Color3.fromRGB", "")
				check(checks, "ok", string.format("Light %s + %d effects — copied as the skin's light and flame.", rgb, emitters))
			end
		elseif def.extras == "face" then
			local rig = model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig")
			local hub = bySocket.RotationPart and bySocket.RotationPart[1]
			if not rig then
				check(checks, "bad", "No FaceRig — Billy's face needs one on every wheel skin (copy one from another wheel, place and colour it).")
			elseif not hub then
				check(checks, "bad", "No RotationPart piece — the face is measured from the wheel hub.")
			else
				plan.face = faceAttributes(rig, hub)
				local frames = 0
				for k in pairs(plan.face) do
					if k:match("^Face_MouthHappy.*_Color$") then frames += 1 end
				end
				check(checks, "ok", string.format("Face at scale %.3f, %d mouth frame(s) — the others follow MouthHappyRest.", plan.face.FaceScale, frames))
			end
		elseif def.extras == "text" then
			local piece = bySocket.Board and bySocket.Board[1]
			if piece then
				local t, why = boardText(model, piece)
				if not t then
					check(checks, "bad", why)
				else
					plan.text = t
					if not t.font or not t.color then
						check(checks, "warn", "No TextFont / TextColor attributes on the model — the name uses the default gold LuckiestGuy.")
					else
						local fontName = t.font:match("([^/]+)%.json$") or t.font
						local rgb = Util.color3(t.color):gsub("Color3.fromRGB", "")
						check(checks, "ok", "Name text: " .. fontName .. ", colour " .. rgb .. " — drawn on the BoardTextPlane.")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- THE ROW — keyed by the skin's WEBSITE ID (2026-10-03, docs/notes/economy/skin-ids.md in
	-- SailMe-Places): found under the id, else its name (not converted yet), else the row that
	-- carries the name as its legacy; an approve moves a name-keyed row to the id
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local rows = cat and cat[skin.slot]
	-- the skin's own developer product (AGENTS.md rule 11 in SailMe-Places): none yet = its name
	local pid = type(webRow) == "table" and tonumber(webRow.product_id)
	local id = (pid and pid > 0) and string.format("%d", pid) or nil
	local existingKey
	if type(rows) == "table" then
		if id and rows[id] then
			existingKey = id
		elseif rows[key] then
			existingKey = key
		else
			for k, r in pairs(rows) do
				if type(r) == "table" and r.legacy == key then existingKey = k break end
			end
		end
	end
	local existing = existingKey and rows[existingKey]
	-- A KEY HELD BY A PRODUCT NEVER MOVES (AGENTS.md rule 11 in SailMe-Places): a row already keyed by a
	-- product keeps it when the website gives none (not loaded / unreadable), and a DIFFERENT product
	-- is refused — never a silent move that orphans the owners
	local held = existingKey and existingKey:match("^%d%d%d%d%d+$") and existingKey or nil
	if held and id and held ~= id then
		check(checks, "bad", "The catalogue holds it under product " .. held .. ", but the website now links it to " .. id
			.. ". A product id never changes — fix the link on the website (Merch page) before approving.")
	end
	local catalogKey = id or held or key
	-- ONE PRODUCT, ONE SKIN: the row under this product belongs to ANOTHER website asset (identity, not names)
	if existing and id and existingKey == id and type(existing.asset) == "string" and type(webRow) == "table"
		and type(webRow.id) == "string" and existing.asset ~= webRow.id then
		check(checks, "bad", "Its developer product " .. id .. " already sells another skin (" .. tostring(existing.legacy or "?")
			.. ") in the catalogue. One product sells ONE skin — fix the product link on the website (Merch page) before approving.")
	end
	local keep = {
		price = existing and existing.price,
		tier = existing and existing.tier,
		icon = existing and existing.icon,
		catalogKey = catalogKey,
		legacy = (existing and existing.legacy) or (existingKey and existingKey ~= catalogKey and existingKey)
			or (catalogKey ~= key and key) or nil,
		name = (type(webRow) == "table" and type(webRow.shop_name) == "string" and #webRow.shop_name > 0 and webRow.shop_name)
			or (existing and existing.name) or nil,
		productId = (type(webRow) == "table" and tonumber(webRow.product_id)) or (existing and existing.productId) or nil,
		-- a renamed skin keeps the theme its row was given (the name may no longer carry it)
		theme = (existing and existing.theme) or theme,
		asset = (type(webRow) == "table" and type(webRow.id) == "string" and webRow.id) or (existing and existing.asset) or nil,
	}
	if webRow and webRow.tier and Slots.TIERS[webRow.tier] then keep.tier = Slots.TIERS[webRow.tier] end
	local row = rowText(skin, plan, keep)
	local module = ShipSkins.catalogModule()
	local current = module and existingKey and CatalogText.getRow(ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(module), skin.slot, existingKey)
	local diffs = existing and ShipSkins.diff(skin, existing, plan, existingKey) or nil
	if diffs and existingKey ~= catalogKey then
		table.insert(diffs, 1, "its key " .. existingKey .. " → its product id " .. catalogKey .. " (the old name stays as legacy)")
	end
	local status = (not existing) and "new" or (#diffs == 0 and "same" or "changed")

	local ok = true
	for _, c in ipairs(checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then ok = false end
	end
	return { checks = checks, plan = plan, row = row, current = current, status = status, diffs = diffs, ok = ok,
		catalogKey = catalogKey, existingKey = existingKey }
end

-- what the catalogue (and its appearance folder) says differently from the model,
-- in plain words; {} when they agree
local function near(a, b, tol) return math.abs(a - b) <= tol end
local function scaleVec(s)
	if s == nil then return Vector3.one end
	if typeof(s) == "Vector3" then return s end
	return Vector3.new(s, s, s)
end
function ShipSkins.diff(skin, entry, plan, rowKey)
	local d = {}
	local def = Slots.SHIP[skin.slot]
	local root = ShipSkins.appearancesRoot()
	local folder = root and root:FindFirstChild(skin.slot) and root[skin.slot]:FindFirstChild(rowKey or skin.key)
	if def.texture then
		local sa = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Surface")
		if not sa then
			table.insert(d, "the catalogue has no Surface art for it")
		elseif plan.sail and sa.ColorMap ~= plan.sail.ColorMap then
			table.insert(d, "the sail texture changed")
		end
		return d
	end
	local rows = entry.pieces or {}
	if #rows ~= #plan.pieces then
		table.insert(d, string.format("%d piece(s) in the catalogue, %d on the model", #rows, #plan.pieces))
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(plan.pieces) do
		local match
		for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
			if r.socket == p.socket and r.mesh == p.mesh then match = r end
		end
		if not match then
			table.insert(d, p.socket .. ": mesh " .. p.mesh .. " is not in the catalogue row")
		else
			if (match.texture or nil) ~= p.texture then table.insert(d, p.socket .. ": texture changed") end
			local rp = typeof(match.pivot) == "CFrame" and match.pivot or CFrame.new(match.pivot or Vector3.zero)
			local dp = (rp.Position - p.pivot.Position).Magnitude
			if dp > 0.001 or Util.angleBetween(rp, p.pivot) > 0.2 then -- rows are written to 6 places; below this is rounding
				table.insert(d, string.format("%s: pivot moved %.3f studs / %.1f°", p.socket, dp, Util.angleBetween(rp, p.pivot)))
			end
			local a, b = scaleVec(match.scale), scaleVec(p.scale)
			if not (near(a.X, b.X, 1e-3 * b.X) and near(a.Y, b.Y, 1e-3 * b.Y) and near(a.Z, b.Z, 1e-3 * b.Z)) then
				table.insert(d, string.format("%s: scale %s in the catalogue, %s on the model", p.socket,
					match.scale and Util.n6(a.X) or "none", p.scale and Util.n6(b.X) or "none"))
			end
			if not near(match.transparency or 0, p.transparency or 0, 1e-3) then table.insert(d, p.socket .. ": transparency changed") end
			if (match.doubleSided == true) ~= (p.doubleSided == true) then table.insert(d, p.socket .. ": double-sided changed") end
			if (match.sa ~= nil) ~= (p.sa ~= nil) then table.insert(d, p.socket .. ": SurfaceAppearance added or removed") end
			if p.saInst and folder then
				local have = folder:FindFirstChild(match.sa or p.sa)
				if not have or have.ColorMap ~= p.saInst.ColorMap then table.insert(d, p.socket .. ": texture art changed") end
			end
		end
	end
	if def.rig and entry.rig ~= def.rig then table.insert(d, "rig = \"" .. def.rig .. "\" missing") end
	if plan.candle then
		local have = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
		local l1 = have and have:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light")
		local l2 = plan.candle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light")
		if not have then
			table.insert(d, "light / flame not in the catalogue yet")
		elseif not (l1 and l2 and l1.Color == l2.Color) then
			table.insert(d, "light colour changed")
		else
			for _, e in ipairs(plan.candle:GetChildren()) do
				if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					local o = have:FindFirstChild(e.Name)
					if not (o and o:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and o.Color == e.Color) then table.insert(d, e.Name .. " colour changed") end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if plan.face then
		local fs = folder and folder:GetAttribute("FaceScale")
		if type(fs) ~= "number" then
			table.insert(d, "face not in the catalogue yet")
		else
			local changed = false
			for k, v in pairs(plan.face) do
				local o = folder:GetAttribute(k)
				if typeof(v) == "CFrame" then
					if typeof(o) ~= "CFrame" or (o.Position - v.Position).Magnitude > 1e-3 then changed = true end
				elseif typeof(v) == "number" then
					if type(o) ~= "number" or not near(o, v, 1e-4) then changed = true end
				elseif o ~= v then
					changed = true
				end
			end
			if changed then table.insert(d, "face position / colours changed") end
		end
	end
	if plan.text then
		local t = entry.text
		if type(t) ~= "table" then
			table.insert(d, "name text style not in the catalogue yet")
		elseif t.font ~= plan.text.font or t.color ~= plan.text.color or t.outline ~= plan.text.outline
			or t.thickness ~= plan.text.thickness or t.scale ~= plan.text.scale or t.curve ~= plan.text.curve
			or (typeof(t.size) == "Vector3" and (t.size - plan.text.size).Magnitude > 1e-3)
			or typeof(t.plane) ~= "CFrame" or (t.plane.Position - plan.text.plane.Position).Magnitude > 1e-3 then
			table.insert(d, "name text style changed")
		end
	end
	return d
end

local function buildAppearance(skin, plan, catalogKey, oldKey)
	local root = ShipSkins.appearancesRoot()
	local slotF = root:FindFirstChild(skin.slot)
	if not slotF then
		slotF = Instance.new("Folder")
		slotF.Name = skin.slot
		slotF.Parent = root
	end
	for _, k in ipairs({ oldKey or skin.key, catalogKey or skin.key }) do
		local old = slotF:FindFirstChild(k)
		if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = catalogKey or skin.key
	local any = false
	for _, p in ipairs(plan.pieces) do
		if p.saInst and p.sa then
			local c = p.saInst:Clone()
			c.Name = p.sa
			c.Parent = f
			any = true
		end
	end
	if plan.sail then
		local c = plan.sail:Clone()
		c.Name = "Surface"
		c.Parent = f
		any = true
	end
	if plan.candle then
		local c = plan.candle:Clone()
		for _, k in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
			if not (k:IsA("Light") or k:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) then k:Destroy() end
		end
		c.Name = "Fitile"
		c.Parent = f
		any = true
	end
	if plan.face then
		for k, v in pairs(plan.face) do f:SetAttribute(k, v) end
		any = true
	end
	if any then f.Parent = slotF else f:Destroy() end
	return any
end

-- returns ok, message
function ShipSkins.approve(skin, result)
	if not result.ok then return false, "Fix the red checks first." end
	local module = ShipSkins.catalogModule()
	if not module then return false, "No ReplicatedStorage.SkinCatalog in this place." end
	if not ShipSkins.appearancesRoot() then return false, "No ServerStorage.SkinAppearances in this place." end

	local recording = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("SailMeSkinsApprove", "Approve skin " .. skin.key)
	local oldSource = ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(module)
	local newSource, how
	local okSplice, err = pcall(function()
		local key = result.catalogKey or skin.key
		local src = oldSource
		-- a row moving to its id: the name-keyed row goes, the id row takes its place
		if result.existingKey and result.existingKey ~= key then src = CatalogText.remove(src, skin.slot, result.existingKey) end
		newSource, how = CatalogText.upsert(src, skin.slot, key, result.row)
	end)
	if not okSplice then
		if recording then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	-- prove the new catalogue loads and holds the row before touching the real module
	local probe = module:Clone()
	probe.Source = newSource
	local okLoad, data = pcall(require, probe)
	probe:Destroy()
	local entry = okLoad and type(data) == "table" and data[skin.slot] and data[skin.slot][result.catalogKey or skin.key]
	if not entry then
		if recording then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
		return false, "The new catalogue did not load (" .. tostring(okLoad and "row missing" or data) .. ") — nothing was changed."
	end

	-- a plain .Source write, never UpdateSourceAsync: only a property write marks the Package as
	-- changed. On 2026-09-29 six approved cannons sat in SkinCatalog written by UpdateSourceAsync and
	-- Publish Package answered "matched the newest version; no new version was created".
	local okWrite, werr = pcall(function()
		module.Source = newSource
	end)
	if not okWrite then
		if recording then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
		return false, "Could not write SkinCatalog: " .. tostring(werr)
	end
	local art = buildAppearance(skin, result.plan, result.catalogKey, result.existingKey)
	if recording then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
	catalogCache = nil
	return true, string.format("%s %s in SkinCatalog.%s%s. Now right-click SkinCatalog%s → Publish Package.",
		how == "added" and "Added" or "Updated", skin.key, skin.slot,
		art and (" and its art in SkinAppearances." .. skin.slot .. "." .. (result.catalogKey or skin.key)) or "",
		art and " and SkinAppearances" or "")
end

-- run a check's fix as one undo step
function ShipSkins.runFix(fix)
	local recording = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("SailMeSkinsFix", fix.label)
	local ok, err = pcall(fix.fn)
	if recording then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording,
			ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	return ok, err
end

-- the theme a skin key names (<Theme><Slot>), for skins not in the place yet (Import)
ShipSkins.themeOfName = themeOf

return ShipSkins
modules.Slots:
--[[
	Slots — what each skin type looks like in the Assets place and what the game
	reads for it. Socket names and aliases were taken from the game's SkinService
	(Arena src/server + Shipyard places/shipyard/server) and from the 85 rows that
	were already catalogued on 2026-09-28 (every Assets piece matched to its row by
	mesh id). Matching is case-insensitive, so only real renames need an alias.
]]

local Slots = {}

-- SHIP SKINS -> ReplicatedStorage.SkinCatalog.<Slot> + ServerStorage.SkinAppearances.<Slot>
-- folder     : workspace.<folder> in the Assets place
-- sockets    : the names SkinService mounts on (a piece's `socket`)
-- aliases    : lower-case piece name -> socket
-- reference  : a model in the folder whose pieces show where the sockets are
--              (its parts' pivots are the socket frames); used to check pivots
-- extras     : "candle" (lantern light/VFX), "face" (wheel face), "text" (board name)
-- rig        : written into every row (Anchor: pieces mount on the template rig)
Slots.SHIP = {
	Anchor = {
		folder = "Anchor",
		sockets = { "BasePart", "RotationPart", "LeftHand", "RightHand", "CenterPart" },
		aliases = { cappart = "CenterPart", cap = "CenterPart", knob = "CenterPart", center = "CenterPart",
			rotationalpart = "RotationPart" }, -- AnchorTemplate's RotationalPartTemplate (2026-10-03)
		reference = "AnchorDefault",
		rig = "template",
	},
	Wheel = {
		folder = "Wheel",
		sockets = { "BasePart", "RotationPart" },
		aliases = { base = "BasePart", wheel = "RotationPart", wheelpart = "RotationPart" },
		extras = "face",
	},
	Cannon = {
		folder = "Cannon",
		sockets = { "BasePart", "RotationPart", "OpenMouth", "CloseMouth", "Tongue", "Aim" },
		aliases = { aimpart = "Aim", base = "BasePart" },
		reference = "CannonDefault",
	},
	Lantern = {
		folder = "Lantern",
		sockets = { "Handle", "Base", "Glass", "Legs" },
		aliases = { basepart = "Base", hangingpart = "Handle" },
		reference = "LanternDefaultFinal",
		extras = "candle",
	},
	Harpoon = {
		folder = "Harpoon",
		sockets = { "BasePart", "LowerRotationPart", "UpperRotationPart" },
	},
	Door = {
		folder = "Door",
		sockets = { "LeftDoor", "RightDoor" },
		-- a leaf's glass is its own (transparent) mesh, mounted on that leaf's socket
		aliases = { leftglass = "LeftDoor", rightglass = "RightDoor" },
		-- names offered beside the sockets when naming pieces (2026-10-03): a leaf's GLASS is named
		-- LeftGlass / RightGlass — it mounts on that leaf's socket without two pieces sharing a name
		extraNames = { "LeftGlass", "RightGlass" },
		pair = true, -- a double door: warn when one leaf is missing
	},
	Window = {
		folder = "Window",
		sockets = { "BasePart", "CoverPart" },
		aliases = { frame = "BasePart", cover = "CoverPart" },
	},
	Board = {
		folder = "Board",
		sockets = { "Board" },
		extras = "text",
	},
	Bell = {
		folder = "Bell",
		sockets = { "BasePart", "RotationPart", "TonguePart" },
		aliases = { rotationalpart = "RotationPart" },
		reference = "bellTemplate",
	},
	Stove = {
		folder = "Stove",
		sockets = { "Stove" },
	},
	Sail = {
		folder = "Sailes",
		texture = true, -- a MeshPart carrying one SurfaceAppearance -> SkinAppearances.Sail.<Key>.Surface
	},
}

-- the order slots are listed in the panel
Slots.ORDER = { "Wheel", "Lantern", "Cannon", "Anchor", "Window", "Door", "Bell", "Board", "Sail", "Harpoon", "Stove" }

-- models in a slot folder that are references, rigs or parked parts, never skins
Slots.NOT_A_SKIN_TAGS = { defaultTest = true, Main = true }
function Slots.isReferenceName(name)
	local l = name:lower()
	return l:find("template", 1, true) ~= nil or l:find("default", 1, true) ~= nil
end

-- TOOL SKINS -> ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins.<Tool>.<Key> (a Package)
-- tag        : CollectionService tag on the designer's model (PVP&NPC ASSETS place)
-- folder     : its folder in that place (2026-10-03, the owner: "Flintlock, Sword, Bucket have their own
--              folder, like the Assets place"): every skin of the tool, read by the plugin, and its pads
--              in <folder>.Pads (a pad equips the nearest skin in the folder — SkinPadService)
-- required   : mount attributes ToolSkinMount needs on the model
-- optional   : mount attributes with a default
Slots.TOOL = {
	Sword = {
		tag = "SwordSkin",
		folder = "Sword", -- its folder in PVP&NPC ASSETS: the skins, and its pads in <folder>.Pads
		oldFolder = "ZAAL Assets", oldPads = "SwordSkinPads", -- the room's names before 2026-10-03
		required = { HiltEnd = "string" },
		optional = { SkinOffset = "Vector3", SkinPitch = "number", SkinYaw = "number", SkinRoll = "number" },
		check = function(model)
			local h = model:GetAttribute("HiltEnd")
			if h ~= nil and h ~= "+Z" and h ~= "-Z" then
				return "HiltEnd must be \"+Z\" or \"-Z\" (it is " .. tostring(h) .. ")"
			end
			return nil
		end,
	},
	Flintlock = {
		tag = "FlintlockSkin",
		folder = "Flintlock",
		oldFolder = "Flintlock Assets", oldPads = "FlintlockSkinPads",
		required = {},
		optional = { SkinPitch = "number", SkinYaw = "number", SkinRoll = "number", SkinOffset = "Vector3" },
	},
	Bucket = {
		tag = "BucketSkin",
		folder = "Bucket",
		oldFolder = "Bucket Assets", oldPads = "BucketSkinPads",
		required = { WaterDiameter = "number", WaterRim = "number" },
		optional = { WaterOffset = "Vector3", SkinPitch = "number", SkinYaw = "number", SkinRoll = "number", SkinOffset = "Vector3" },
	},
}
Slots.TOOL_ORDER = { "Sword", "Flintlock", "Bucket" }
Slots.TOOL_PADS = "Pads"

-- a tool's folder in the workspace (a Folder: the place also had a Tool named Bucket), else its old
-- name's (a place not organised yet), else — with create — a new one
function Slots.toolFolder(tool, create)
	local def = Slots.TOOL[tool]
	if not def then return nil end
	for _, c in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == def.folder and c:IsA("Folder") then return c end
	end
	local old = def.oldFolder and workspace:FindFirstChild(def.oldFolder)
	if old then return old end
	if not create then return nil end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = def.folder
	f.Parent = workspace
	return f
end

-- a tool's pads folder: <folder>.Pads, else the old top-level one, else — with create — a new Pads
function Slots.toolPads(tool, create)
	local def = Slots.TOOL[tool]
	local f = Slots.toolFolder(tool, false)
	local pads = f and f:FindFirstChild(Slots.TOOL_PADS)
	if pads then return pads end
	local old = def and def.oldPads and workspace:FindFirstChild(def.oldPads)
	if old then return old end
	if not create then return nil end
	pads = Instance.new("Folder")
	pads.Name = Slots.TOOL_PADS
	pads.Parent = Slots.toolFolder(tool, true)
	return pads
end

-- the game's tiers, as the catalogue and the ToolSkins attributes spell them
Slots.TIERS = { common = "Common", rare = "Rare", epic = "Epic", legendary = "Legendary" }

-- the socket a piece name maps to, or nil
function Slots.socketFor(def, pieceName)
	if #def.sockets == 1 then return def.sockets[1] end
	local l = pieceName:lower():gsub("%s+$", "")
	for _, s in ipairs(def.sockets) do
		if s:lower() == l then return s end
	end
	return def.aliases and def.aliases[l] or nil
end

return Slots
modules.Theme:
--[[
	Theme — the ZAAL Assets panel's look: Studio's own light/dark colours for the
	surfaces and text, one accent, tier and status colours, and a handful of
	components (card, pill, button, segmented control, swatches, input).
]]

local Theme = {}

local studio = settings().Studio
local C = Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor
local M = Enum.StudioStyleGuideModifier

function Theme.studio(c, m)
	return studio.Theme:GetColor(c, m or M.Default)
end

local function isDark()
	local bg = Theme.studio(C.MainBackground)
	return (bg.R + bg.G + bg.B) / 3 < 0.5
end
Theme.dark = isDark()

Theme.color = {
	bg = Theme.studio(C.MainBackground),
	panel = Theme.studio(C.ScriptBackground),
	card = Theme.dark and Color3.fromRGB(43, 45, 51) or Color3.fromRGB(246, 247, 249),
	cardStroke = Theme.dark and Color3.fromRGB(58, 61, 69) or Color3.fromRGB(225, 227, 232),
	raised = Theme.dark and Color3.fromRGB(52, 55, 62) or Color3.fromRGB(236, 238, 242),
	hover = Theme.dark and Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 75) or Color3.fromRGB(226, 229, 235),
	selected = Theme.dark and Color3.fromRGB(33, 58, 102) or Color3.fromRGB(214, 228, 252),
	text = Theme.studio(C.MainText),
	dim = Theme.studio(C.DimmedText),
	input = Theme.studio(C.InputFieldBackground),
	accent = Color3.fromRGB(47, 128, 255),
	accentHover = Color3.fromRGB(84, 151, 255),
	onAccent = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	ok = Color3.fromRGB(46, 184, 104),
	warn = Color3.fromRGB(230, 163, 35),
	bad = Color3.fromRGB(229, 72, 77),
	info = Color3.fromRGB(128, 134, 145),
}

Theme.TIER = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(140, 148, 160),
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(52, 132, 245),
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(162, 89, 245),
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(240, 168, 40),
}
Theme.TIER_ORDER = { "Common", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary" }

Theme.font = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json", Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
Theme.fontMedium = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
Theme.fontBold = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
Theme.fontMono = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.RobotoMono)

-- builder --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Theme.new(class, props, children)
	local i = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do i[k] = v end
	for _, c in ipairs(children or {}) do c.Parent = i end
	return i
end
local new = Theme.new

function Theme.corner(px) return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, px) }) end
function Theme.stroke(color, t) return new("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = t or 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }) end
function Theme.pad(t, r, b, l)
	return new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, t), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r or t),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b or t), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, l or r or t) })
end
function Theme.vlist(gap, align)
	return new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 0), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		HorizontalAlignment = align or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left })
end
function Theme.hlist(gap, valign)
	return new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 0), FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, VerticalAlignment = valign or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center })
end

function Theme.text(text, props)
	local p = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, FontFace = Theme.font, TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, TextWrapped = true,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
	}
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	return new("TextLabel", p)
end

-- a hover-aware button: kind = "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger"
function Theme.button(text, kind, onClick, props)
	local base = ({
		primary = Theme.color.accent, secondary = Theme.color.raised, ghost = Theme.color.bg, danger = Theme.color.bad,
		ok = Theme.color.ok, warn = Theme.color.warn, -- Apply / Revert: never mistaken for the other buttons
	})[kind or "secondary"]
	local hover = ({
		primary = Theme.color.accentHover, secondary = Theme.color.hover, ghost = Theme.color.hover,
		danger = Theme.color.bad:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15),
		ok = Theme.color.ok:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15), warn = Theme.color.warn:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15),
	})[kind or "secondary"]
	local fg = (kind == "primary" or kind == "danger" or kind == "ok" or kind == "warn") and Theme.color.onAccent or Theme.color.text
	local p = {
		Text = text, FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 14, AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = base, TextColor3 = fg, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	local b = new("TextButton", p, { Theme.corner(6), Theme.pad(0, 12, 0, 12) })
	if kind == "ghost" or kind == "secondary" then Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke).Parent = b end
	local enabled = true
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if enabled then b.BackgroundColor3 = hover end end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if enabled then b.BackgroundColor3 = base end end)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if enabled and onClick then onClick() end end)
	local api = {}
	function api.setEnabled(on)
		enabled = on
		b.BackgroundColor3 = on and base or Theme.color.raised
		b.TextColor3 = on and fg or Theme.color.dim
	end
	return b, api
end

-- a small rounded label: tinted background, coloured text
function Theme.pill(text, color, props)
	local p = {
		Text = text, FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = color,
		BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	return new("TextLabel", p, { Theme.corner(10), Theme.pad(0, 8, 0, 8) })
end

-- a card: rounded, bordered, padded, vertical list; optional small caps title
function Theme.card(title, order, props)
	local p = {
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order or 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	local f = new("Frame", p, { Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke), Theme.pad(12, 14, 12, 14), Theme.vlist(8) })
	if title then
		Theme.text(title:upper(), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.color.dim, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

-- a horizontal row that sizes to its content
function Theme.row(gap, order, height)
	return new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order or 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 30), AutomaticSize = height and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.Y },
		{ Theme.hlist(gap or 8) })
end

-- segmented control: options = { { key, label, color? } }; onPick(key)
function Theme.segmented(options, selected, onPick, props)
	local p = { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.raised, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X }
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	local f = new("Frame", p, { Theme.corner(7), Theme.pad(3), Theme.hlist(3) })
	local buttons = {}
	local function paint(key)
		for k, b in pairs(buttons) do
			local on = k == key
			local col = b:GetAttribute("OnColor")
			b.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1
			b.BackgroundColor3 = on and (col or Theme.color.accent) or Theme.color.raised
			b.TextColor3 = on and Theme.color.onAccent or Theme.color.text
		end
	end
	for i, o in ipairs(options) do
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Text = o[2], FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = i,
		}, { Theme.corner(5), Theme.pad(0, 12, 0, 12) })
		if o[3] then b:SetAttribute("OnColor", o[3]) end
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			paint(o[1])
			onPick(o[1])
		end)
		buttons[o[1]] = b
		b.Parent = f
	end
	paint(selected)
	return f, paint
end

-- like segmented, but the options WRAP onto more lines instead of running off a narrow panel
-- (a cannon's six pieces). options = { { key, label } }; onPick(key). props sizes the frame.
function Theme.chips(options, selected, onPick, props)
	local p = { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	local f = new("Frame", p, {
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Wraps = true, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
	})
	-- Wraps keeps a gap between lines only through a vertical padding: the layout's Padding is
	-- along the line, so each chip carries its own bottom margin
	local buttons = {}
	local function paint(key)
		for k, b in pairs(buttons) do
			local on = k == key
			b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.color.accent or Theme.color.raised
			b.TextColor3 = on and Theme.color.onAccent or Theme.color.text
		end
	end
	for i, o in ipairs(options) do
		local holder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X })
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Text = o[2], FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		}, { Theme.corner(6), Theme.pad(0, 12, 0, 12), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke) })
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			paint(o[1])
			onPick(o[1])
		end)
		b.Parent = holder
		holder.Parent = f
		buttons[o[1]] = b
	end
	paint(selected)
	return f
end

-- chips where SEVERAL can be on (2026-10-03, the owner: move two or three pieces together): the
-- caller keeps the choice; onPick(key) changes it, then every chip repaints from isOn(key)
function Theme.multiChips(options, isOn, onPick, props)
	local p = { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	local f = new("Frame", p, {
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Wraps = true, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
	})
	local buttons = {}
	local function paint()
		for k, b in pairs(buttons) do
			local on = isOn(k)
			b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.color.accent or Theme.color.raised
			b.TextColor3 = on and Theme.color.onAccent or Theme.color.text
		end
	end
	for i, o in ipairs(options) do
		local holder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X })
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Text = o[2], FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		}, { Theme.corner(6), Theme.pad(0, 12, 0, 12), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke) })
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			onPick(o[1])
			paint()
		end)
		b.Parent = holder
		holder.Parent = f
		buttons[o[1]] = b
	end
	paint()
	return f
end

-- colour swatches; onPick(Color3)
Theme.SWATCHES = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 105), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 50), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 60), Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
	Color3.fromRGB(190, 140, 255), Color3.fromRGB(110, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 255), Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 210),
	Color3.fromRGB(40, 220, 120), Color3.fromRGB(170, 190, 80), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 8),
}
function Theme.swatches(colors, current, onPick, order)
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order or 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, {
		new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
	})
	for i, c in ipairs(colors) do
		local near = current and (math.abs(current.R - c.R) + math.abs(current.G - c.G) + math.abs(current.B - c.B)) < 0.03
		local b = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true, BackgroundColor3 = c, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i },
			{ Theme.corner(13), Theme.stroke(near and Theme.color.text or Theme.color.cardStroke, near and 2 or 1) })
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() onPick(c) end)
		b.Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

function Theme.input(placeholder, text, props)
	local p = {
		Text = text or "", PlaceholderText = placeholder or "", FontFace = Theme.font, TextSize = 14, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.input, TextColor3 = Theme.color.text, PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.color.dim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
	}
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
	return new("TextBox", p, { Theme.corner(6), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke), Theme.pad(0, 10, 0, 10) })
end

-- DRAGGING: while a slider is held, a see-through CATCHER covers the whole panel. It takes every
-- mouse move and the release wherever it happens — the release used to be heard only by the
-- panel root, so letting go over a button (buttons swallow input) or off the panel left the
-- slider following the mouse with no button down (2026-10-02). Leaving the panel ends the drag
-- too: a release out there can't be heard at all. Nothing runs when no one drags.
local activeDrag = nil
local activeRelease = nil -- the dragged slider's onRelease, called once when the drag ends
local dragHost, catcher = nil, nil
local function endDrag()
	if catcher then
		catcher:Destroy()
		catcher = nil
	end
	if not activeDrag then return end
	activeDrag = nil
	local r = activeRelease
	activeRelease = nil
	if r then r() end
end
local function beginDrag()
	if catcher or not dragHost then return end
	catcher = new("TextButton", { Name = "DragCatcher", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 10000 })
	catcher.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if activeDrag and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then activeDrag(input.Position.X) end
	end)
	catcher.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then endDrag() end
	end)
	catcher.MouseButton1Up:Connect(endDrag)
	catcher.MouseLeave:Connect(endDrag)
	catcher.Parent = dragHost
end
function Theme.bindDragHost(host)
	dragHost = host
	-- the old path stays as a backstop (the catcher normally hears everything first)
	host.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if activeDrag and not catcher and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then activeDrag(input.Position.X) end
	end)
	host.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then endDrag() end
	end)
end

-- true while a slider is being dragged (a re-render then would destroy the slider under the mouse)
function Theme.dragging() return activeDrag ~= nil end

-- a 0..1 slider over a gradient; onChange(value) while dragging / on click.
-- returns the frame and set(value) (moves the knob without calling onChange);
-- onRelease (optional) runs once when the drag or click ends
function Theme.slider(label, value, gradient, onChange, order, onRelease)
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), LayoutOrder = order or 0 })
	Theme.text(label, { TextColor3 = Theme.color.dim, TextSize = 12, Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = f
	local track = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0.5, -7), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 14) },
		{ Theme.corner(7), new("UIGradient", { Color = gradient }), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke) })
	local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(value, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 2) })
	knob.Parent = track
	track.Parent = f
	local function set(v) knob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(v, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0) end
	local function fromX(x)
		local v = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		set(v)
		onChange(v)
	end
	track.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(x)
		activeDrag = fromX
		activeRelease = onRelease
		beginDrag()
		fromX(x)
	end)
	track.MouseButton1Up:Connect(endDrag)
	return f, set, track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
end

function Theme.hex(c)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

-- "255, 200, 105", "255 200 105" or "#FFC869" -> Color3, or nil
function Theme.parseColor(s)
	s = s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local hex = s:match("^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$")
	if hex then
		return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16))
	end
	local r, g, b = s:match("^(%d+)[,%s]+(%d+)[,%s]+(%d+)$")
	if r then
		return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255))
	end
	return nil
end

-- a 0..255 colour as "255, 200, 105"
function Theme.rgb(c)
	return string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

-- any colour: the preset swatches, an "r, g, b or #hex" box and Hue / Saturation / Brightness
-- sliders. onLive(c) runs while a slider is dragged (show it, keep it cheap, no undo step);
-- onCommit(c) once per finished choice — a swatch, the box, or the end of a slider drag.
function Theme.colorPicker(current, onLive, onCommit, order)
	current = current or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order or 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, { Theme.vlist(6) })
	Theme.swatches(Theme.SWATCHES, current, function(c) onCommit(c) end, 1).Parent = f
	local r = Theme.row(8, 2, 28)
	local chip = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), BackgroundColor3 = current, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 1 },
		{ Theme.corner(6), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke) })
	chip.Parent = r
	local box = Theme.input("r, g, b  or  #hex", "", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 28), FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 2 })
	box.Parent = r
	r.Parent = f
	local h0, s0, v0 = current:ToHSV()
	local cur = { h = h0, s = s0, v = v0 }
	local hueKeys = {}
	for i = 0, 6 do table.insert(hueKeys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(i / 6 % 1, 1, 1))) end
	local sliders = {}
	local function show(c)
		chip.BackgroundColor3 = c
		if not box:IsFocused() then box.Text = Theme.rgb(c) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(c) end
		if sliders.sgrad then
			sliders.sgrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, 0, cur.v), Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, 1, math.max(cur.v, 0.05)))
			sliders.vgrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, 1))
		end
	end
	local function fromSliders()
		local c = Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, cur.v)
		show(c)
		onLive(c)
	end
	local function release() onCommit(Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, cur.v)) end
	local white = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	local hf = Theme.slider("Hue", h0, ColorSequence.new(hueKeys), function(x) cur.h = x fromSliders() end, 3, release)
	local sf, _, sgrad = Theme.slider("Saturation", s0, white, function(x) cur.s = x fromSliders() end, 4, release)
	local vf, _, vgrad = Theme.slider("Brightness", v0, white, function(x) cur.v = x fromSliders() end, 5, release)
	sliders.sgrad, sliders.vgrad = sgrad, vgrad
	hf.Parent, sf.Parent, vf.Parent = f, f, f
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local c = Theme.parseColor(box.Text:match("#%x+") or box.Text:gsub("%s+#%x+$", ""))
		if c then onCommit(c) else show(Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, cur.v)) end
	end)
	show(current)
	return f
end

return Theme
modules.ToolBundles:
--[[
	ToolBundles — tool skins grouped into named bundles, kept IN THE PLACE (2026-10-03, the owner:
	"bundle different items together, and they sit in a different place in tidy up").

	A bundle is a grouping in PVP&NPC ASSETS only: no shop, no website, no game effect. Tidy stands a
	bundle's skins together in the BUNDLES row (past the three tool rows), each still in its own tool's
	display folder with a pad of its own tool in front, so stepping on it equips it as before; a skin in
	a bundle leaves its tool row.

	Kept in ServerStorage.ZAALToolBundles: one Configuration per bundle (its Name is the bundle's name,
	attribute Order its place in the list), holding one ObjectValue per skin pointing at the skin's
	model — a reference, so a renamed or moved skin stays in its bundle. Nothing is written on the skin
	models themselves (Approve copies a model's attributes into ToolSkins). A skin is in one bundle at
	most. Every change is one undo step; save the place to keep it.
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)

local ToolBundles = {}

local FOLDER = "ZAALToolBundles"
ToolBundles.MAX_NAME = 40

local function recorded(name, fn)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsBundles", name)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	return ok, err
end

local function folder(create)
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER)
	if not f and create then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- which tool a skin model is (its row's tag, else its row's display folder), or nil
function ToolBundles.toolOf(model)
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local def = Slots.TOOL[tool]
		if CollectionService:HasTag(model, def.tag) then return tool end
		local f = Slots.toolFolder(tool, false)
		if f and model.Parent == f then return tool end
	end
	return nil
end

local function live(model)
	return model ~= nil and (model:IsA("Model") or model:IsA("MeshPart")) and model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
end

-- the bundles, in their order: { { inst, name, items = { { model, tool } } } }
function ToolBundles.list()
	local f = folder(false)
	local out = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(f and f:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if c:IsA("Configuration") then
			local b = { inst = c, name = c.Name, items = {} }
			for _, v in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and live(v.Value) then
					table.insert(b.items, { model = v.Value, tool = ToolBundles.toolOf(v.Value) })
				end
			end
			-- within a bundle: Sword, Flintlock, Bucket (Slots.TOOL_ORDER), then by name
			table.sort(b.items, function(a, z)
				local ia, iz = table.find(Slots.TOOL_ORDER, a.tool) or 99, table.find(Slots.TOOL_ORDER, z.tool) or 99
				if ia ~= iz then return ia < iz end
				return a.model.Name:lower() < z.model.Name:lower()
			end)
			table.insert(out, b)
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, z)
		local oa, oz = tonumber(a.inst:GetAttribute("Order")) or 0, tonumber(z.inst:GetAttribute("Order")) or 0
		if oa ~= oz then return oa < oz end
		return a.name:lower() < z.name:lower()
	end)
	return out
end

-- the bundle a skin model is in, or nil
function ToolBundles.bundleOf(model)
	for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do
		for _, it in ipairs(b.items) do
			if it.model == model then return b end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- { [model] = bundle } for every skin in a bundle
function ToolBundles.members()
	local m = {}
	for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do
		for _, it in ipairs(b.items) do m[it.model] = b end
	end
	return m
end

local function nameProblem(name, except)
	if name == "" then return "Give the bundle a name." end
	if #name > ToolBundles.MAX_NAME then return "At most " .. ToolBundles.MAX_NAME .. " letters." end
	for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do
		if b.inst ~= except and b.name:lower() == name:lower() then return "There is already a bundle called " .. b.name .. "." end
	end
	return nil
end

-- answers ok, message, the new bundle's name
function ToolBundles.create(name)
	name = tostring(name or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local why = nameProblem(name)
	if why then return false, why end
	local last = 0
	for _, b in ipairs(ToolBundles.list()) do last = math.max(last, tonumber(b.inst:GetAttribute("Order")) or 0) end
	local ok, err = recorded("New bundle " .. name, function()
		local c = Instance.new("Configuration")
		c.Name = name
		c:SetAttribute("Order", last + 1)
		c.Parent = folder(true)
	end)
	if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
	return true, "Bundle " .. name .. " made — add its skins below.", name
end

function ToolBundles.rename(bundle, name)
	name = tostring(name or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if name == bundle.name then return true, "" end
	local why = nameProblem(name, bundle.inst)
	if why then return false, why end
	local ok, err = recorded("Rename bundle " .. bundle.name, function() bundle.inst.Name = name end)
	return ok, ok and ("Renamed to " .. name .. ".") or tostring(err)
end

function ToolBundles.delete(bundle)
	local ok, err = recorded("Delete bundle " .. bundle.name, function()
		bundle.inst.Parent = nil -- not Destroy: Ctrl+Z brings it back
	end)
	return ok, ok and ("Bundle " .. bundle.name .. " deleted (its skins go back to their tool rows at the next Tidy; Ctrl+Z undoes it).") or tostring(err)
end

-- one place up (-1) or down (+1) in the list
function ToolBundles.move(bundle, step)
	local list = ToolBundles.list()
	local i
	for k, b in ipairs(list) do
		if b.inst == bundle.inst then i = k end
	end
	local j = i and i + step
	if not (j and list[j]) then return false end
	return recorded("Reorder bundles", function()
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
		for k, b in ipairs(list) do b.inst:SetAttribute("Order", k) end
	end)
end

-- add a skin (out of any other bundle first)
function ToolBundles.add(bundle, model)
	if not live(model) then return false, "That skin is not in the place." end
	if not ToolBundles.toolOf(model) then return false, model.Name .. " is not a Sword, Bucket or Flintlock skin." end
	local other = ToolBundles.bundleOf(model)
	if other and other.inst == bundle.inst then return false, model.Name .. " is already in " .. bundle.name .. "." end
	local ok, err = recorded("Add " .. model.Name .. " to " .. bundle.name, function()
		if other then
			for _, v in ipairs(other.inst:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Value == model then v.Parent = nil end
			end
		end
		local v = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		v.Name = model.Name
		v.Value = model
		v.Parent = bundle.inst
	end)
	if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
	return true, model.Name .. " added to " .. bundle.name .. (other and (" (taken out of " .. other.name .. ")") or "") .. "."
end

function ToolBundles.remove(bundle, model)
	local ok, err = recorded("Take " .. model.Name .. " out of " .. bundle.name, function()
		for _, v in ipairs(bundle.inst:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and (v.Value == model or not live(v.Value)) then v.Parent = nil end
		end
	end)
	return ok, ok and (model.Name .. " taken out of " .. bundle.name .. ".") or tostring(err)
end

return ToolBundles
modules.ToolData:
--[[
	ToolData — ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkinData, the tool skins as DATA (2026-10-03).

	The game keeps sword / flintlock / bucket skins the way it keeps ship skins: a row of ids per skin
	in a ModuleScript Package, and the MeshPart built only when someone looks at it or wears it
	(SailMe-Places src/shared/ToolSkinRows.luau). It replaced ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins, 89 Models
	every player was sent at join (the owner: "this method is heavy, why we are not making it like
	shipyard"). The module is published ONLY from PVP&NPC ASSETS, and only this plugin writes it —
	the whole source is regenerated from the table on every write, sorted, so two writes of the same
	rows are the same text and a diff shows exactly what moved.

	  return {
	  	Sword = {
	  		["3713965573"] = { mesh = 135660202898281, texture = 126650117799904,
	  			size = Vector3.new(...), doubleSided = true,
	  			attrs = { HiltEnd = "+Z", LegacyKey = "sowrd-fish", ProductId = 3713965573, Tier = "Common", ... } },
	  	},
	  	Flintlock = { ... },
	  	Bucket = { ... },
	  }

	Numbers are written with %.17g, which reads back as exactly the same number, so an unchanged skin
	never shows as "changed" because of rounding.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local ToolData = {}

ToolData.NAME = "ToolSkinData"

function ToolData.module()
	local m = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(ToolData.NAME)
	return (m and m:IsA("ModuleScript")) and m or nil
end

-- the rows as a table (a clone is required, so a stale require cache never lies); an empty table
-- when there is no module yet; nil + why when the module does not load. Kept while the source is
-- unchanged, so checking 90 skins reads it once — READ ONLY: pass `fresh` for a table to change.
local cacheSrc, cacheData
function ToolData.read(fresh)
	local m = ToolData.module()
	if not m then return {} end
	local src = m.Source
	if not fresh and src == cacheSrc then return cacheData end
	local ok, data = pcall(require, m:Clone())
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil, "ToolSkinData did not load: " .. tostring(data) end
	if not fresh then cacheSrc, cacheData = src, data end
	return data
end

-- one row of a table read by ToolData.read, or nil
function ToolData.row(data, tool, key)
	local t = type(data) == "table" and data[tool]
	local r = type(t) == "table" and t[key]
	return type(r) == "table" and r or nil
end

-- the key whose row carries `legacy` as its LegacyKey, or nil
function ToolData.keyByLegacy(data, tool, legacy)
	local t = type(data) == "table" and data[tool]
	for k, r in pairs(type(t) == "table" and t or {}) do
		if type(r) == "table" and type(r.attrs) == "table" and r.attrs.LegacyKey == legacy then return k end
	end
	return nil
end

--=========================================================== model -> row ====

local function meshOf(model)
	if model:IsA("MeshPart") then return model end
	return model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
end

-- a row from a skin Model (one MeshPart + attributes); `attrs` replaces the model's own when given.
-- nil + why when the model has no usable mesh.
function ToolData.rowFromModel(model, attrs)
	local mp = meshOf(model)
	local mesh = mp and Util.assetId(mp.MeshId)
	if not mesh then return nil, "no MeshPart with a MeshId" end
	local a = {}
	for k, v in pairs(attrs or model:GetAttributes()) do
		if k ~= "RBX_ReimportId" then a[k] = v end
	end
	return {
		mesh = mesh,
		texture = Util.assetId(mp.TextureID),
		size = mp.Size,
		doubleSided = mp.DoubleSided or nil,
		attrs = a,
	}
end

-- are two rows the same skin, value for value (what Approve compares before writing)
local function same(a, b)
	if typeof(a) ~= typeof(b) then return false end
	if type(a) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(a) do
			if not same(v, b[k]) then return false end
		end
		for k in pairs(b) do
			if a[k] == nil then return false end
		end
		return true
	end
	return a == b
end
ToolData.same = same

--========================================================== row -> source ===

local function num(x)
	if x == math.floor(x) and math.abs(x) < 1e15 then return string.format("%d", x) end
	return string.format("%.17g", x)
end

local function value(v)
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "string" then return Util.str(v) end
	if t == "number" then return num(v) end
	if t == "boolean" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "Vector3" then return ("Vector3.new(%s, %s, %s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y), num(v.Z)) end
	if t == "Vector2" then return ("Vector2.new(%s, %s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y)) end
	if t == "Color3" then return ("Color3.new(%s, %s, %s)"):format(num(v.R), num(v.G), num(v.B)) end
	if t == "CFrame" then
		local c = { v:GetComponents() }
		for i, x in ipairs(c) do c[i] = num(x) end
		return "CFrame.new(" .. table.concat(c, ", ") .. ")"
	end
	error("ToolSkinData cannot hold a " .. t)
end

local function sortedKeys(t)
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(t) do table.insert(keys, k) end
	table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
	return keys
end

local HEADER = [[
-- ToolSkinData — the sword / flintlock / bucket skins as DATA: one row per skin, keyed by its
-- developer product id (its name until it has one). WRITTEN BY THE ZAAL ASSETS PLUGIN — never edit
-- by hand. A Package published ONLY from PVP&NPC ASSETS. Read by ToolSkinRows (SailMe-Places
-- src/shared/ToolSkinRows.luau), which builds each skin's MeshPart only when it is shown or worn.
]]

function ToolData.source(data)
	local out = { HEADER, "return {" }
	local tools = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do table.insert(tools, t) end
	for _, t in ipairs(sortedKeys(data)) do
		if not table.find(tools, t) then table.insert(tools, t) end
	end
	for _, tool in ipairs(tools) do
		local rows = type(data[tool]) == "table" and data[tool] or {}
		table.insert(out, "\t" .. Util.keyExpr(tool) .. " = {")
		for _, key in ipairs(sortedKeys(rows)) do
			local r = rows[key]
			local parts = { "mesh = " .. num(r.mesh) }
			if r.texture then table.insert(parts, "texture = " .. num(r.texture)) end
			if r.size then table.insert(parts, "size = " .. value(r.size)) end
			if r.doubleSided then table.insert(parts, "doubleSided = true") end
			local attrs = {}
			for _, k in ipairs(sortedKeys(r.attrs or {})) do
				table.insert(attrs, Util.keyExpr(k) .. " = " .. value(r.attrs[k]))
			end
			table.insert(parts, "attrs = { " .. table.concat(attrs, ", ") .. " }")
			table.insert(out, "\t\t[" .. Util.str(tostring(key)) .. "] = { " .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. " },")
		end
		table.insert(out, "\t},")
	end
	table.insert(out, "}")
	return table.concat(out, "\n") .. "\n"
end

-- write the rows (creating ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkinData when there is none). The new text is
-- loaded and compared with `data` BEFORE it replaces the module, so a bad write never lands.
-- A plain .Source write: only a property write marks a Package as changed (ShipSkins.approve).
function ToolData.write(data)
	local src = ToolData.source(data)
	local m = ToolData.module()
	local probe = m and m:Clone() or Instance.new("ModuleScript")
	probe.Source = src
	local ok, back = pcall(require, probe)
	probe:Destroy()
	if not (ok and type(back) == "table") then return false, "the new ToolSkinData did not load: " .. tostring(back) end
	for tool, rows in pairs(data) do
		for key, r in pairs(rows) do
			if not same(r, ToolData.row(back, tool, key)) then
				return false, "the new ToolSkinData lost " .. tool .. "." .. tostring(key) .. " — nothing written"
			end
		end
	end
	if not m then
		m = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
		m.Name = ToolData.NAME
		m.Source = src
		m.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	else
		m.Source = src
	end
	return true
end

return ToolData
modules.ToolPreview:
--[[
	ToolPreview — a tool skin in an avatar's hand, mounted EXACTLY as the game mounts it (2026-10-02,
	the owner: tools "should work same as ship").

	The rule is the game's own: shared/ToolSkinMount.luau is a byte-for-byte copy of the Arena's
	src/server/ToolSkinMount.luau (scripts/sync-shared.cjs), so what you see here is what a player
	holds. The tool is a copy of StarterPack's (its Handle, and the art marked SkinArt that a skin
	replaces); the hand is Roblox's DEFAULT R15 avatar WITH FINGERS (the owner, 2026-10-02: "that R15
	which has fingers in his hand" — the place's model named Standard, else any grey body whose
	RightHand is mesh 8650495280), copied from
	the place and stripped of clothes and accessories, so every skin is judged on the same plain body
	and a real grip. With none in the place, Roblox's generated default avatar stands in.

	Everything lives in workspace.ZAAL_ToolPreview (Archivable off: never saved, never published).
	Changing the skin model's mount attributes (HiltEnd, SkinPitch/Yaw/Roll, SkinOffset, Water*)
	re-mounts it on the next frame.
]]

local StarterPack = game:GetService("StarterPack")

local ToolSkinMount = require(script.Parent.ToolSkinMount)

local ToolPreview = {}

local FOLDER = "ZAAL_ToolPreview"
local SPOT = Vector3.new(0, 6, -80) -- an empty stretch of the baseplate in front of the rows

local state = { folder = nil, rig = nil, tools = {}, skin = nil, conn = nil, sizeConn = nil, pending = false }

-- SEE-THROUGH (2026-10-03, as the ship's template): "art" = the tool's own default art (what a skin
-- replaces, the frame it mounts on) faded behind the skin; "hidden" = hidden, as the game does
-- "hitbox" = the tool's invisible working parts shown red (as the ship's template: its colliders);
-- "both" = the two together
ToolPreview.seeThrough = "art"
local SEE_THROUGH = 0.7
local HITBOX_SEE = 0.55
local HITBOX_COLOUR = Color3.fromRGB(235, 60, 60)
local HITBOX_GRIP = Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 40)

-- LOCKED (2026-10-03, as the preview ship): the avatar and the tool cannot be dragged by a stray click
local function lock(inst)
	for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Locked = true end
	end
end

local function strip(inst)
	for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then d:Destroy() end
	end
end

-- THE AVATARS: the place's models named Standard, Standard2, … (the owner's picks, 2026-10-02 —
-- default R15 bodies with fingers), switchable; else any fingered default R15 (hand mesh
-- 8650495280); else Roblox's generated default. Copied bare: no clothes or accessories.
local FINGERED_HAND = "8650495280"
local function bare(m)
	local rig = m:Clone()
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Accessory") or d:IsA("Clothing") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or d:IsA("WrapLayer") then d:Destroy() end
	end
	return rig
end
local function isRig(m)
	local preview = workspace:FindFirstChild(FOLDER)
	return m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil and m:FindFirstChild("RightHand") ~= nil
		and not (preview and m:IsDescendantOf(preview))
end

-- the switchable avatars: { "Skeleton", "Standard", "Standard2", … } — rigs named Standard… or
-- Skeleton… anywhere in the workspace (workspace.Avatars), sorted. A SKELETON (2026-10-03, the owner):
-- the game's skeleton crew rig, copied into workspace.Avatars and named Skeleton (it must be R15 with a
-- RightHand to hold anything)
local function pickable(name)
	local l = name:lower()
	return l:sub(1, 8) == "standard" or l:sub(1, 8) == "skeleton"
end
function ToolPreview.avatars()
	local out, seen = {}, {}
	for _, m in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isRig(m) and pickable(m.Name) and not seen[m.Name] then
			seen[m.Name] = true
			table.insert(out, m.Name)
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(x, y) return x:lower() < y:lower() end)
	return out
end

local function rigNamed(name)
	local fingered
	for _, m in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isRig(m) then
			if name and m.Name == name then return bare(m) end
			local hand = m.RightHand
			if not fingered and hand:IsA("MeshPart") and tostring(hand.MeshId):find(FINGERED_HAND, 1, true) then fingered = m end
		end
	end
	return fingered and bare(fingered) or nil
end
-- the fallback: Roblox's generated default R15 (classic colours: an empty description is all black)
local function defaultRig()
	local ok, rig = pcall(function()
		-- an empty description is all black: the classic default colours instead, so the tool reads
		local d = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
		local yellow, blue, green = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48), Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172), Color3.fromRGB(164, 189, 71)
		d.HeadColor, d.LeftArmColor, d.RightArmColor = yellow, yellow, yellow
		d.TorsoColor = blue
		d.LeftLegColor, d.RightLegColor = green, green
		return game:GetService("Players"):CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(d, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	end)
	return (ok and rig and rig:FindFirstChild("RightHand")) and rig or nil
end
local function findRig()
	for _, m in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and m:FindFirstChild("RightHand") and m.Name ~= FOLDER then
			return m
		end
	end
	local sc = game:GetService("StarterPlayer"):FindFirstChild("StarterCharacter")
	return (sc and sc:FindFirstChild("RightHand")) and sc or nil
end

function ToolPreview.exists()
	return state.folder ~= nil and state.folder.Parent ~= nil
end

local function ensure()
	if ToolPreview.exists() then return true end
	local avatars = ToolPreview.avatars()
	if not (state.avatar and table.find(avatars, state.avatar)) then state.avatar = avatars[1] end
	local rig = rigNamed(state.avatar) or defaultRig()
	if not rig then
		local src = findRig()
		if not src then return false, "Roblox could not build a default avatar, and this place has no R15 character." end
		rig = src:Clone()
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER
	folder.Archivable = false
	strip(rig)
	rig.Name = "PreviewAvatar"
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	rig:PivotTo(CFrame.new(SPOT) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)) -- facing the camera's usual side
	-- stand on the ground (the baseplate's top at Y = 0), not where the pivot happens to land
	local box, size = rig:GetBoundingBox()
	rig:PivotTo(rig:GetPivot() - Vector3.new(0, box.Y - size.Y / 2, 0))
	rig.Parent = folder
	lock(rig)
	folder.Parent = workspace
	state.folder, state.rig, state.tools = folder, rig, {}
	-- the rest pose and the joints, for posing from a keyframe
	state.rest, state.motors = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then state.rest[d] = d.CFrame end
		-- a joint either way: a Motor6D (C0 / C1), or — the newer avatars, like Standard — an
		-- AnimationConstraint between two attachments (their frames are its C0 / C1); a keyframe's
		-- pose is the same joint transform for both
		local j
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part0 and d.Part1 then
			j = { part0 = d.Part0, part1 = d.Part1, c0 = d.C0, c1 = d.C1 }
		elseif d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d.Attachment0 and d.Attachment1 then
			local a0, a1 = d.Attachment0, d.Attachment1
			if a0.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and a1.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
				j = { part0 = a0.Parent, part1 = a1.Parent, c0 = a0.CFrame, c1 = a1.CFrame }
			end
		end
		if j then
			state.motors[j.part0] = state.motors[j.part0] or {}
			table.insert(state.motors[j.part0], j)
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- hold the tool as Roblox does — Handle = RightHand * RightGripAttachment * Grip⁻¹ — wherever the
-- hand is now (a pose moves it); every part of the tool, the mounted skin included, moves with it
local function hold(tool)
	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local hand = state.rig and state.rig:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	if not (handle and hand) then return end
	local att = hand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
	local want = hand.CFrame * (att and att.CFrame or CFrame.new(0, -hand.Size.Y / 2, 0)) * tool.Grip:Inverse()
	local move = want * handle.CFrame:Inverse()
	for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CFrame = move * d.CFrame end
	end
end

-- POSES (the owner, 2026-10-02): one keyframe of the tool's OWN animation (its Animation objects in
-- StarterPack — what the game plays), the most extreme frame of it: Sword Guard / Attack, Flintlock
-- Aim (the Shoot animation's first frame) / Reload, Bucket Bail / Throw. A row can name its frame
-- ("first", "last", a time); without one it is the most extreme. A keyframe lists only the joints that move in it, so each
-- joint is followed across the keyframes and read at that moment.
-- HOLD is each tool's Idle — the game plays it the whole time a tool is equipped, so it is how a
-- player sees a skin held (the bare rest pose hung the bucket on its side) and the default pose.
-- THE SWORD'S "Idle" IS NOT A HOLD (2026-10-03, the owner: "why is the sword hold like this?"): it is a
-- 0.5 s DRAW, played once and never looped (StarterPack.sword.SwordHandler says so), and its most extreme
-- frame is mid-draw — both hands up at the chest. Once drawn, a player stands in Roblox's default tool
-- hold (the Animate script's toolnone, 507768375, the same in every avatar here), so that is the Hold.
-- A row may name an animation id instead of an Animation in the tool.
ToolPreview.TOOL_HOLD = "rbxassetid://507768375"
ToolPreview.POSES = {
	Sword = { { "hold", "Hold", ToolPreview.TOOL_HOLD, "first" }, { "guard", "Guard", "Guard1" }, { "attack", "Attack", "Slash1" } },
	-- the flintlock's Shoot animation STARTS on the aim (arm out, barrel level) and its peak is the
	-- recoil — the aim is the pose that shows a skin (the owner, 2026-10-02)
	Flintlock = { { "hold", "Hold", "Idle" }, { "aim", "Aim", "Shoot", "first" }, { "reload", "Reload", "Reload" } },
	Bucket = { { "hold", "Hold", "Idle" }, { "bail", "Bail", "Scoop" }, { "throw", "Throw", "Throw" } },
}
local poseCache = {} -- [animation id] = { [part name] = CFrame } or false

-- which frame: "first" / "last" / a time in seconds, or nil = the most extreme moment
local function poseOf(seq, which)
	local kfs = seq:GetKeyframes()
	table.sort(kfs, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	local tracks = {}
	for _, kf in ipairs(kfs) do
		for _, p in ipairs(kf:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("Pose") then
				tracks[p.Name] = tracks[p.Name] or {}
				table.insert(tracks[p.Name], { t = kf.Time, cf = p.CFrame })
			end
		end
	end
	local function at(t)
		local out = {}
		for name, tr in pairs(tracks) do
			local a, b = tr[1], tr[#tr]
			for _, k in ipairs(tr) do
				if k.t <= t then a = k end
				if k.t >= t then b = k break end
			end
			out[name] = (b.t > a.t) and a.cf:Lerp(b.cf, (t - a.t) / (b.t - a.t)) or a.cf
		end
		return out
	end
	if which == "first" then return at(kfs[1] and kfs[1].Time or 0) end
	if which == "last" then return at(kfs[#kfs] and kfs[#kfs].Time or 0) end
	if type(which) == "number" then return at(which) end
	-- the most extreme moment: the biggest turn of every joint together
	local best, bestScore = kfs[1] and kfs[1].Time or 0, -1
	for _, kf in ipairs(kfs) do
		local score = 0
		for _, cf in pairs(at(kf.Time)) do
			local _, angle = cf:ToAxisAngle()
			score += math.abs(angle)
		end
		if score > bestScore then best, bestScore = kf.Time, score end
	end
	return at(best)
end

local function loadPose(catalog, animName, which)
	local config = ToolSkinMount.configFor(catalog)
	local id
	if animName:find("^rbxassetid://") or animName:find("^https?://") then
		id = animName -- an animation of its own (the default tool hold), not one of the tool's
	else
		local src = config and StarterPack:FindFirstChild(config.toolName)
		local anim
		for _, d in ipairs(src and src:GetDescendants() or {}) do
			if d:IsA("Animation") and d.Name == animName then anim = d break end
		end
		if not anim then return nil, "No " .. animName .. " animation in StarterPack." .. tostring(config and config.toolName) .. "." end
		id = anim.AnimationId
	end
	local key = id .. "|" .. tostring(which)
	if poseCache[key] == nil then
		local ok, seq = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider"):GetKeyframeSequenceAsync(id)
		end)
		poseCache[key] = ok and poseOf(seq, which) or false
	end
	if not poseCache[key] then return nil, "Roblox would not hand over the " .. animName .. " animation." end
	return poseCache[key]
end

-- the avatar in a pose ({ [part] = joint CFrame }), or at rest (nil): every joint from the root out,
-- Part1 = Part0 * C0 * pose * C1⁻¹ (C0 / C1: a Motor6D's, or an AnimationConstraint's attachments)
local function applyPose(pose)
	for part, cf in pairs(state.rest or {}) do part.CFrame = cf end
	if not pose then return end
	local root = state.rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local function walk(part0)
		for _, j in ipairs(state.motors[part0] or {}) do
			j.part1.CFrame = part0.CFrame * j.c0 * (pose[j.part1.Name] or CFrame.identity) * j.c1:Inverse()
			walk(j.part1)
		end
	end
	if root then walk(root) end
end

-- the tool for a catalog folder (Sword / Flintlock / Bucket), held in the right hand
local function toolFor(catalog)
	local config = ToolSkinMount.configFor(catalog)
	if not config then return nil, nil, "No mount row for " .. tostring(catalog) .. "." end
	local tool = state.tools[catalog]
	if tool and tool.Parent then return tool, config end
	local src = StarterPack:FindFirstChild(config.toolName)
	if not (src and src:IsA("Tool")) then return nil, nil, "No StarterPack." .. config.toolName .. " tool in this place." end
	tool = src:Clone()
	strip(tool)
	if not (tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") and state.rig:FindFirstChild("RightHand")) then
		return nil, nil, "The tool has no Handle, or the avatar no RightHand."
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	hold(tool)
	tool.Parent = state.folder
	state.tools[catalog] = tool
	return tool, config
end

local function remount()
	local skin = state.skin
	if not (skin and skin.model.Parent and ToolPreview.exists()) then return end
	for name, t in pairs(state.tools) do
		if t.Parent then t.Parent = name == skin.slot and state.folder or nil end
	end
	-- the pose first (a pose of another tool goes back to rest), then the tool into the hand
	local poseWhy
	local valid = false
	for _, row in ipairs(ToolPreview.POSES[skin.slot] or {}) do
		if row[1] == state.poseKey then
			valid = true
			local pose, why = loadPose(skin.slot, row[3], row[4])
			poseWhy = why
			applyPose(pose)
		end
	end
	if not valid then
		-- a pose of another tool (or none yet): this tool's Hold
		local hold = (ToolPreview.POSES[skin.slot] or {})[1]
		state.poseKey = hold and hold[1] or nil
		local pose = hold and loadPose(skin.slot, hold[3], hold[4])
		applyPose(pose)
	end
	local tool, config, why = toolFor(skin.slot)
	if not tool then return false, why end
	tool.Parent = state.folder
	hold(tool)
	local ok = ToolSkinMount.apply(config, tool, skin.model)
	-- the mounted mesh is welded to the anchored Handle; keep it still and out of the way
	for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("SkinPart") then
			d.Anchored = true
		end
		-- the default art the mount just hid: faded in again, as a guide (this copy only)
		local showArt = ToolPreview.seeThrough == "art" or ToolPreview.seeThrough == "both"
		if ok and showArt and d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("SkinArt") then
			local authored = d:GetAttribute("AuthoredTransparency")
			if type(authored) == "number" and authored < 1 then d.Transparency = math.max(authored, SEE_THROUGH) end
		end
		-- THE HITBOX (2026-10-03, the owner: "the see-through of the template too — the sword's collide"):
		-- the tool's invisible working Parts (the sword's Blade / Crossguard / TrailSword, the
		-- flintlock's ShootPart, the bucket's ThrowBall) and its Handle — never art, never a mesh —
		-- shown see-through red (the Handle, the grip, yellow), as the ship's template shows its colliders
		if d:IsA("Part") and not d:GetAttribute("SkinArt") and not d:GetAttribute("SkinPart") then
			if d:GetAttribute("ZAALHitbox") == nil and d.Transparency >= 0.99 then
				d:SetAttribute("ZAALHitbox", true)
				d:SetAttribute("ZAALHitboxColor", d.Color)
			end
			if d:GetAttribute("ZAALHitbox") then
				local showBox = ToolPreview.seeThrough == "hitbox" or ToolPreview.seeThrough == "both"
				d.Transparency = showBox and HITBOX_SEE or 1
				d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				d.Color = showBox and (d.Name == "Handle" and HITBOX_GRIP or HITBOX_COLOUR) or d:GetAttribute("ZAALHitboxColor")
			end
		end
	end
	lock(tool)
	if ok and poseWhy then return true, poseWhy end
	if ok then return true, nil end -- (not "ok and nil or …": that is always the message)
	return false, "The game's mount refused it (see Output)."
end

-- show `skin` (a ToolSkins.scan row) in the hand; answers ok, message
function ToolPreview.show(skin)
	local ok, why = ensure()
	if not ok then return false, why end
	state.skin = skin
	if state.conn then state.conn:Disconnect() end
	-- a mount attribute changed (the Adjust buttons, or by hand), or the mesh was scaled: re-mount next frame
	local function later()
		if state.pending then return end
		state.pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			state.pending = false
			remount()
		end)
	end
	state.conn = skin.model.AttributeChanged:Connect(later)
	if state.sizeConn then state.sizeConn:Disconnect() end
	local mesh = ToolSkinMount.meshOf(skin.model)
	state.sizeConn = mesh and mesh:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(later) or nil
	local okM, msg = remount()
	ToolPreview.focus()
	if okM == false then return false, msg end
	return true, skin.key .. " in the avatar's hand — mounted by the game's own rule."
end

-- mount again now (the see-through switch)
function ToolPreview.refresh()
	return remount()
end

function ToolPreview.showing()
	return state.skin
end

-- the pose shown ("guard", "attack", … or nil = rest) and its choices for a tool
function ToolPreview.pose()
	return state.poseKey
end
function ToolPreview.setPose(key)
	state.poseKey = key
	local ok, why = remount()
	return ok ~= false, why
end

-- the avatar holding it (a name from ToolPreview.avatars()), rebuilt in place
function ToolPreview.avatar()
	return state.avatar
end
function ToolPreview.setAvatar(name)
	state.avatar = name
	if not ToolPreview.exists() then return true end
	state.folder:Destroy()
	state.folder, state.rig, state.tools = nil, nil, {}
	local ok, why = ensure()
	if not ok then return false, why end
	local okM, msg = remount()
	return okM ~= false, msg
end

-- the camera on the hand and the tool
function ToolPreview.focus()
	if not ToolPreview.exists() then return end
	local hand = state.rig:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	local at = hand and hand.Position or SPOT
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local front = state.rig:GetPivot().LookVector
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(at + front * 6 + Vector3.new(2.5, 1.5, 0), at)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(at)
end

function ToolPreview.clear()
	if state.conn then state.conn:Disconnect() end
	if state.sizeConn then state.sizeConn:Disconnect() end
	state.conn, state.sizeConn = nil, nil
	state.skin = nil
	if state.folder then state.folder:Destroy() end
	state.folder, state.rig, state.tools = nil, nil, {}
end

return ToolPreview
modules.ToolSkins:
--[[
	ToolSkins — sword / flintlock / bucket skins in the PVP&NPC ASSETS place.

	The designer's model (tagged SwordSkin / FlintlockSkin / BucketSkin) is one
	MeshPart plus the mount attributes ToolSkinMount reads. Approve writes it as a
	ROW of ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkinData (ToolData, 2026-10-03: mesh id, texture id,
	size and attributes — the game builds the mesh only when it is shown or worn) —
	a Package published only from this place, so the Lobby, Arena and Shipyard all
	pick it up from one Publish Package — and stamps what the shop reads: Tier and
	Exclusive (from the website), Shown (the website's shop name), Icon (kept from
	the old row). The old ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins folder of Models is gone;
	Settings → Convert builds ToolSkinData from it once.
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local ToolData = require(script.Parent.ToolData)

local ToolSkins = {}

local SHOP_ATTRS = { Tier = true, Exclusive = true, Icon = true, Shown = true, LegacyKey = true, ProductId = true, WebsiteAsset = true }
